          var data = await res.json().catch(function() { return {}; });
          return { ok: res.ok, data: data };
        } catch (err) {
          return { ok: false, data: {}, networkError: true };
        }
      },
      get: async function(url) {
        try {
          var res = await fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin' });
          if (!res.ok) return null;
          return await res.json();
        } catch (e) { return null; }
      },
    };

    function extractError(errData) {
      var defaultMsg = 'Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± ÙˆØ±ÙˆØ¯.';
      if (!errData) return defaultMsg;
      if (typeof errData === 'string') return errData;
      if (Array.isArray(errData)) {
        return errData.map(function(e) {
          if (typeof e === 'string') return e;
          return e.string || e.detail || e.message || defaultMsg;
        }).join(' ');
      }
      if (errData.detail) return errData.detail;
      if (errData.string) return errData.string;
      return defaultMsg;
    }

    async function handleLogin(e) {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();

      if (subscriptionExpired) {
        store.set({ status: 'error', message: 'Ø§Ù…Ú©Ø§Ù† ÙˆØ±ÙˆØ¯ ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ Ù†Ø¯Ø§Ø±Ø¯. Ø§Ø´ØªØ±Ø§Ú© Ù…Ù†Ù‚Ø¶ÛŒ Ø´Ø¯Ù‡.' });

      var username = ($('login-username') || {}).value || '';
      var password = ($('login-password') || {}).value || '';
      username = username.trim();

      if (!username || !password) {
        store.set({ status: 'error', message: 'Ù†Ø§Ù… Ú©Ø§Ø±Ø¨Ø±ÛŒ Ùˆ Ø±Ù…Ø² Ø¹Ø¨ÙˆØ± Ø±Ø§ ÙˆØ§Ø±Ø¯ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯.' });

        var result = await api.post('/api/super/login/', credentials);
        if (result.networkError) {
          store.set({ status: 'error', message: 'Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø§ØªØµØ§Ù„ Ø¨Ù‡ Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ±.' });
          return;

        }
      } else {
        var result = await api.post(API_BASE + '/login/', credentials);
        if (result.networkError) {
          store.set({ status: 'error', message: 'Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø§ØªØµØ§Ù„ Ø¨Ù‡ Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ±.' });

        localStorage.setItem('refresh_token', data.refresh);

        // â”€â”€ Sidebar Toggle
        function toggleSidebar() {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('open');
            document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay').classList.toggle('show');
        }

        // â”€â”€ Toast
        function showToast(message, type) {
            type = type || 'info';
            var container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
            var toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = 'toast toast-' + type;
            var icons = { success: '&#10004;', error: '&#10008;', info: '&#8505;' };
            toast.innerHTML = '<span>' + (icons[type] || icons.info) + '</span> ' + message;
            container.appendChild(toast);
            setTimeout(function() {
                toast.style.opacity = '0';
                toast.style.transform = 'translateX(-20px)';
                toast.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
                setTimeout(function() { toast.remove(); }, 300);
            }, 4000);
        }

        // â”€â”€ CSRF Token
        function getCookie(name) {
            var cookieValue = null;
            if (document.cookie && document.cookie !== '') {
                var cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
                for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
                    var cookie = cookies[i].trim();
                    if (cookie.substring(0, name.length + 1) === (name + '=')) {
                        cookieValue = decodeURIComponent(cookie.substring(name.length + 1));
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return cookieValue;
        }
        var CSRF_TOKEN = getCookie('csrftoken');

        // â”€â”€ API Helper
        function apiCall(url, method, data) {
            method = method || 'GET';
            var options = {
                method: method,
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN
                }
            };
            if (data) options.body = JSON.stringify(data);
            return fetch(url, options).then(function(r) { return r.json(); });
        }

        // â”€â”€ Number Format
        function formatNumber(n) {
            return Number(n).toLocaleString('fa-IR');
        }

        // â”€â”€ Close sidebar on link click (mobile)
        document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-link').forEach(function(link) {
            link.addEventListener('click', function() {
                if (window.innerWidth <= 768) toggleSidebar();
            });
        });

  function showError(msg) {
    errorMsg.textContent = msg;
    errorBox.style.display = 'block';
    errorBox.style.animation = 'none';
    errorBox.offsetHeight;
    errorBox.style.animation = 'shakeIn 0.4s ease';

  function hideError() {

  var style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = '@keyframes shakeIn{0%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-6px)}40%{transform:translateX(5px)}60%{transform:translateX(-3px)}80%{transform:translateX(2px)}100%{transform:translateX(0)}}';
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  function getCookie(name) {
    var value = null;
    document.cookie.split(';').forEach(function(c) {
      c = c.trim();
      if (c.startsWith(name + '=')) {
        value = decodeURIComponent(c.slice(name.length + 1));
      }
    });
    return value;
  }

  async function doLogin() {

    var password = document.getElementById('password').value;

    if (!username) {
      showError('Ù†Ø§Ù… Ú©Ø§Ø±Ø¨Ø±ÛŒ Ø±Ø§ ÙˆØ§Ø±Ø¯ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯');

          'X-CSRFToken': getCookie('csrftoken') || ''

        body: JSON.stringify({ username: username, password: password }),

      doLogin();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      document.getElementById('username').value = '';
      document.getElementById('password').value = '';
      hideError();
      document.getElementById('username').focus();
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('username').addEventListener('input', hideError);
  document.getElementById('password').addEventListener('input', hideError);
</script>

</body>
</html>

  function initSalesChart(data) {
    var ctx = document.getElementById('salesChart');
    if (!ctx || typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;
    if (salesChartInstance) salesChartInstance.destroy();

    var isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;

            yAxisID: 'y'

  window.switchChartView = function(view, btn) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.chart-tab').forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('active'); });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    initSalesChart(_chartData[view] || _chartData.week);
  };

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
     نمودار دسته‌بندی
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  var catChartInstance = null;

  function initCatChart(labels, values) {
    var ctx = document.getElementById('catChart');
    if (!ctx || typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;
    if (catChartInstance) catChartInstance.destroy();

    var isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;

    catChartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: {
        labels: labels,
        datasets: [{
          data: values,
          backgroundColor: ['#ff6b35','#3b82f6','#10b981','#8b5cf6','#f59e0b','#ef4444','#06b6d4','#ec4899'],
          borderWidth: 0,
          hoverOffset: isMobile ? 4 : 6
        }]
      },
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        cutout: isMobile ? '55%' : '65%',
        plugins: {
          legend: {
            position: 'bottom', rtl: true,
            labels: {
              font: { family: 'Vazirmatn', size: isMobile ? 8 : 10 },
              padding: isMobile ? 6 : 10,
              usePointStyle: true,
              boxWidth: isMobile ? 6 : 10
            }
          }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
     بارگذاری داده‌ها
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  async function loadDashboard() {

    /* ── 1. گزارش روزانه ── */
    try {
      var r = await fetch(URL_REPORT + '?date=');
      var d = await r.json();
      if (d.success) {
        document.getElementById('dStatSales').textContent  = fmtN(d.total_sales) + ' \u062A';
        document.getElementById('dStatOrders').textContent = toP(d.order_count);

        if (d.weekly_sales && d.weekly_sales.length) {
          _chartData.week.sales  = d.weekly_sales;
          _chartData.week.orders = d.weekly_orders || _chartData.week.orders;
        }

        var tbody = document.getElementById('topItemsBody');
        if (d.top_items && d.top_items.length) {
          document.getElementById('topItemsBadge').textContent = toP(d.top_items.length) + ' \u0622\u06CC\u062A\u0645';
          var h = '';
          d.top_items.forEach(function(it, i) {
            var rc = i === 0 ? 'rank-1' : i === 1 ? 'rank-2' : i === 2 ? 'rank-3' : 'rank-n';
            h += '<tr>';
            h += '<td><span class="rank-badge ' + rc + '">' + toP(i + 1) + '</span></td>';
            h += '<td style="font-weight:600">' + esc(it.name) + '</td>';
            h += '<td>' + toP(it.qty) + '</td>';
            h += '<td>' + fmtN(it.total) + ' \u062A</td>';
            h += '</tr>';
          });
          tbody.innerHTML = h;
        } else {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:28px">' +
            '<i class="bi bi-inbox" style="font-size:20px;display:block;margin-bottom:6px"></i>' +
            '\u0647\u0646\u0648\u0632 \u0633\u0641\u0627\u0631\u0634\u06CC \u062B\u0628\u062A \u0646\u0634\u062F\u0647</td></tr>';
        }
      }
    } catch(e) {
      console.warn('Error loading report:', e);
    }

    /* ── 2. نمودار فروش ── */
    initSalesChart(_chartData.week);

    /* ── 3. نمودار دسته‌بندی ── */
    try {
      var rc = await fetch(URL_REPORT + '?date=&categories=1');
      var cd = await rc.json();
      if (cd.success && cd.category_sales && cd.category_sales.length) {
        var cLabels = [], cValues = [];
        cd.category_sales.forEach(function(c) { cLabels.push(c.name); cValues.push(c.total); });
        initCatChart(cLabels, cValues);
      } else {
        initCatChart(['\u063A\u0630\u0627\u06CC \u0627\u0635\u0644\u06CC','\u067E\u06CC\u0634\u200C\u063A\u0630\u0627','\u0646\u0648\u0634\u06CC\u062F\u0646\u06CC','\u062F\u0633\u0631','\u0633\u0627\u0644\u0627\u062F'], [35, 20, 18, 15, 12]);
      }
    } catch(e) {
      initCatChart(['\u063A\u0630\u0627\u06CC \u0627\u0635\u0644\u06CC','\u067E\u06CC\u0634\u200C\u063A\u0630\u0627','\u0646\u0648\u0634\u06CC\u062F\u0646\u06CC','\u062F\u0633\u0631','\u0633\u0627\u0644\u0627\u062F'], [35, 20, 18, 15, 12]);
    }

    /* ── 4. مشتریان باشگاه ── */
    try {
      var r2 = await fetch(URL_LOYALTY);
      var d2 = await r2.json();
      document.getElementById('dStatCustomers').textContent =
        d2.total_customers != null ? toP(d2.total_customers) : '\u2014';
    } catch(e) {
      document.getElementById('dStatCustomers').textContent = '\u2014';
    }

    /* ── 5. اقلام موجود ── */
    try {
      var r3 = await fetch(URL_CLOSE);
      var d3 = await r3.json();
      if (d3.kitchen_items) document.getElementById('dStatStock').textContent = toP(d3.kitchen_items.length);
    } catch(e) {}

    /* ── 6. آخرین فعالیت‌ها ── */
    var activities = [];
    try {
      var r4 = await fetch(URL_ORDERS + '?limit=5&t=' + Date.now());
      var d4 = await r4.json();
      var orders = d4.results || d4 || [];
      if (Array.isArray(orders) && orders.length) {
        orders.slice(0, 5).forEach(function(o) {
          var statusMap = {
            pending:   { text: '\u0633\u0641\u0627\u0631\u0634 \u062C\u062F\u06CC\u062F \u062F\u0631 \u0627\u0646\u062A\u0638\u0627\u0631', dot: 'orange' },
            preparing: { text: '\u062F\u0631 \u062D\u0627\u0644 \u0622\u0645\u0627\u062F\u0647\u200C\u0633\u0627\u0632\u06CC',     dot: 'blue' },
            ready:     { text: '\u0622\u0645\u0627\u062F\u0647 \u062A\u062D\u0648\u06CC\u0644',            dot: 'green' },
            delivered: { text: '\u062A\u062D\u0648\u06CC\u0644 \u0634\u062F\u0647',              dot: 'green' },
            cancelled: { text: '\u0644\u063A\u0648 \u0634\u062F\u0647',                dot: 'orange' }
          };
          var s = statusMap[o.status] || { text: o.status, dot: 'blue' };
          activities.push({ dot: s.dot, text: '\u0633\u0641\u0627\u0631\u0634 #' + toP(o.id) + ' \u2014 ' + s.text, time: o.time || o.created_at || '' });
        });
      }
    } catch(e) {}

    activities.push({ dot: 'green', text: '\u0633\u06CC\u0633\u062A\u0645 \u0622\u0645\u0627\u062F\u0647 \u0628\u0647 \u06A9\u0627\u0631 \u0627\u0633\u062A', time: '\u0627\u06A9\u0646\u0648\u0646' });

    var actBox = document.getElementById('activityList');
    if (activities.length) {
      var ah = '';
      activities.forEach(function(a) {
        ah += '<div class="activity-item">';
        ah += '<div class="activity-dot ' + a.dot + '"></div>';
        ah += '<div class="activity-text">' + esc(a.text) + '</div>';
        ah += '<div class="activity-time">' + esc(a.time) + '</div>';
        ah += '</div>';
      });
      actBox.innerHTML = ah;
    } else {
      actBox.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:28px">' +
        '<i class="bi bi-inbox" style="font-size:20px;display:block;margin-bottom:6px"></i>' +
        '\u0641\u0639\u0627\u0644\u06CC\u062A\u06CC \u062B\u0628\u062A \u0646\u0634\u062F\u0647</div>';
    }
  }

  /* ═══ اجرا ═══ */
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadDashboard);
  } else {
    loadDashboard();
  }

})();
</script>
{% endblock %}

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
     ★ یک اسکریپت واحد — همه چیز اینجاست
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════
     ۱. ثابت‌ها و ابزارهای پایه
     ══════════════════════════════════════ */

  var HEARTBEAT_MS = 3000;
  var LOCK_TTL     = 8000;
  var LOCK_KEY     = 'db_lock';
  var AUTH_KEY     = 'db_auth';
  var TAB_ID_KEY   = 'db_tid';

  // فارسی‌ساز اعداد
  var pD = '\u06F0\u06F1\u06F2\u06F3\u06F4\u06F5\u06F6\u06F7\u06F8\u06F9';
  window.toP = function(n) { return String(n).replace(/\d/g, function(c){ return pD[c]; }); };
  window.fmtN = function(v) { var n = parseInt(v); return toP((isNaN(n) ? 0 : n).toLocaleString('en')); };

  // CSRF
  window.getCsrf = function() {
    var meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');
    if (meta) return meta.content;
    var m = document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/);
    return m ? m[1] : '';
  };

  // Restaurant ID
  (function() {
    var rid = null;
    var bodyAttr = document.body.getAttribute('data-restaurant-id');
    if (bodyAttr && bodyAttr !== '' && bodyAttr !== 'None' && bodyAttr !== 'null') rid = parseInt(bodyAttr);
    if (!rid) { var h = document.querySelector('input[name="restaurant_id"], input#restaurantId'); if (h && h.value) rid = parseInt(h.value); }
    if (!rid) { var meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="restaurant-id"]'); if (meta && meta.content) rid = parseInt(meta.content); }
    window.RESTAURANT_ID = rid || null;
  })();

  // Tab ID
  var myTab = sessionStorage.getItem(TAB_ID_KEY);
  if (!myTab) {
    myTab = 't_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 8);
    sessionStorage.setItem(TAB_ID_KEY, myTab);
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════
     ۲. بررسی احراز هویت
     ══════════════════════════════════════ */

  if (!localStorage.getItem(AUTH_KEY) || !localStorage.getItem('access_token')) {
    localStorage.removeItem('access_token');
    localStorage.removeItem('refresh_token');
    localStorage.removeItem('user');
    localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_KEY);
    localStorage.removeItem(LOCK_KEY);
    sessionStorage.clear();
    window.location.href = '/dashboard/?logout=1';
    return;
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════
     ۳. قفل تک‌تبی
     ══════════════════════════════════════ */

  function lockData() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LOCK_KEY)); } catch(e) { return null; }
  }
  function setLock() {
    localStorage.setItem(LOCK_KEY, JSON.stringify({ tid: myTab, ts: Date.now() }));
  }
  function lockFresh(l) { return l && l.ts && (Date.now() - l.ts) < LOCK_TTL; }
  function myLock(l) { return l && l.tid === myTab; }

  window.DictionaryAC = {
    attach: function(nameSelector, unitSelector, category) {
      var nameInput = typeof nameSelector === 'string' ? document.querySelector(nameSelector) : nameSelector;
      var unitInput = typeof unitSelector === 'string' ? document.querySelector(unitSelector) : unitSelector;
      if (!nameInput) return;

      var wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.className = 'ac-wrap';
      wrap.style.position = 'relative';
      nameInput.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, nameInput);
      wrap.appendChild(nameInput);

      var dropdown = document.createElement('div');
      dropdown.className = 'ac-dropdown';
      wrap.appendChild(dropdown);

      var timer = null;

      nameInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
        var q = nameInput.value.trim();
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (q.length < 1) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }
        timer = setTimeout(function() {
          fetch('/api/dictionary/autocomplete/?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q) + '&category=' + encodeURIComponent(category), {
            headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': getCsrf() }
          }).then(function(r) {
            if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
            return r.json();
          }).then(function(res) {
            var items = res.items || [];
            if (items.length === 0) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }
            var html = '';
            items.forEach(function(item) {
              html += '<div class="ac-item" data-name="' + escA(item.name) + '" data-unit="' + escA(String(item.unit)) + '">'
                + '<span class="ac-item-name">' + escA(item.name) + '</span>'
                + '<span class="ac-item-unit">' + escA(item.unit_display) + '</span>'
                + (item.description ? '<span class="ac-item-desc">' + escA(item.description) + '</span>' : '')
                + '</div>';
            });
            dropdown.innerHTML = html;
            dropdown.classList.add('show');
            dropdown.querySelectorAll('.ac-item').forEach(function(el) {
              el.addEventListener('click', function() {
                nameInput.value = el.dataset.name;
                if (unitInput) {
                  unitInput.value = el.dataset.unit;
                  unitInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
                }
                dropdown.classList.remove('show');
                nameInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
              });
            });
          }).catch(function(err) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            console.error('Autocomplete error:', err);
          });
        }, 250);
      });

      document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!wrap.contains(e.target)) dropdown.classList.remove('show');
      });

      nameInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (!dropdown.classList.contains('show')) return;
        var items = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.ac-item');
        var active = dropdown.querySelector('.ac-item.active');

        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
          e.preventDefault();
          items.forEach(function(i){ i.classList.remove('active'); });
          if (!active) { items[0] && items[0].classList.add('active'); }
          else { (active.nextElementSibling || items[0]).classList.add('active'); }
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
          e.preventDefault();
          items.forEach(function(i){ i.classList.remove('active'); });
          if (!active) { items[items.length - 1] && items[items.length - 1].classList.add('active'); }
          else { (active.previousElementSibling || items[items.length - 1]).classList.add('active'); }
        } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && active) {
          e.preventDefault();
          active.click();
        }
      });
    }
  };

})();

<script>
  const API_BASE = '/api/loyalty/notifications';
  const TYPE_LABELS = {
    'welcome': 'Ø®ÙˆØ´â€ŒØ¢Ù…Ø¯Ú¯ÙˆÛŒÛŒ',
    'level_up': 'Ø§Ø±ØªÙ‚Ø§ Ø³Ø·Ø­',
    'birthday': 'ØªÙˆÙ„Ø¯',
    'coupon': 'Ú©ÙˆÙ¾Ù†',
    'points': 'Ø§Ù…ØªÛŒØ§Ø²',
    'wallet': 'Ú©ÛŒÙ Ù¾ÙˆÙ„',
    'reward': 'Ø¬ÙˆØ§ÛŒØ²',
    'referral': 'Ø¯Ø¹ÙˆØª',
  };
  const TYPE_ICONS = {
    'welcome': '&#128075;',
    'level_up': '&#127942;',
    'birthday': '&#127874;',
    'coupon': '&#127915;',
    'points': '&#11088;',
    'wallet': '&#128176;',
    'reward': '&#127873;',
    'referral': '&#128101;',
  };

  let allNotifications = [];

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadNotifications);

  async function loadNotifications() {
    const container = document.getElementById('notifications-list');
    const loading = document.getElementById('loading');
    const empty = document.getElementById('empty-state');

    container.innerHTML = '';
    loading.style.display = 'block';
    empty.style.display = 'none';

    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    const readFilter = document.getElementById('filter-read').value;
    const typeFilter = document.getElementById('filter-type').value;
    const phoneFilter = document.getElementById('filter-phone').value.trim();

    if (readFilter !== '') params.append('read', readFilter);
    if (typeFilter) params.append('type', typeFilter);
    if (phoneFilter) params.append('phone', phoneFilter);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(API_BASE + '/?' + params.toString());
      const data = await res.json();

      loading.style.display = 'none';

      let notifications = [];
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        notifications = data;
      } else if (data.results) {
        notifications = data.results;
      }

      allNotifications = notifications;
      updateStats(notifications);

      if (notifications.length === 0) {
        empty.style.display = 'block';
        return;
      }

      renderNotifications(notifications);

    } catch (err) {
      loading.style.display = 'none';
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="empty-state">
          <div class="empty-icon">&#9888;</div>
          <h3>Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø¨Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ</h3>
          <p>${err.message}</p>
        </div>`;
    }
  }

  function updateStats(notifications) {
    const total = notifications.length;
    const unread = notifications.filter(n => !n.is_read).length;
    const read = total - unread;

    document.getElementById('stat-total').textContent = total;
    document.getElementById('stat-unread').textContent = unread;
    document.getElementById('stat-read').textContent = read;
    document.getElementById('count-badge').textContent = total;
  }

  function renderNotifications(notifications) {
    const container = document.getElementById('notifications-list');

    container.innerHTML = notifications.map(n => {
      const isUnread = !n.is_read;
      const ntype = n.notification_type || 'default';
      const icon = TYPE_ICONS[ntype] || '&#128276;';
      const typeLabel = TYPE_LABELS[ntype] || ntype;
      const channelLabel = n.channel_display || n.channel || 'Ø¯Ø±ÙˆÙ†â€ŒØ¨Ø±Ù†Ø§Ù…Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ';
      const channelClass = 'channel-' + (n.channel || 'inapp');

      return `
        <div class="notif-item ${isUnread ? 'unread' : ''}"
             onclick="markRead(${n.id}, this)" data-id="${n.id}">
          <div class="notif-dot"></div>
          <div class="notif-ico ico-${ntype}">${icon}</div>
          <div class="notif-body">
            <div class="notif-title">${escapeHtml(n.title || 'Ø§Ø¹Ù„Ø§Ù†')}</div>
            <div class="notif-msg">${escapeHtml(n.message || '')}</div>
            <div class="notif-meta">
              <span class="notif-tag tag-${ntype}">${typeLabel}</span>
              <span class="notif-tag ${channelClass}">${channelLabel}</span>
              ${n.customer_phone ? '<span class="notif-tag tag-default">&#128241; ' + escapeHtml(n.customer_phone) + '</span>' : ''}
              <span class="notif-time">${formatDate(n.created_at)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  async function markRead(id, element) {
    if (!element.classList.contains('unread')) return;

    try {
      await fetch(API_BASE + '/mark-read/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'X-CSRFToken': getCookie('csrftoken'),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          notification_ids: [id],
          mark_all: false,
        }),
      });

      element.classList.remove('unread');
      updateStatsFromDOM();

    } catch (err) {
      console.error('mark read error:', err);
    }
  }

  async function markAllRead() {
    const phone = document.getElementById('filter-phone').value.trim();

    try {
      const body = { mark_all: true };
      if (phone) body.phone = phone;

      await fetch(API_BASE + '/mark-read/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'X-CSRFToken': getCookie('csrftoken'),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });

      loadNotifications();

    } catch (err) {
      alert('Ø®Ø·Ø§: ' + err.message);
    }
  }

  function updateStatsFromDOM() {
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.notif-item');
    const total = items.length;
    const unread = document.querySelectorAll('.notif-item.unread').length;
    const read = total - unread;

    document.getElementById('stat-unread').textContent = unread;
    document.getElementById('stat-read').textContent = read;
  }

  function clearFilters() {
    document.getElementById('filter-read').value = 'false';
    document.getElementById('filter-type').value = '';
    document.getElementById('filter-phone').value = '';
    loadNotifications();
  }

  function escapeHtml(text) {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.textContent = text;
    return div.innerHTML;
  }

  function formatDate(dateStr) {
    if (!dateStr) return 'â€”';
    try {
      const d = new Date(dateStr);
      const now = new Date();
      const diff = Math.floor((now - d) / 1000);

      if (diff < 60) return 'Ù„Ø­Ø¸Ø§ØªÛŒ Ù¾ÛŒØ´';
      if (diff < 3600) return Math.floor(diff / 60) + ' Ø¯Ù‚ÛŒÙ‚Ù‡ Ù¾ÛŒØ´';
      if (diff < 86400) return Math.floor(diff / 3600) + ' Ø³Ø§Ø¹Øª Ù¾ÛŒØ´';
      if (diff < 604800) return Math.floor(diff / 86400) + ' Ø±ÙˆØ² Ù¾ÛŒØ´';

      return d.toLocaleDateString('fa-IR');
    } catch {
      return dateStr;
    }
  }

  function getCookie(name) {
    const cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
    for (let c of cookies) {
      c = c.trim();
      if (c.startsWith(name + '=')) {
        return decodeURIComponent(c.substring(name.length + 1));
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
    var couponStatus = '';
    var couponTimer = null;

    async function loadCoupons() {
        var url = '/api/loyalty/coupons/?format=json';
        if (couponStatus === 'active') url += '&active=true';
        if (couponStatus === 'inactive') url += '&active=false';
        var search = document.getElementById('couponSearch').value.trim();
        if (search) url += '&search=' + encodeURIComponent(search);

        try {
            var d = await apiCall(url);
            var coupons = d.results || d;
            renderCoupons(coupons);
        } catch (e) {
            showToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø¨Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ Ú©ÙˆÙ¾Ù†â€ŒÙ‡Ø§', 'error');
        }
    }

    function renderCoupons(coupons) {
        var tbody = document.getElementById('couponTable');
        var active = 0, expired = 0;
        coupons.forEach(function(c) { c.is_active ? active++ : expired++; });

        document.getElementById('totalCoupons').textContent = formatNumber(coupons.length);
        document.getElementById('activeCoupons').textContent = formatNumber(active);
        document.getElementById('expiredCoupons').textContent = formatNumber(expired);

        if (!coupons.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9"><div class="empty-state"><div class="icon">&#9733;</div><h3>Ú©ÙˆÙ¾Ù†ÛŒ ÛŒØ§ÙØª Ù†Ø´Ø¯</h3></div></td></tr>';
            return;
        }

        var typeLabels = {
            general: 'Ø¹Ù…ÙˆÙ…ÛŒ', first_order: 'Ø§ÙˆÙ„ÛŒÙ† Ø³ÙØ§Ø±Ø´', birthday: 'ØªÙˆÙ„Ø¯',
            vip: 'VIP', referral: 'Ø¯Ø¹ÙˆØª', seasonal: 'Ù…Ù†Ø§Ø³Ø¨ØªÛŒ'
        };

        var html = '';
        for (var i = 0; i < coupons.length; i++) {
            var c = coupons[i];
            var fromDate = new Date(c.valid_from).toLocaleDateString('fa-IR');
            var untilDate = new Date(c.valid_until).toLocaleDateString('fa-IR');
            var validBadge = c.is_valid_now
                ? '<span class="badge badge-green">&#10004; Ù…Ø¹ØªØ¨Ø±</span>'
                : '<span class="badge badge-red">&#10008; Ù…Ù†Ù‚Ø¶ÛŒ</span>';
            var toggleIcon = c.is_active ? '&#128683;' : '&#9989;';
            var minOrder = c.min_order_amount > 0 ? formatNumber(c.min_order_amount) + ' Øª' : 'â€”';

            html += '<tr>';
            html += '<td><code style="background:var(--gold-bg);color:var(--gold);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;">' + c.code + '</code></td>';
            html += '<td><strong>' + c.name + '</strong></td>';
            html += '<td><span class="badge badge-blue">' + (typeLabels[c.coupon_type] || c.coupon_type) + '</span></td>';
            html += '<td style="font-weight:600;">' + c.discount_label + '</td>';
            html += '<td>' + minOrder + '</td>';
            html += '<td>' + c.used_count + ' / ' + c.max_uses + '</td>';
            html += '<td style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);">' + fromDate + '<br>ØªØ§ ' + untilDate + '</td>';
            html += '<td>' + validBadge + '</td>';
            html += '<td><button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="toggleCoupon(' + c.id + ')" title="ØªØºÛŒÛŒØ± ÙˆØ¶Ø¹ÛŒØª">' + toggleIcon + '</button></td>';
            html += '</tr>';
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = html;
    }

    async function toggleCoupon(id) {
        try {
            var r = await apiCall('/api/loyalty/coupons/' + id + '/toggle-active/', 'POST');
            showToast(r.is_active ? 'Ú©ÙˆÙ¾Ù† ÙØ¹Ø§Ù„ Ø´Ø¯' : 'Ú©ÙˆÙ¾Ù† ØºÛŒØ±ÙØ¹Ø§Ù„ Ø´Ø¯', 'success');
            loadCoupons();
        } catch (e) {
            showToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± ØªØºÛŒÛŒØ± ÙˆØ¶Ø¹ÛŒØª', 'error');
        }
    }

    document.getElementById('couponSearch').addEventListener('input', function() {
        clearTimeout(couponTimer);
        couponTimer = setTimeout(loadCoupons, 400);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach(function(chip) {
        chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove('active'); });
            chip.classList.add('active');
            couponStatus = chip.dataset.status;
            loadCoupons();
        });
    });

    loadCoupons();
</script>
{% endblock %}

function searchMat(q){
    q=(q||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    var all=dictItems;
    if(!q)return all.slice();
    var s=[],c=[];
    for(var i=0;i<all.length;i++){
        var nl=all[i].name.toLowerCase();
        if(nl.indexOf(q)!==-1)(nl.indexOf(q)===0?s:c).push(all[i]);
    }
    return s.concat(c);
}

function loadDict() {
    var container = $('dict-sections-container');
    if (container) container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:32px;color:var(--text-sec)"><p>Ø¯Ø± Ø­Ø§Ù„ Ø¨Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ...</p></div>';

    fetch('/api/dictionary/raw-materials/', { headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': gc('csrftoken') } })
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (data) {

        /* â˜… Ø±ÛŒØ³Øª Ú©Ø§Ù…Ù„ â€” Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ Ú†ÛŒØ² Ø§Ø² API Ø³Ø§Ø®ØªÙ‡ Ù…ÛŒØ´Ù‡ */

        SECTIONS_ORDER = [];
        SECTION_CATS = {};

        /* â˜… Ø³Ø§Ø®Øª Ø¨Ø®Ø´â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ Ø§Ø² tabs */
        if (data.tabs && data.tabs.length) {
            data.tabs.forEach(function (t) {
                var slug = t.slug;
                if (!slug) return;
                SECTIONS_ORDER.push(slug);
                SECTIONS_META[slug] = {
                    label: t.name || slug,
                    icon: resolveIcon(t.icon),       /* â˜… resolveIcon */
                    color: t.color || FALLBACK_META.color,
                    searchPlaceholder: 'Ø¬Ø³ØªØ¬ÙˆÛŒ ' + (t.name || slug) + '...'
                };
            });
        }

        /* â˜… ØªÙˆØ²ÛŒØ¹ Ø¢ÛŒØªÙ…â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ Ø¨Ø± Ø§Ø³Ø§Ø³ group_slug */

        dictItems = [];

            var item = {
                id:            it.id,
                name:          it.name,
                unit:          it.unit || 'unit',
                dict_category: it.dict_category || '',
                description:   it.description || '',
                tab:           it[TAB_FIELD] || 'other'
            };
            dictItems.push(item);

            if (!dictSections[item.tab]) {
                dictSections[item.tab] = { items: [], activeCat: 'all', query: '' };
            }
            dictSections[item.tab].items.push(item);

            /* â˜… Ø¬Ù…Ø¹â€ŒØ¢ÙˆØ±ÛŒ Ø®ÙˆØ¯Ú©Ø§Ø± Ø¯Ø³ØªÙ‡â€ŒØ¨Ù†Ø¯ÛŒâ€ŒÙ‡Ø§ */

                var exists = false;
                for (var ci = 0; ci < SECTION_CATS[item.tab].length; ci++) {
                    if (SECTION_CATS[item.tab][ci].value === item.dict_category) { exists = true; break; }
                }
                if (!exists) {
                    SECTION_CATS[item.tab].push({ value: item.dict_category, label: gcl(item.dict_category) });
                }
            }
        });

            if (SECTIONS_ORDER.indexOf(key) === -1) SECTIONS_ORDER.push(key);
            if (!SECTIONS_META[key]) {
                /* fallback Ø§Ø² Ø§ÙˆÙ„ÛŒÙ† Ø¢ÛŒØªÙ… Ø¨Ø®Ø´ */

                    label: key,
                    icon: resolveIcon(first._group_icon),
                    color: first._group_color || FALLBACK_META.color,
                    searchPlaceholder: 'Ø¬Ø³ØªØ¬Ùˆ...'
                };
            }
        });

        renderAllSections();
    })
    .catch(function (err) {

        if (container) container.innerHTML = '<div class="dict-empty"><p>Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø¨Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ Ø¯ÛŒÚ©Ø´Ù†Ø±ÛŒ</p></div>';
        toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø¨Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ Ø¯ÛŒÚ©Ø´Ù†Ø±ÛŒ', 'error');
    });
}

/* â”€â”€ Ø±Ù†Ø¯Ø± Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ Ø¨Ø®Ø´â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ â”€â”€ */
function renderAllSections() {
    var container = $('dict-sections-container');
    if (!container) return;
    container.innerHTML = '';

    var totalCount = 0;
    var isFirst = true;

    SECTIONS_ORDER.forEach(function (tabId) {
        var sec = dictSections[tabId];
        if (!sec || !sec.items.length) return;
        totalCount += sec.items.length;
        container.appendChild(buildSectionDOM(tabId, sec, isFirst));
        isFirst = false;
    });

    Object.keys(dictSections).forEach(function (tabId) {
        if (SECTIONS_ORDER.indexOf(tabId) !== -1) return;
        var sec = dictSections[tabId];
        if (!sec || !sec.items.length) return;
        totalCount += sec.items.length;
        container.appendChild(buildSectionDOM(tabId, sec, isFirst));
        isFirst = false;
    });

    var countEl = $('dict-count');
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = pn(totalCount);
}

function buildSectionDOM(tabId, sec, isFirst) {
    var meta = SECTIONS_META[tabId] || FALLBACK_META;
    var color = meta.color || FALLBACK_META.color;
    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'dict-section-block';
    div.dataset.section = tabId;

    var filtered = getFilteredItems(tabId);

    var html = '';

    if (isFirst) {
        html += '<div class="dict-section-head" style="color:' + color + '">'
            + (meta.icon || '')
            + '<span class="dsh-label">' + esc(meta.label) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="dsh-count" style="background:' + color + '15;color:' + color + '">'
            + pn(sec.items.length) + ' Ù‚Ù„Ù…</span></div>';
    } else {
        html += '<div class="dict-section-divider" style="color:' + color + '">'
            + (meta.icon || '') + ' ' + esc(meta.label) + '</div>';
    }

    html += '<div class="dict-search-bar"><input type="text" class="dict-search-input" data-section="' + tabId + '" placeholder="' + esc(meta.searchPlaceholder || 'Ø¬Ø³ØªØ¬Ùˆ...') + '" value="' + esc(sec.query) + '"></div>';

    html += '<div class="dict-grid">' + _gridHTML(filtered) + '</div>';

    div.innerHTML = html;

    var searchInput = div.querySelector('.dict-search-input');
    if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
            dictSections[tabId].query = this.value;
            _refreshGrid(tabId);
        });
    }

    _bindCards(div, tabId);

    return div;
}

/* â”€â”€ ØªÙˆØ§Ø¨Ø¹ Ú©Ù…Ú©ÛŒ Ø¨Ø®Ø´â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ â”€â”€ */
function getCatsForSection(tabId) {
    if (SECTION_CATS[tabId] && SECTION_CATS[tabId].length) return SECTION_CATS[tabId];
    var sec = dictSections[tabId];
    if (!sec) return [];
    var map = {};
    sec.items.forEach(function (it) { if (it.dict_category) map[it.dict_category] = true; });
    return Object.keys(map).map(function (k) { return { value: k, label: gcl(k) }; });
}

function getFilteredItems(tabId) {
    var sec = dictSections[tabId];
    if (!sec) return [];
    var items = sec.items;
    if (sec.activeCat !== 'all') items = items.filter(function (m) { return m.dict_category === sec.activeCat; });
    if (sec.query) { var q = sec.query.toLowerCase(); items = items.filter(function (m) { return m.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; }); }
    return items;
}

function _catPill(val, label, count, active, color) {
    var style = active && color ? ' style="background:' + color + ';border-color:' + color + '"' : '';
    return '<button type="button" class="dict-cat-pill' + (active ? ' active' : '') + '" data-cat="' + val + '"' + style + '>'
        + esc(label) + ' <span class="pill-count">' + count + '</span></button>';
}

    items.forEach(function (it) {
        var c = CAT_COLORS[it.dict_category] || '#78716c';
        h += '<div class="dict-card" data-id="' + it.id + '">'
            + '<div class="dc-name">' + esc(it.name) + '</div>'
            + '<div class="dc-meta"><span class="dc-cat-dot" style="background:' + c + '"></span>'
            + '<span class="dc-cat-label">' + esc(gcl(it.dict_category)) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="dc-unit-badge">' + esc(gul(it.unit)) + '</span></div>'
            + (it.description ? '<div class="dc-desc">' + esc(it.description) + '</div>' : '')
            + '</div>';
    });
    return h;
}

function _refreshGrid(tabId) {
    var block = document.querySelector('.dict-section-block[data-section="' + tabId + '"]');
    if (!block) return;
    var grid = block.querySelector('.dict-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = _gridHTML(getFilteredItems(tabId));
    _bindCards(block, tabId);
}

function _refreshCatsAndGrid(tabId) {
    var block = document.querySelector('.dict-section-block[data-section="' + tabId + '"]');
    if (!block) return;
    var sec = dictSections[tabId];
    var meta = SECTIONS_META[tabId] || FALLBACK_META;
    var color = meta.color || FALLBACK_META.color;

    block.querySelectorAll('.dict-cat-pill').forEach(function (pill) {
        var isActive = pill.dataset.cat === sec.activeCat;
        pill.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
        if (isActive && sec.activeCat !== 'all') {
            var cc = CAT_COLORS[sec.activeCat] || color;
            pill.style.background = cc;
            pill.style.borderColor = cc;
        } else {
            pill.style.background = '';
            pill.style.borderColor = '';
        }
    });
    _refreshGrid(tabId);
}

function _bindCards(container, tabId) {
    if (!container) return;
    container.querySelectorAll('.dict-card').forEach(function (card) {
        card.onclick = function () {
            var id = this.dataset.id;
            var sec = dictSections[tabId];
            if (!sec) return;
            var m = sec.items.find(function (x) { return String(x.id) === String(id); });
            if (!m) return;
            addRow({ item_name: m.name, unit: m.unit, dict_category: m.dict_category, quantity: '', unit_price: '', id: m.id });
            toast('Â«' + m.name + 'Â» Ø§Ø¶Ø§ÙÙ‡ Ø´Ø¯ â€” Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯ Ø±Ø§ ÙˆØ§Ø±Ø¯ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯.');
            this.classList.add('dc-added');
            var self = this;
            setTimeout(function () { self.classList.remove('dc-added'); }, 800);
            if (tableWrap) setTimeout(function () { tableWrap.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' }); }, 100);
        };
    });
}

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
var PageDict = (function() {
  /* ═══ URLها ═══ */
  var URL_GRP_LIST    = '/api/dictionary/groups/';
  var URL_GRP_SAVE    = '/api/dictionary/groups/save/';
  var URL_GRP_DELETE  = '/api/dictionary/groups/delete/';
  var URL_DICT_LIST   = '/api/dictionary/list/';
  var URL_DICT_CREATE = '/api/dictionary/create/';
  var URL_FOOD_LIST   = '/api/dictionary/food-menu/';

  /* ═══ تب‌های پیش‌فرض (همیشه نمایش داده میشن) ═══ */
  var PRESETS = [
    { slug: '__raw_material__',   name: 'مواد اولیه',  icon: 'bi-box2',      color: '#10b981', cat: 'raw_material' },
    { slug: '__ready_material__', name: 'مواد آماده',  icon: 'bi-box-seam',  color: '#f59e0b', cat: 'ready_material' },
    { slug: '__food_menu__',      name: 'غذا و منو',   icon: 'bi-egg-fried', color: '#3b82f6', cat: 'food' },
  ];

  /* ═══ State ═══ */
  var allGroups = [], currentSlug = null, allItems = {};
  var editingId = null, editingGroupId = null;
  var _editingPresetSlug = null; /* ★ تشخیص ویرایش تب پیش‌فرض */
  var searchQuery = '', dictFilterCat = 'all', selectedDictCat = '';
  var DICT_CATS = {}, _dictCatEditing = null;

  /* ═══ Refs ═══ */
  var $ = function(id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var statsWrap = $('dictStatsWrap'), groupPanel = $('groupFormPanel');
  var grpNameEl = $('grpName'), grpIconEl = $('grpIcon'), grpIconPrev = $('grpIconPreview'), grpIconLbl = $('grpIconLabel');
  var grpColorEl = $('grpColor'), grpSaveBtn = $('grpSaveBtn'), grpIconGrid = $('grpIconGrid'), grpIconPopup = $('grpIconPopup');
  var grpURecipes = $('grpURecipes'), grpUWarehouse = $('grpUWarehouse'), grpUInvoice = $('grpUInvoice'), grpUKitchen = $('grpUKitchen'), grpUPOS = $('grpUPOS');
  var nameEl = $('pdName'), unitEl = $('pdUnit'), descEl = $('pdDesc'), addBtn = $('pdAddBtn'), cancelBtn = $('pdCancelBtn');
  var tableBody = $('pdTableBody'), pdEmpty = $('pdEmpty'), searchEl = $('pageDictSearch');
  var catTitle = $('catTitle'), catDot = $('catDot'), toastEl = $('dictToast');
  var groupActDiv = $('groupActions');
  var customUnitEl = $('pdCustomUnit'), customUnitWrap = $('pdCustomUnitWrap');

  /* ═══ Constants ═══ */
  var ICONS = ['bi-archive','bi-layers','bi-box2','bi-box-seam','bi-egg-fried','bi-cup-straw','bi-cup-hot','bi-droplet','bi-water','bi-snow','bi-fire','bi-lightning','bi-leaf','bi-flower1','bi-tree','bi-palette','bi-brush','bi-gear','bi-tools','bi-hammer','bi-truck','bi-cart','bi-shop','bi-bag','bi-tag','bi-meat','bi-egg','bi-apple','bi-basket','bi-floppy','bi-boxes','bi-grid','bi-grid-3x3','bi-columns-gap','bi-kanban','bi-gift','bi-star','bi-heart','bi-music-note','bi-camera'];
  var UNIT_LABELS = { kg:'کیلوگرم', g:'گرم', l:'لیتر', ml:'میلی‌لیتر', unit:'عدد', bunch:'دسته', pack:'بسته' };

  /* ═══ Helpers ═══ */
  function unitLabel(u) { return UNIT_LABELS[u] || u || '—'; }
  function csrf() { var c = document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/); return c ? c[1] : ''; }
  function api(url, method, body) {
    var opts = { method: method, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': csrf() } };
    if (body) opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    return fetch(url, opts).then(function(r) { return r.json(); });
  }
  function apiGet(url) {
    return fetch(url, { headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': csrf() } }).then(function(r) { return r.json(); });
  }
  function toast(msg, type) {
    toastEl.textContent = msg;
    toastEl.className = 'dict-toast ' + (type || '');
    toastEl.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(function() { toastEl.classList.remove('show'); }, 2500);
  }
  function esc(s) { var d = document.createElement('div'); d.textContent = s || ''; return d.innerHTML; }
  function escAttr(s) { return esc(s).replace(/'/g, "\\'"); }

  /* ★ تشخیص نوع تب */
  function getPreset(slug) {
    return PRESETS.find(function(p) { return p.slug === (slug || currentSlug); });
  }
  function isPreset() { return !!getPreset(currentSlug); }
  function isFood()  { return currentSlug === '__food_menu__'; }
  function hasUnit() { return !isFood(); } /* غذا واحد نداره، بقیه دارن */

  /* دسته‌بندی واقعی برای ذخیره در دیتابیس */
  function getDbCategory() {
    var p = getPreset(currentSlug);
    if (p) return p.cat;
    return currentSlug;
  }

  function getActiveGroup() { return allGroups.find(function(g) { return g.slug === currentSlug; }); }
  function getActiveItems() { return allItems[currentSlug] || []; }
  function onEnter(el, fn) { el.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') fn(); }); }

  function chipActions(editFn, delFn) {
    return '<span class="chip-actions">'
      + '<button class="chip-edit" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); PageDict.' + editFn + '" title="ویرایش"><i class="bi bi-pencil"></i></button>'
      + '<button class="chip-del" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); PageDict.' + delFn + '" title="حذف"><i class="bi bi-trash3"></i></button>'
      + '</span>';
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ★ تنظیمات دسترسی تب‌های پیش‌فرض (localStorage)
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  var PRESET_SETTINGS = {};

  function _defaultPresetUsage() {
    return { usage_recipes: true, usage_warehouse: true, usage_invoice: true, usage_kitchen: true, usage_pos: true };
  }

  function loadPresetSettings() {
    try {
      var saved = localStorage.getItem('kt_preset_usage_v2');
      if (saved) PRESET_SETTINGS = JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch(e) {}
    PRESETS.forEach(function(p) {
      if (!PRESET_SETTINGS[p.slug]) PRESET_SETTINGS[p.slug] = _defaultPresetUsage();
    });
  }

  function savePresetSettings() {
    try { localStorage.setItem('kt_preset_usage_v2', JSON.stringify(PRESET_SETTINGS)); } catch(e) {}
  }

  /* ★ تابع عمومی: تنظیمات دسترسی هر تبی (پیش‌فرض یا سفارشی) */
  function getUsage(slug) {
    var preset = getPreset(slug);
    if (preset) {
      return PRESET_SETTINGS[slug] || _defaultPresetUsage();
    }
    var g = allGroups.find(function(x) { return x.slug === slug; });
    if (g) {
      return {
        usage_recipes:   g.usage_recipes,
        usage_warehouse: g.usage_warehouse,
        usage_invoice:   g.usage_invoice,
        usage_kitchen:   g.usage_kitchen,
        usage_pos:       g.usage_pos,
      };
    }
    return _defaultPresetUsage();
  }

  /* ═══ زیردسته‌ها (localStorage) ═══ */
  function loadDictCats() {
    try {
      var saved = localStorage.getItem('kt_dict_cats_v8');
      if (saved) { var p = JSON.parse(saved); if (p.cats) { DICT_CATS = p.cats; return; } }
    } catch(e) {}
    DICT_CATS = {};
  }
  function saveDictCats() { try { localStorage.setItem('kt_dict_cats_v8', JSON.stringify({ cats: DICT_CATS })); } catch(e) {} }
  function getActiveCats() { return DICT_CATS[currentSlug] || {}; }
  function dictCatLabel(v) { return v ? (getActiveCats()[v] || v) : '—'; }

  /* ═══ گروه‌ها و تب‌ها ═══ */
  function loadGroups() {
    api(URL_GRP_LIST, 'GET').then(function(res) {
      allGroups = res.groups || [];
      renderStats();
      if (currentSlug) renderPanelHead();
      render();
    }).catch(function() {});
  }

  /* ★ تب‌های پیش‌فرض + سفارشی */
  function renderStats() {
    var h = '';

    /* تب‌های پیش‌فرض — همیشه اول */
    PRESETS.forEach(function(p) {
      var active = (currentSlug === p.slug) ? ' active' : '';
      var cnt = (allItems[p.slug] || []).length;
      h += '<div class="dict-stat-card' + active + '" data-slug="' + p.slug + '" onclick="PageDict.switchTab(this)"'
        + (active ? ' style="border-color:' + p.color + ';"' : '') + '>'
        + '<div class="dict-stat-icon" style="background:' + p.color + '18;color:' + p.color + ';"><i class="bi ' + p.icon + '"></i></div>'
        + '<div class="dict-stat-num" id="stat-' + p.slug + '">' + cnt + '</div>'
        + '<div class="dict-stat-label">' + p.name + '</div></div>';
    });

    /* تب‌های سفارشی */
    allGroups.forEach(function(g) {
      var active = (currentSlug === g.slug) ? ' active' : '';
      var cnt = (allItems[g.slug] || []).length;
      h += '<div class="dict-stat-card' + active + '" data-slug="' + g.slug + '" onclick="PageDict.switchTab(this)"'
        + (active ? ' style="border-color:' + g.color + ';"' : '') + '>'
        + '<div class="dict-stat-icon" style="background:' + g.color + '18;color:' + g.color + ';"><i class="bi ' + esc(g.icon) + '"></i></div>'
        + '<div class="dict-stat-num" id="stat-' + g.slug + '">' + cnt + '</div>'
        + '<div class="dict-stat-label">' + esc(g.name) + (g.is_system ? ' <span class="sys-badge">سیستمی</span>' : '') + '</div></div>';
    });

    h += '<div class="dict-stat-add" onclick="PageDict.showGroupForm()"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i><span>تب جدید</span></div>';
    statsWrap.innerHTML = h;
  }

  function switchTab(card) { selectTab(card.dataset.slug); }

  function selectTab(slug) {
    currentSlug = slug;
    cancelEdit(); cancelDictCatEdit();
    _dictCatEditing = null; editingGroupId = null; _editingPresetSlug = null;
    searchEl.value = ''; searchQuery = ''; dictFilterCat = 'all'; selectedDictCat = '';
    cancelGroupForm();
    renderStats(); renderPanelHead(); toggleFormFields();
    renderDictCatDropdown(); renderDictCatBar(); render();
  }

  function toggleFormFields() {
    $('unitFieldWrap').style.display = hasUnit() ? '' : 'none';
    $('thUnit').style.display = hasUnit() ? '' : 'none';
    if (customUnitWrap) customUnitWrap.style.display = 'none';
    nameEl.placeholder = isFood() ? 'مثال: پیتزا مارگاریتا' : 'مثال: آرد سفید';
  }

  /* ★ تب‌های پیش‌فرض: ویرایش داره (دسترسی) ولی حذف نداره */
  function renderPanelHead() {
    var preset = getPreset(currentSlug);
    if (preset) {
      catTitle.textContent = preset.name;
      catDot.style.background = preset.color;
      /* دکمه ویرایش نشون بده، حذف مخفی */
      groupActDiv.style.display = '';
      var delBtns = groupActDiv.querySelectorAll('.grp-del-btn');
      delBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.style.display = 'none'; });
      var editBtns = groupActDiv.querySelectorAll('.grp-edit-btn');
      editBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.style.display = ''; });
      return;
    }
    var g = getActiveGroup();
    if (!g) return;
    catTitle.innerHTML = esc(g.name) + (g.is_system ? ' <span class="sys-badge">سیستمی</span>' : '');
    catDot.style.background = g.color;
    groupActDiv.style.display = '';
    /* همه دکمه‌ها نمایش */
    var delBtns = groupActDiv.querySelectorAll('.grp-del-btn');
    delBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.style.display = ''; });
    var editBtns = groupActDiv.querySelectorAll('.grp-edit-btn');
    editBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.style.display = ''; });
  }

  /* ═══ فرم گروه ═══ */
  function renderIconGrid() {
    grpIconGrid.innerHTML = ICONS.map(function(icon) {
      var sel = grpIconEl.value === icon ? ' active' : '';
      return '<button type="button" class="' + sel + '" onclick="PageDict.pickIcon(\'' + icon + '\')"><i class="bi ' + icon + '"></i></button>';
    }).join('');
  }
  function toggleIconPicker() { grpIconPopup.classList.toggle('show'); }
  function pickIcon(icon) {
    grpIconEl.value = icon; grpIconPrev.className = 'bi ' + icon;
    grpIconLbl.textContent = icon; grpIconPopup.classList.remove('show'); renderIconGrid();
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var wrap = document.querySelector('.icon-picker-wrap');
    if (wrap && !wrap.contains(e.target)) grpIconPopup.classList.remove('show');
  });

  function showGroupForm(group) {
    _editingPresetSlug = null;
    editingGroupId = group ? group.id : null;
    grpNameEl.value = group ? group.name : '';
    grpIconEl.value = group ? group.icon : 'bi-archive';
    grpIconPrev.className = 'bi ' + grpIconEl.value;
    grpIconLbl.textContent = grpIconEl.value;
    grpColorEl.value = group ? group.color : '#6b7280';
    grpURecipes.checked = group ? group.usage_recipes : false;
    grpUWarehouse.checked = group ? group.usage_warehouse : false;
    grpUInvoice.checked = group ? group.usage_invoice : false;
    grpUKitchen.checked = group ? group.usage_kitchen : false;
    grpUPOS.checked = group ? group.usage_pos : false;
    $('groupFormTitle').textContent = group ? 'ویرایش تب «' + group.name + '»' : 'ساخت تب جدید';
    grpSaveBtn.innerHTML = group ? '<i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> ذخیره' : '<i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> ساخت تب';
    grpSaveBtn.classList.toggle('editing', !!group);
    groupPanel.classList.add('show'); renderIconGrid(); grpNameEl.focus();
    var sys = group && group.is_system;
    grpNameEl.disabled = sys; grpIconEl.disabled = sys; grpColorEl.disabled = sys;
  }

  /* ★ فرم دسترسی تب پیش‌فرض */
  function showPresetForm(preset) {
    _editingPresetSlug = preset.slug;
    editingGroupId = null;
    var settings = PRESET_SETTINGS[preset.slug] || _defaultPresetUsage();

    grpNameEl.value = preset.name;
    grpIconEl.value = preset.icon;
    grpIconPrev.className = 'bi ' + preset.icon;
    grpIconLbl.textContent = preset.icon;
    grpColorEl.value = preset.color;
    grpURecipes.checked   = settings.usage_recipes   !== false;
    grpUWarehouse.checked = settings.usage_warehouse !== false;
    grpUInvoice.checked   = settings.usage_invoice   !== false;
    grpUKitchen.checked   = settings.usage_kitchen   !== false;
    grpUPOS.checked       = settings.usage_pos       !== false;

    $('groupFormTitle').textContent = 'تنظیمات دسترسی «' + preset.name + '»';
    grpSaveBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> ذخیره';
    grpSaveBtn.classList.add('editing');

    groupPanel.classList.add('show'); renderIconGrid();

    /* فقط چک‌باکس‌ها قابل ویرایش */
    grpNameEl.disabled = true; grpIconEl.disabled = true; grpColorEl.disabled = true;
  }

  function cancelGroupForm() {
    editingGroupId = null; _editingPresetSlug = null;
    groupPanel.classList.remove('show');
    grpNameEl.disabled = false; grpIconEl.disabled = false; grpColorEl.disabled = false;
  }

  function saveGroup() {
    /* ★ ذخیره تنظیمات تب پیش‌فرض */
    if (_editingPresetSlug) {
      PRESET_SETTINGS[_editingPresetSlug] = {
        usage_recipes:   grpURecipes.checked,
        usage_warehouse: grpUWarehouse.checked,
        usage_invoice:   grpUInvoice.checked,
        usage_kitchen:   grpUKitchen.checked,
        usage_pos:       grpUPOS.checked,
      };
      savePresetSettings();
      var pName = getPreset(_editingPresetSlug);
      toast('دسترسی «' + (pName ? pName.name : '') + '» ذخیره شد', 'success');
      cancelGroupForm();
      return;
    }

    /* ذخیره تب سفارشی (مثل قبل) */
    var name = grpNameEl.value.trim();
    if (!name && !editingGroupId) { grpNameEl.focus(); toast('نام تب الزامی است', 'error'); return; }
    var body = {
      name: name, icon: grpIconEl.value, color: grpColorEl.value,
      usage_recipes: grpURecipes.checked, usage_warehouse: grpUWarehouse.checked,
      usage_invoice: grpUInvoice.checked, usage_kitchen: grpUKitchen.checked, usage_pos: grpUPOS.checked,
    };
    if (editingGroupId) body.id = editingGroupId;
    api(URL_GRP_SAVE, 'POST', body).then(function(res) {
      if (res.error) { toast(res.error, 'error'); return; }
      toast(res.message || 'ذخیره شد', 'success');
      cancelGroupForm(); loadGroups();
    }).catch(function() { toast('خطا در ارتباط', 'error'); });
  }

  /* ★ ویرایش — برای تب پیش‌فرض فرم دسترسی، برای سفارشی فرم عادی */
  function editCurrentGroup() {
    var preset = getPreset(currentSlug);
    if (preset) { showPresetForm(preset); return; }
    var g = getActiveGroup(); if (g) showGroupForm(g);
  }

  function deleteCurrentGroup() {
    if (isPreset()) { toast('تب پیش‌فرض قابل حذف نیست', 'error'); return; }
    var g = getActiveGroup(); if (!g) return;
    if (g.is_system) { toast('تب سیستمی قابل حذف نیست', 'error'); return; }
    var items = allItems[g.slug] || [];
    var msg = 'حذف تب «' + g.name + '»؟';
    if (items.length) msg += '\n' + items.length + ' آیتم داخلش هم حذف میشه.';
    if (!confirm(msg)) return;
    api(URL_GRP_DELETE, 'POST', { id: g.id }).then(function(res) {
      if (res.error) { toast(res.error, 'error'); return; }
      toast(res.message || 'حذف شد', 'success');
      currentSlug = null; loadGroups(); loadAll();
    }).catch(function() { toast('خطا در ارتباط', 'error'); });
  }

  /* ═══ زیردسته — dropdown ═══ */
  function renderDictCatDropdown() {
    var cats = getActiveCats(), opts = $('dictCatOpts');
    if (!opts) return;
    opts.innerHTML = Object.keys(cats).map(function(key) {
      var sel = selectedDictCat === key ? ' selected' : '';
      return '<div class="dict-cat-opt' + sel + '" data-key="' + key + '">'
        + '<span class="dict-cat-opt-name" onclick="PageDict.pickDictCat(\'' + key + '\')">' + esc(cats[key]) + '</span>'
        + '</div>';
    }).join('');
    var label = $('dictCatSelLabel');
    if (label) {
      var has = selectedDictCat && cats[selectedDictCat];
      label.textContent = has ? cats[selectedDictCat] : '— انتخاب —';
      label.style.color = has ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--muted)';
    }
  }
  function toggleDictCat() {
    var panel = $('dictCatPanel'), trigger = $('dictCatTrigger');
    if (panel.classList.contains('show')) {
      panel.classList.remove('show'); trigger.classList.remove('open');
    } else {
      renderDictCatDropdown(); panel.classList.add('show'); trigger.classList.add('open');
      var inp = $('dictCatNewInput'); if (inp) inp.value = '';
    }
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var wrap = $('dictCatWrap');
    if (wrap && !wrap.contains(e.target)) {
      $('dictCatPanel').classList.remove('show');
      $('dictCatTrigger').classList.remove('open');
    }
  });
  function pickDictCat(key) {
    selectedDictCat = key;
    $('dictCatPanel').classList.remove('show'); $('dictCatTrigger').classList.remove('open');
    renderDictCatDropdown();
  }
  function addDictCat() {
    var input = $('dictCatNewInput'), name = (input ? input.value : '').trim();
    if (!name) { if (input) input.focus(); toast('نام زیردسته را وارد کنید', 'error'); return; }
    if (!DICT_CATS[currentSlug]) DICT_CATS[currentSlug] = {};
    var cats = DICT_CATS[currentSlug];
    if (Object.keys(cats).find(function(k) { return cats[k] === name; })) { toast('«' + name + '» قبلاً ثبت شده', 'error'); return; }
    cats['cat_' + Date.now()] = name;
    saveDictCats(); if (input) input.value = '';
    renderDictCatDropdown(); renderDictCatBar(); render();
    toast('زیردسته «' + name + '» اضافه شد', 'success');
  }

  /* ═══ نوار زیردسته ═══ */
  function renderDictCatBar() {
    var bar = $('dictCatBar'); if (!bar) return;
    var cats = getActiveCats(), items = getActiveItems();
    var h = '<button class="cat-chip' + (dictFilterCat === 'all' ? ' active' : '') + '" onclick="PageDict.filterDictCat(\'all\')">همه <span class="chip-count">' + items.length + '</span></button>';
    h += Object.keys(cats).map(function(key) {
      var cnt = items.filter(function(it) { return it.dict_category === key; }).length;
      return '<div class="cat-chip' + (dictFilterCat === key ? ' active' : '') + '" onclick="PageDict.filterDictCat(\'' + key + '\')">'
        + chipActions('editDictCatBar(\'' + key + '\')', 'removeDictCatBar(\'' + key + '\')')
        + '<span>' + esc(cats[key]) + '</span><span class="chip-count">' + cnt + '</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    h += '<button class="cat-chip add-chip" onclick="PageDict.showDictCatForm()"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> زیردسته جدید</button>';
    bar.innerHTML = h;
  }
  function showDictCatForm() {
    _dictCatEditing = null;
    var el = $('dictCatLabel'); if (el) el.value = '';
    var btn = $('dictCatSaveBtn');
    if (btn) { btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> افزودن'; btn.classList.remove('editing'); }
    $('dictCatInline').classList.add('show'); if (el) el.focus();
  }
  function cancelDictCatEdit() { _dictCatEditing = null; $('dictCatInline').classList.remove('show'); }
  function editDictCatBar(key) {
    _dictCatEditing = key;
    var el = $('dictCatLabel'); if (el) el.value = getActiveCats()[key] || '';
    var btn = $('dictCatSaveBtn');
    if (btn) { btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> ذخیره'; btn.classList.add('editing'); }
    $('dictCatInline').classList.add('show'); if (el) el.focus();
  }
  function removeDictCatBar(key) {
    var label = getActiveCats()[key] || key;
    if (!confirm('حذف زیردسته «' + label + '»؟')) return;
    delete DICT_CATS[currentSlug][key];
    if (selectedDictCat === key) selectedDictCat = '';
    if (dictFilterCat === key) dictFilterCat = 'all';
    saveDictCats(); renderDictCatDropdown(); renderDictCatBar(); render();
    toast('حذف شد', 'success');
  }
  function saveDictCatFn() {
    var el = $('dictCatLabel'), label = (el ? el.value : '').trim();
    if (!label) { if (el) el.focus(); toast('نام زیردسته را وارد کنید', 'error'); return; }
    if (!DICT_CATS[currentSlug]) DICT_CATS[currentSlug] = {};
    var cats = DICT_CATS[currentSlug];
    if (Object.keys(cats).find(function(k) { return cats[k] === label && k !== _dictCatEditing; })) { toast('«' + label + '» قبلاً ثبت شده', 'error'); return; }
    if (_dictCatEditing) cats[_dictCatEditing] = label;
    else cats['cat_' + Date.now()] = label;
    saveDictCats(); cancelDictCatEdit(); renderDictCatDropdown(); renderDictCatBar(); render();
    toast(_dictCatEditing ? 'ویرایش شد' : 'اضافه شد', 'success');
  }
  function filterDictCat(key) { dictFilterCat = key; renderDictCatBar(); render(); }

  /* ═══ بارگذاری ═══ */
  function loadAll() {
    /* همه آیتم‌های دیکشنری → تفکیک بر اساس category */
    api(URL_DICT_LIST, 'GET').then(function(res) {
      var dictItems = res.items || [];
      dictItems.forEach(function(item) {
        if (!item.unit_display) item.unit_display = unitLabel(item.unit);
      });

      /* ★ تب‌های پیش‌فرض — فیلتر بر اساس category */
      allItems['__raw_material__']   = dictItems.filter(function(it) { return it.category === 'raw_material'; });
      allItems['__ready_material__'] = dictItems.filter(function(it) { return it.category === 'ready_material'; });

      /* تب‌های سفارشی */
      allGroups.forEach(function(g) {
        allItems[g.slug] = dictItems.filter(function(it) { return it.category === g.slug; });
      });

      updateStats(); render();
    }).catch(function(){});

    /* ★ آیتم‌های غذا */
    apiGet(URL_FOOD_LIST).then(function(res) {
      var items = res.items || res.results || (Array.isArray(res) ? res : []);
      allItems['__food_menu__'] = items;
      updateStats(); render();
    }).catch(function(){});
  }

  function updateStats() {
    PRESETS.forEach(function(p) {
      var el = $('stat-' + p.slug);
      if (el) el.textContent = (allItems[p.slug] || []).length;
    });
    allGroups.forEach(function(g) {
      var el = $('stat-' + g.slug);
      if (el) el.textContent = (allItems[g.slug] || []).length;
    });
  }
  function filterList() { searchQuery = searchEl.value.trim().toLowerCase(); render(); }

  /* ═══ رندر واحد ═══ */
  function render() {
    var items = getActiveItems();
    var cats = getActiveCats();
    if (dictFilterCat !== 'all') {
      items = items.filter(function(it) { return it.dict_category === dictFilterCat; });
    }
    if (searchQuery) {
      items = items.filter(function(it) {
        return (it.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(searchQuery) !== -1
          || (it.description || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(searchQuery) !== -1;
      });
    }
    if (!items.length) {
      tableBody.innerHTML = ''; pdEmpty.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
    pdEmpty.style.display = 'none';

    var g = getActiveGroup();
    var preset = getPreset(currentSlug);
    var gColor = preset ? preset.color : (g ? g.color : '#6b7280');
    var catKeys = Object.keys(cats);
    var catColors = ['#ff6b35','#8b5cf6','#10b981','#f59e0b','#3b82f6','#ec4899','#14b8a6','#6366f1','#ef4444','#84cc16','#a855f7'];

    tableBody.innerHTML = items.map(function(item, i) {
      var ed = editingId === item.id ? ' editing-row' : '';
      var id = item.id;

      /* ستون واحد — فقط غیرغذا */
      var unitCol = '';
      if (hasUnit()) {
        var uLabel = item.unit_display || unitLabel(item.unit);
        unitCol = '<td class="col-unit"><span style="background:' + gColor + '12;color:' + gColor + ';">' + esc(uLabel) + '</span></td>';
      }

      /* ستون زیردسته */
      var cLabel, catColor = '#6b7280';
      if (isFood()) {
        cLabel = item.category_name || dictCatLabel(item.dict_category);
        catColor = '#d97706';
      } else {
        cLabel = dictCatLabel(item.dict_category);
        var catIdx = catKeys.indexOf(item.dict_category || '');
        if (catIdx >= 0) catColor = catColors[catIdx % catColors.length];
      }

      /* ستون توضیحات — فقط غیرغذا */
      var descCol = '';
      if (!isFood()) {
        descCol = '<td class="col-desc">' + esc(item.description || '—') + '</td>';
      }

      return '<tr class="' + ed + '">'
        + '<td class="col-num">' + (i + 1) + '</td>'
        + '<td class="col-name">' + esc(item.name) + '</td>'
        + unitCol
        + '<td><span class="col-cat-badge" style="background:' + catColor + '15;color:' + catColor + ';">' + esc(cLabel) + '</span></td>'
        + descCol
        + '<td class="col-actions">'
        + '<button class="btn-edit" onclick="PageDict.edit(' + id + ')" title="ویرایش"><i class="bi bi-pencil"></i></button>'
        + '<button class="btn-delete" onclick="PageDict.remove(' + id + ')" title="حذف"><i class="bi bi-trash3"></i></button>'
        + '</td></tr>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* ═══ CRUD واحد ═══ */
  function save() {
    var name = nameEl.value.trim();
    var unit = hasUnit() ? unitEl.value : 'unit';
    var desc = descEl.value.trim();

    if (!name) { nameEl.focus(); toast('نام آیتم را وارد کنید', 'error'); return; }
    if (hasUnit()) {
      if (unit === 'custom') { unit = customUnitEl.value.trim(); if (!unit) { customUnitEl.focus(); toast('واحد سفارشی را وارد کنید', 'error'); return; } }
      if (!unit) { unitEl.focus(); toast('واحد را انتخاب کنید', 'error'); return; }
    }

    if (isFood()) {
      saveFoodItem(name, desc);
    } else {
      saveDictItem(name, unit, desc);
    }
  }

  /* ★ ساخت/ویرایش غذا — Food API */
  function saveFoodItem(name, desc) {
    /* ★ زیردسته انتخاب‌شده کاربر */
    var catName = '';
    if (selectedDictCat && DICT_CATS[currentSlug] && DICT_CATS[currentSlug][selectedDictCat]) {
        catName = DICT_CATS[currentSlug][selectedDictCat];
    }

    if (editingId) {
      var updateBody = { name: name };
      if (catName) updateBody.category_name = catName;
      api('/api/dictionary/food/' + editingId + '/update/', 'POST', updateBody).then(function(res) {
        if (res.error) { toast(res.error, 'error'); return; }
        var arr = allItems['__food_menu__'] || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
          if (arr[i].id === editingId) { arr[i] = Object.assign(arr[i], res); break; }
        }
        cancelEdit(); renderDictCatBar(); render(); toast('ویرایش شد', 'success');
      }).catch(function() { toast('خطا', 'error'); });
    } else {
      if (!catName) { toast('زیردسته را انتخاب کنید', 'error'); return; }
      api('/api/dictionary/food/create/', 'POST', {
        name: name, category_name: catName
      }).then(function(res) {
        if (res.error) { toast(res.error, 'error'); return; }
        if (!allItems['__food_menu__']) allItems['__food_menu__'] = [];
        allItems['__food_menu__'].push(res);
        updateStats(); renderDictCatBar(); render();
        nameEl.value = ''; descEl.value = ''; nameEl.focus();
        toast('غذا اضافه شد', 'success');
      }).catch(function() { toast('خطا در ساخت غذا', 'error'); });
    }
}

  /* ★ ساخت/ویرایش آیتم دیکشنری (مواد اولیه، آماده، سفارشی) */
  function saveDictItem(name, unit, desc) {
    var body = {
      name: name, unit: unit,
      category: getDbCategory(),
      description: desc,
      dict_category: selectedDictCat || ''
    };
    var group = getActiveGroup();
    if (group) body.group_id = group.id;

    if (editingId) {
      api('/api/dictionary/' + editingId + '/update/', 'POST', body).then(function(res) {
        if (res.error) { toast(res.error, 'error'); return; }
        var arr = allItems[currentSlug] || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
          if (arr[i].id === editingId) {
            arr[i] = Object.assign(arr[i], res);
            arr[i].unit_display = unitLabel(unit); break;
          }
        }
        cancelEdit(); renderDictCatBar(); render(); toast('ویرایش شد', 'success');
      }).catch(function() { toast('خطا', 'error'); });
    } else {
      api(URL_DICT_CREATE, 'POST', body).then(function(res) {
        if (res.error) { toast(res.error, 'error'); return; }
        if (!res.unit_display) res.unit_display = unitLabel(unit);
        if (!allItems[currentSlug]) allItems[currentSlug] = [];
        allItems[currentSlug].push(res);
        updateStats(); renderDictCatBar(); render();
        nameEl.value = ''; descEl.value = '';
        if (hasUnit()) { unitEl.value = ''; customUnitWrap.style.display = 'none'; }
        selectedDictCat = ''; renderDictCatDropdown();
        nameEl.focus(); toast('آیتم اضافه شد', 'success');
      }).catch(function() { toast('خطا در ساخت', 'error'); });
    }
  }

  function edit(id) {
    var item = (allItems[currentSlug] || []).find(function(x) { return x.id === id; });
    if (!item) return;
    editingId = id;
    nameEl.value = item.name; descEl.value = item.description || '';
    if (hasUnit()) {
      var knownUnits = Object.keys(UNIT_LABELS);
      if (item.unit && knownUnits.indexOf(item.unit) === -1) {
        unitEl.value = 'custom'; customUnitEl.value = item.unit; customUnitWrap.style.display = '';
      } else {
        unitEl.value = item.unit || ''; customUnitWrap.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }
    selectedDictCat = item.dict_category || '';
    renderDictCatDropdown();
    addBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i> ذخیره';
    addBtn.classList.add('editing'); cancelBtn.style.display = '';
    nameEl.focus(); render();
  }

  function cancelEdit() {
    editingId = null;
    nameEl.value = ''; descEl.value = '';
    if (hasUnit()) { unitEl.value = ''; customUnitEl.value = ''; customUnitWrap.style.display = 'none'; }
    selectedDictCat = '';
    addBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> افزودن';
    addBtn.classList.remove('editing'); cancelBtn.style.display = 'none';
    renderDictCatDropdown();
  }

  /* ═══ حذف ═══ */
  function remove(id) {
    if (!confirm('آیا از حذف این آیتم مطمئنید؟')) return;

    if (isFood()) {
      /* ★ غذا → cascade delete (Food → Recipe → KitchenProduct) */
      api('/api/dictionary/food/' + id + '/delete/', 'POST').then(function(res) {
        if (res.error) { toast(res.error, 'error'); return; }
        handleDeleteSuccess(id, res.message);
      }).catch(function() { toast('خطا', 'error'); });
    } else {
      /* مواد اولیه / آماده / سفارشی → dictionary API */
      api('/api/dictionary/' + id + '/delete/', 'POST').then(function(res) {
        if (res.error) { toast(res.error, 'error'); return; }
        handleDeleteSuccess(id);
      }).catch(function() { toast('خطا', 'error'); });
    }
  }

  function handleDeleteSuccess(id, msg) {
    allItems[currentSlug] = (allItems[currentSlug] || []).filter(function(x) { return x.id !== id; });
    if (editingId === id) cancelEdit();
    updateStats(); renderDictCatBar(); render();
    toast(msg || 'حذف شد', 'success');
  }

  /* ═══ Events ═══ */
  onEnter(nameEl, save);
  onEnter(descEl, save);
  onEnter(grpNameEl, saveGroup);
  unitEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
    if (this.value === 'custom') { customUnitWrap.style.display = ''; customUnitEl.focus(); }
    else { customUnitWrap.style.display = 'none'; customUnitEl.value = ''; }
  });

  /* ═══ Init — تب پیش‌فرض: مواد اولیه ═══ */
  loadPresetSettings();
  loadDictCats();
  currentSlug = PRESETS[0].slug;
  renderStats(); renderPanelHead(); toggleFormFields();
  loadGroups();
  loadAll();

  return {
    switchTab: switchTab, filterList: filterList,
    filterDictCat: filterDictCat,
    save: save, edit: edit, cancelEdit: cancelEdit, remove: remove,
    showGroupForm: function() { showGroupForm(null); },
    cancelGroupForm: cancelGroupForm, saveGroup: saveGroup,
    editCurrentGroup: editCurrentGroup, deleteCurrentGroup: deleteCurrentGroup,
    toggleIconPicker: toggleIconPicker, pickIcon: pickIcon,
    showDictCatForm: showDictCatForm, editDictCatBar: editDictCatBar,
    removeDictCatBar: removeDictCatBar, saveDictCat: saveDictCatFn, cancelDictCatEdit: cancelDictCatEdit,
    toggleDictCat: toggleDictCat, pickDictCat: pickDictCat, addDictCat: addDictCat,
    renderDictCatDropdown: renderDictCatDropdown,
    /* ★ تابع عمومی — صفحات دیگه استفاده میکنن */
    getUsage: getUsage,
    getPresets: function() { return PRESETS; },
  };
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}

function fpGetCookie(name) {
    let v = null;
    document.cookie.split(';').forEach(c => {
        c = c.trim();
        if (c.startsWith(name + '=')) v = decodeURIComponent(c.slice(name.length + 1));
    });
    return v;
}

function fpOpenEdit(id) {

function fpAddSemi(data) {

    });

    var qty = data ? data.quantity : '';
    var costStr = data ? fpFmt(data.total_cost) + ' Øª' : 'â€”';
    div.innerHTML = '<select onchange="fpUpdateCostPreview()">' + options + '</select>' +
        '<input type="number" placeholder="Ù…Ù‚Ø¯Ø§Ø±" value="' + qty + '" min="0.01" step="0.01" oninput="fpUpdateCostPreview()">' +

//  Cost Preview
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
function fpUpdateCostPreview() {
    var semiTotal = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('#fpSemiRows .fp-ing-row').forEach(function(row) {
        var sel = row.querySelector('select');
        var qty = parseFloat(row.querySelector('input').value) || 0;
        var opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
        var cost = opt ? parseFloat(opt.dataset.cost || 0) : 0;
        var lineCost = cost * qty;
        semiTotal += lineCost;
        row.querySelector('.fp-ing-cost').textContent = lineCost > 0 ? fpFmt(Math.round(lineCost)) + ' Øª' : 'â€”';
    });

    var rawTotal = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('#fpRawRows .fp-ing-row').forEach(function(row) {
        var sel = row.querySelector('select');
        var qty = parseFloat(row.querySelector('input').value) || 0;
        var opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
        var price = opt ? parseFloat(opt.dataset.price || 0) : 0;
        var lineCost = price * qty;
        rawTotal += lineCost;
        row.querySelector('.fp-ing-cost').textContent = lineCost > 0 ? fpFmt(Math.round(lineCost)) + ' Øª' : 'â€”';
    });

    var total = semiTotal + rawTotal;
    var prodQty = parseFloat(document.getElementById('fpQty').value) || 1;
    var profit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('fpProfit').value) || 0;
    var perUnit = prodQty > 0 ? total / prodQty : 0;
    var suggested = Math.round(perUnit * (1 + profit / 100));

    document.getElementById('fpCpSemi').textContent = fpFmt(Math.round(semiTotal)) + ' Øª';
    document.getElementById('fpCpRaw').textContent = fpFmt(Math.round(rawTotal)) + ' Øª';
    document.getElementById('fpCpTotal').textContent = fpFmt(Math.round(total)) + ' Øª';
    document.getElementById('fpCpSuggested').textContent = fpFmt(suggested) + ' Øª';
}

document.getElementById('fpQty').addEventListener('input', fpUpdateCostPreview);
document.getElementById('fpProfit').addEventListener('input', fpUpdateCostPreview);

        var sel = row.querySelector('select');
        var qty = parseFloat(row.querySelector('input').value) || 0;
        var sfId = parseInt(sel.value);
        if (sfId && qty > 0) semiItems.push({ semi_finished: sfId, quantity: qty });
    });

    var rawItems = [];
    document.querySelectorAll('#fpRawRows .fp-ing-row').forEach(function(row) {
        var sel = row.querySelector('select');
        var qty = parseFloat(row.querySelector('input').value) || 0;
        var rmId = parseInt(sel.value);
        if (rmId && qty > 0) rawItems.push({ raw_material: rmId, quantity: qty });
    });

    var payload = {
        name: name,
        category: document.getElementById('fpCategory').value,
        unit: document.getElementById('fpUnit').value,
        quantity_produced: parseFloat(document.getElementById('fpQty').value) || 1,
        profit_percentage: parseInt(document.getElementById('fpProfit').value) || 30,
        description: document.getElementById('fpDesc').value.trim(),
        semi_finished_items: semiItems,
        raw_material_items: rawItems,
    };

    var url = fpEditingId ? '/api/finished-products/' + fpEditingId + '/' : '/api/finished-products/';
    var method = fpEditingId ? 'PUT' : 'POST';

    try {
        var res = await fetch(url, {
            method: method,
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': fpCsrf },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
            var err = await res.json();
            var msg = Object.values(err).flat().join(' | ');
            throw new Error(msg || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§ÛŒ Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ±');
        }
        fpToast(fpEditingId ? 'Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„ ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´ Ø´Ø¯.' : 'Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„ Ø¬Ø¯ÛŒØ¯ Ø«Ø¨Øª Ø´Ø¯.');
        fpCloseModal('fpFormModal');
        await fpRefresh();
    } catch (e) {
        fpToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§: ' + e.message, 'error');
    }
}
