//  Delete
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
async function fpDelete(id) {
    var p = null;
    fpProducts.forEach(function(x){ if (x.id === id) p = x; });
    if (!p) return;
    if (!confirm('Ø¢ÛŒØ§ Ø§Ø² Ø­Ø°Ù Â«' + p.name + 'Â» Ù…Ø·Ù…Ø¦Ù† Ù‡Ø³ØªÛŒØ¯ØŸ')) return;

    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/finished-products/' + id + '/', {
            method: 'DELETE',
            headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': fpCsrf },
        });
        if (!res.ok && res.status !== 204) throw new Error('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø­Ø°Ù');
        fpToast('Â«' + p.name + 'Â» Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´Ø¯.');
        await fpRefresh();
    } catch (e) {
        fpToast(e.message, 'error');
    }
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  Produce
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
function fpOpenProduce(id) {
    var p = null;
    fpProducts.forEach(function(x){ if (x.id === id) p = x; });
    if (!p) return;

    fpProducingId = id;
    fpProduceUnitCost = p.cost_per_unit;

    document.getElementById('fpProduceInfo').innerHTML =
        '<h3>' + p.name + '</h3>' +
        '<div class="fp-produce-detail">' +
        'Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª ØªÙ…Ø§Ù…â€ŒØ´Ø¯Ù‡ Ù‡Ø± ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯: <strong>' + fpFmt(p.cost_per_unit) + ' ØªÙˆÙ…Ø§Ù†</strong><br>' +
        'Ù…ÙˆØ§Ø¯ Ù†ÛŒÙ…â€ŒØ¢Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡: ' + p.semi_finished_items.length + ' Ù‚Ù„Ù… | ' +
        'Ù…ÙˆØ§Ø¯ Ø§ÙˆÙ„ÛŒÙ‡: ' + p.raw_material_items.length + ' Ù‚Ù„Ù…</div>';

    document.getElementById('fpProduceQty').value = 1;
    fpUpdateProducePreview();
    fpOpenModal('fpProduceModal');
}

function fpUpdateProducePreview() {
    var qty = parseFloat(document.getElementById('fpProduceQty').value) || 0;
    var total = Math.round(fpProduceUnitCost * qty);
    document.getElementById('fpProduceTotal').textContent = fpFmt(total) + ' ØªÙˆÙ…Ø§Ù†';
}

async function fpDoProduce() {
    var qty = parseFloat(document.getElementById('fpProduceQty').value);
    if (!qty || qty <= 0) { fpToast('ØªØ¹Ø¯Ø§Ø¯ Ù…Ø¹ØªØ¨Ø± ÙˆØ§Ø±Ø¯ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯.', 'error'); return; }

    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/finished-products/' + fpProducingId + '/produce/', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': fpCsrf },
            body: JSON.stringify({ quantity: qty }),
        });
        var data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) {
            var msg = data.errors ? data.errors.join(' | ') : (data.detail || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§');
            throw new Error(msg);
        }
        fpToast(qty + ' ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯ ØªÙˆÙ„ÛŒØ¯ Ø´Ø¯ Ùˆ Ø§Ø² Ø§Ù†Ø¨Ø§Ø± Ú©Ø³Ø± Ú¯Ø±Ø¯ÛŒØ¯.');
        fpCloseModal('fpProduceModal');
        await fpRefresh();
    } catch (e) {
        fpToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§: ' + e.message, 'error');
    }
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  Refresh
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
async function fpRefresh() {
    try {
        var res = await fetch('/api/finished-products/');
        var data = await res.json();
        fpProducts = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.results || []);

        fpProducts = fpProducts.map(function(p) {
            return {
                id: p.id,
                name: p.name,
                category: p.category,
                category_display: p.category_display || p.category,
                description: p.description || '',
                unit: p.unit,
                unit_display: p.unit,
                quantity_produced: parseFloat(p.quantity_produced),
                profit_percentage: p.profit_percentage,
                total_cost: p.total_cost,
                cost_per_unit: p.cost_per_unit,
                suggested_price: p.suggested_price,
                semi_finished_items: (p.semi_finished_items || []).map(function(si) {
                    return { id: si.id, semi_finished_id: si.semi_finished, semi_finished_name: si.semi_finished_name, quantity: parseFloat(si.quantity), total_cost: si.total_cost };
                }),
                raw_material_items: (p.raw_material_items || []).map(function(ri) {
                    return { id: ri.id, raw_material_id: ri.raw_material, raw_material_name: ri.raw_material_name, unit: ri.unit || '', quantity: parseFloat(ri.quantity), total_cost: ri.total_cost };
                }),
                created_at: p.created_at ? p.created_at.split('T')[0].replace(/-/g, '/') : '',
            };
        });

        fpRenderStats();
        fpRenderProducts();
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Refresh error:', e);
        fpToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø¨Ø±ÙˆØ²Ø±Ø³Ø§Ù†ÛŒ Ù„ÛŒØ³Øª', 'error');
    }
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  Init
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    fpRenderStats();
    fpRenderProducts();
});

function ktCsrf() {
    var v = null;
    document.cookie.split(';').forEach(function (c) {
        c = c.trim();
        if (c.indexOf('csrftoken=') === 0) v = decodeURIComponent(c.slice(10));
    });
    return v;
}

    if (!c) { alert(m); return; }
    var d = document.createElement('div');

    c.appendChild(d);
    setTimeout(function () {
        d.style.opacity = '0';

    }, 3500);
}

function ktTierColors(value, dangerMax, warnMax) {
    if (value <= dangerMax) return { color: 'var(--kt-danger)', bg: 'var(--kt-danger-bg)', border: 'var(--kt-danger-border)', icon: 'bi-x-circle-fill' };
    if (value < warnMax)   return { color: 'var(--kt-warning)', bg: 'var(--kt-warning-bg)', border: 'var(--kt-warning-border)', icon: 'bi-exclamation-circle-fill' };
    return { color: 'var(--kt-success)', bg: 'var(--kt-success-bg)', border: 'rgba(22,163,74,.2)', icon: 'bi-check-circle-fill' };
}

function ktMapFoodCategory(categoryName) {
    var cl = (categoryName || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!cl) return 'other';
    for (var ci = 0; ci < ktCategories.length; ci++) {
        var cV = ktCategories[ci][0];
        var cL = (ktCategories[ci][1] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (cL === cl || cL.indexOf(cl) !== -1 || cl.indexOf(cL) !== -1) return cV;
    }
    return 'other';
}

async function ktRunAction(actionFn, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    try {
        ktSpin(true);
        var result = await actionFn();
        var msg = (result && typeof result === 'object') ? result.msg : result;
        if (msg) ktToast(msg, 's');
        if (opts.reload !== false) await ktLoad();
        if (opts.onSuccess) opts.onSuccess(result);
        return result;
    } catch (e) {
        ktToast((opts.errorPrefix || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§: ') + e.message, 'e');
        if (opts.onError) opts.onError(e);
        return null;
    } finally {
        ktSpin(false);
    }
}

async function ktConfirmRunAction(confirmMsg, actionFn, opts) {
    if (!confirm(confirmMsg)) return null;
    return ktRunAction(actionFn, opts);
}

function ktWasteCost(w) {
    if (!w) return 0;
    if (w.total_cost) return w.total_cost;
    if (w.cost && w.quantity) return w.cost * w.quantity;
    return w.cost || 0;
}

function ktRenderTable(bodyId, cols, icon, txt, arr, fn) {
    var b = document.getElementById(bodyId);
    if (!b) return;
    if (!arr || !arr.length) {
        b.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="' + cols + '"><div class="kt-empty"><i class="bi ' + icon + '"></i><p>' + ktEscapeHtml(txt) + '</p></div></td></tr>';
        return;
    }
    var rows = [];
    arr.forEach(function (item, i) { rows.push(fn(item, i)); });
    b.innerHTML = rows.join('');
}

function _ktBuildCaches() {
    _ktProductMap = {};
    _ktStockMap   = {};
    ktD.products.forEach(function (p) { _ktProductMap[p.id] = p; });
    ktD.inventory.forEach(function (inv) {
        var pid = inv.kitchen_product_id || inv.kitchen_product;
        if (pid) {
            _ktStockMap[pid] = {
                total:     inv.quantity || 0,
                reserved:  inv.reserved_quantity || 0,
                available: (inv.available_quantity != null) ? inv.available_quantity : 0
            };
        }
    });
}

function _ktInvalidateCaches() {
    _ktProductMap = null;
    _ktStockMap   = null;
}

function ktFindProduct(id) {
    if (!_ktProductMap) _ktBuildCaches();
    return _ktProductMap[id] || null;
}

function ktGetStock(productId) {
    if (!_ktStockMap) _ktBuildCaches();
    return _ktStockMap[productId] || null;
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

function ktGetMinStock(product) {
    if (!product) return 0;
    if (product.min_stock != null && product.min_stock !== '') return Number(product.min_stock);
    if (product.minimum_stock != null && product.minimum_stock !== '') return Number(product.minimum_stock);
    if (product.min_stock_level != null && product.min_stock_level !== '') return Number(product.min_stock_level);
    return 0;
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

function ktValidateStock(productId, neededQty) {
    neededQty = neededQty || 1;
    var product = ktFindProduct(productId);
    if (!product) {
        return { ok: false, level: 'missing', available: 0, reserved: 0, total: 0, min: 0, message: 'Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„ Ø¯Ø± Ø¯ÛŒÚ©Ø´Ù†Ø±ÛŒ Ø«Ø¨Øª Ù†Ø´Ø¯Ù‡' };
    }
    var stock = ktGetStock(productId);
    if (!stock) {
        return { ok: false, level: 'missing', available: 0, reserved: 0, total: 0, min: 0, message: 'Â«' + product.name + 'Â» Ø¯Ø± Ø§Ù†Ø¨Ø§Ø± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ Ù†ÛŒØ³Øª' };
    }
    var avail = stock.available;
    var min   = ktGetMinStock(product);
    var warn  = KT_CONFIG.warnStock;

    if (neededQty > avail) {
        return { ok: false, level: 'error', available: avail, reserved: stock.reserved, total: stock.total, min: min, message: 'Ú©Ù…Ø¨ÙˆØ¯! Ù†ÛŒØ§Ø²: ' + neededQty + ' â€” Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯: ' + avail };
    }
    var afterUse = avail - neededQty;
    if (min > 0 && afterUse < min) {
        return { ok: false, level: 'error', available: avail, reserved: stock.reserved, total: stock.total, min: min, afterUse: afterUse, message: 'Â«' + product.name + 'Â» Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ Ø§Ø² Ø§ÛŒÙ† Ø¹Ù…Ù„ÛŒØ§Øª ' + afterUse + ' ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯ Ù…ÛŒâ€ŒÙ…Ø§Ù†Ø¯ (Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ù‚Ù„ ØªØ¹ÛŒÛŒÙ†â€ŒØ´Ø¯Ù‡: ' + min + ')' };
    }
    if (afterUse < warn) {
        return { ok: true, level: 'warn', available: avail, reserved: stock.reserved, total: stock.total, min: min, afterUse: afterUse, message: 'Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ Ø±Ùˆ Ø¨Ù‡ Ø§ØªÙ…Ø§Ù… (' + afterUse + ' ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯ Ø¨Ø§Ù‚ÛŒ)' };
    }
    return { ok: true, level: 'ok', available: avail, reserved: stock.reserved, total: stock.total, min: min, afterUse: afterUse, message: '' };
}

function ktStockBadgeHTML(productId) {
    var v = ktValidateStock(productId);
    if (v.level === 'missing') {
        return '<span style="padding:3px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:var(--kt-fs-xs);font-weight:700;background:var(--kt-danger-bg);color:var(--kt-danger)"><i class="bi bi-x-circle-fill"></i> Ø¨Ø¯ÙˆÙ† Ø§Ù†Ø¨Ø§Ø±</span>';
    }
    var color = v.level === 'error' ? 'var(--kt-danger)' : v.level === 'warn' ? 'var(--kt-warning)' : 'var(--kt-success)';
    var bg    = v.level === 'error' ? 'var(--kt-danger-bg)' : v.level === 'warn' ? 'var(--kt-warning-bg)' : 'var(--kt-success-bg)';
    var icon  = v.level === 'error' ? 'bi-exclamation-triangle-fill' : v.level === 'warn' ? 'bi-exclamation-circle-fill' : 'bi-check-circle-fill';

    var html = '<span style="padding:3px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:var(--kt-fs-xs);font-weight:700;background:' + bg + ';color:' + color + '"><i class="bi ' + icon + '" style="margin-left:2px"></i> Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ: ' + ktFmt(v.available) + '</span>';
    if (v.reserved > 0) {
        html += ' <span style="padding:3px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:var(--kt-fs-xs);font-weight:700;background:var(--kt-warning-bg);color:var(--kt-warning)"><i class="bi bi-lock-fill" style="margin-left:2px"></i> Ø±Ø²Ø±Ùˆ: ' + ktFmt(v.reserved) + '</span>';
    }
    if (v.min > 0) {
        html += ' <span style="padding:3px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:var(--kt-fs-xs);font-weight:600;background:var(--kt-bg);color:var(--kt-text-sec)"><i class="bi bi-shield-fill-exclamation" style="margin-left:2px"></i> Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ù‚Ù„: ' + ktFmt(v.min) + '</span>';
    }
    if (v.level === 'error') {
        html += '<div style="margin-top:4px;font-size:var(--kt-fs-xs);color:var(--kt-danger);font-weight:600"><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> ' + ktEscapeHtml(v.message) + '</div>';
    }
    return html;
}

function ktOpenModal(id) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function ktCloseModal(id) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('open');
    if (!document.querySelector('.kt-modal.open')) document.body.style.overflow = '';
    if (id === 'ktModalCostPrice' && _ktCostObserver) {
        _ktCostObserver.disconnect();
        _ktCostObserver = null;
    }
}

document.querySelectorAll('.kt-modal').forEach(function (m) {
    m.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === m) ktCloseModal(m.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        var ms = document.querySelectorAll('.kt-modal.open');
        if (ms.length) ktCloseModal(ms[ms.length - 1].id);
    }
});

function loadKitchenOrders() {
    var container = document.getElementById('kitchen-orders-list');
    if (!container) return;
    container.innerHTML =
        '<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--kt-text-sec)">' +
        '<div class="kt-spin" style="margin:0 auto 12px"></div>' +
        '<p style="font-size:var(--kt-fs-sm)">Ø¯Ø± Ø­Ø§Ù„ Ø¨Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ...</p></div>';

    fetch('/api/orders/kitchen/?status=preparing')
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (data) {
            var orders = data.orders || [];
            renderKitchenOrders(orders);
            knDetectNewOrders(orders);
        })
        .catch(function () {
            container.innerHTML =
                '<div class="ko-empty"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle" style="font-size:3rem;display:block;margin-bottom:10px;opacity:.4"></i>' +
                '<p style="font-size:var(--kt-fs-sm)">Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø¨Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ</p></div>';

function renderKitchenOrders(orders) {

function markOrderReady(orderId) {
    if (_markReadyLock[orderId]) return;
    if (!confirm('Ø³ÙØ§Ø±Ø´ #' + orderId + ' Ø¢Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø´Ø¯Ù‡ØŸ')) return;
    _markReadyLock[orderId] = true;

    var card = document.querySelector('.ko-card[data-order-id="' + orderId + '"]');
    if (card) { card.style.opacity = '.5'; card.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; }

    fetch('/api/orders/' + orderId + '/status/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': ktCsrf() },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'ready' })
    })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (data) {
        if (data.success || data.id) {
            if (card) {
                card.style.transition = 'all .3s ease';
                card.style.opacity = '0';
                card.style.transform = 'translateX(30px)';
                setTimeout(function () {
                    card.remove();
                    var remaining = document.querySelectorAll('.ko-card');
                    if (!remaining.length) loadKitchenOrders();
                    var badge = document.getElementById('orders-badge');
                    if (badge) {
                        var count = document.querySelectorAll('.ko-card').length;
                        if (count > 0) { badge.textContent = count; badge.style.display = ''; }
                        else { badge.style.display = 'none'; }
                    }
                }, 300);
            }
            var idx = _ktKnownOrderIds.indexOf(orderId);
            if (idx > -1) _ktKnownOrderIds.splice(idx, 1);
            knUpdateCounter();
        } else {
            if (card) { card.style.opacity = '1'; card.style.pointerEvents = ''; }
            ktToast(data.error || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'e');
        }
    })
    .catch(function () {
        if (card) { card.style.opacity = '1'; card.style.pointerEvents = ''; }
        ktToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø§Ø±ØªØ¨Ø§Ø· Ø¨Ø§ Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ±', 'e');
    })
    .finally(function () {
        delete _markReadyLock[orderId];
    });
}

var _pollController = null;

function ktStartOrdersPolling() {
    if (_ktOrdersInterval) clearInterval(_ktOrdersInterval);
    _ktOrdersInterval = setInterval(function () {
        if (_pollController) {
            try { _pollController.abort(); } catch (e) { /* Ø³Ø§Ú©Øª */ }
        }
        _pollController = new AbortController();

        var activeTab = document.querySelector('.kt-tab.active');
        if (activeTab && activeTab.dataset.tab === 'orders') {
            loadKitchenOrders();
        } else {
            fetch('/api/orders/kitchen/?status=preparing', { signal: _pollController.signal })
                .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
                .then(function (data) { knDetectNewOrders(data.orders || []); })
                .catch(function (e) {
                    if (e.name === 'AbortError') return;
                });
        }
    }, 15000);
}

function knDetectNewOrders(orders) {
    var currentIds = orders.map(function (o) { return o.id; });
    for (var k = _ktKnownOrderIds.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
        if (currentIds.indexOf(_ktKnownOrderIds[k]) === -1) {
            _ktKnownOrderIds.splice(k, 1);
        }
    }
    orders.forEach(function (order) {
        if (_ktKnownOrderIds.indexOf(order.id) === -1) {
            _ktKnownOrderIds.push(order.id);
            if (_knInitDone) knAddNotification(order);
        }
    });
    knUpdateCounter();
}

function knMarkInitDone() { _knInitDone = true; }

function knAddNotification(order) {

    });
    var timeStr = ktEscapeHtml(order.created_at || '');

    toast.innerHTML =
        '<div class="kn-head">' +
            '<span class="kn-pulse-dot"></span>' +
            '<span class="kn-label">Ø³ÙØ§Ø±Ø´ Ø¬Ø¯ÛŒØ¯</span>' +

var _knAudioCtx = null;

function knPlaySound() {

function knMarkReady(orderId, btnEl) {
    var toast = btnEl.closest('.kn-toast');
    if (toast && toast._timer) clearInterval(toast._timer);
    markOrderReady(orderId);
    if (toast) knDismissToast(toast);
}

function knDismiss(btnEl) {
    var toast = btnEl.closest('.kn-toast');
    if (!toast) return;
    if (toast._timer) clearInterval(toast._timer);
    knDismissToast(toast);
}

function knDismissToast(toast) {
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.classList.add('kn-exit');
    setTimeout(function () {
        var oid = parseInt(toast.getAttribute('data-kn-order-id'));
        if (!isNaN(oid)) {
            for (var i = _knPending.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (_knPending[i].id === oid) _knPending.splice(i, 1);
            }
        }
        toast.remove();
        knUpdateCounter();
    }, 400);
}

function knUpdateCounter() {
    var counter = document.getElementById('knCounter');
    var numEl   = document.getElementById('knCounterNum');
    if (!counter || !numEl) return;
    var count = document.querySelectorAll('.kn-toast').length;
    if (count > 0) {
        numEl.textContent = count;
        counter.style.display = 'flex';
    } else {
        counter.style.display = 'none';
    }
}

function knShowAllPending() {

    var ordersPanel = document.getElementById('panel-orders');
    if (ordersTab)   ordersTab.classList.add('active');
    if (ordersPanel) ordersPanel.classList.add('active');
    loadKitchenOrders();
}

function ktProduceExisting(productId) {

        var opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
        if (opt && opt.dataset.cost) _pfRecipeCost = parseFloat(opt.dataset.cost) || _pfRecipeCost;
    }

function pfCalcFromPrice() {

var _ktLoadPromise = null;

async function ktLoad() {
    if (_ktLoadPromise) return _ktLoadPromise;
    _ktLoadPromise = _ktLoadInner();
    try { return await _ktLoadPromise; }
    finally { _ktLoadPromise = null; }
}

async function _ktLoadInner() {
    try {
        var data = await ktApi('/api/kitchen/dashboard/');
        if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
            ktD.products  = Array.isArray(data.products)  ? data.products  : (ktD.products  || []);
            ktD.batches   = Array.isArray(data.batches)   ? data.batches   : (ktD.batches   || []);
            ktD.inventory = Array.isArray(data.inventory) ? data.inventory : (ktD.inventory || []);
            ktD.logs      = Array.isArray(data.logs)      ? data.logs      : (ktD.logs      || []);
            ktD.low_stock = Array.isArray(data.low_stock) ? data.low_stock : (ktD.low_stock || []);
            ktD.waste     = Array.isArray(data.waste)     ? data.waste     : (data.waste && data.waste.results ? data.waste.results : (ktD.waste || []));
            ktD.stats     = (data.stats && typeof data.stats === 'object') ? data.stats : (ktD.stats || {});
        }
        _ktInvalidateCaches();
        ktRenderAll();
    } catch (e) {
        ktToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§: ' + e.message, 'e');
    }
}

/* â˜… ktRenderDiscounts Ø§Ø² Ø§ÛŒÙ†Ø¬Ø§ Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´Ø¯ */
function ktRenderAll() {
    ktRenderStats();
    ktBuildMenuCatFilters();
    ktRenderMenuFoods();
    ktRenderWaste();
    ktRenderWasteStats();
    ktBuildWasteReasonFilters();
}

function ktStatCard(cls, icon, val, lbl) {
    return '<div class="kt-stat ' + cls + '"><i class="bi ' + icon + '" style="font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:6px;display:block"></i><span class="kt-sv">' + val + '</span><div class="kt-sl">' + lbl + '</div></div>';
}

function ktRenderStats() {
    var s     = ktD.stats || {};
    var waste = ktD.waste || [];
    var today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    var todayWaste    = waste.filter(function (w) { return (w.created_at || '').slice(0, 10) === today; });
    var todayWasteQty = todayWaste.reduce(function (sum, w) { return sum + (w.quantity || 0); }, 0);
    var totalStock    = 0;
    ktD.inventory.forEach(function (inv) { totalStock += (inv.quantity || 0); });

    var lowCount = 0;
    ktD.products.forEach(function (p) {
        var min = ktGetMinStock(p);
        if (min <= 0) return;
        var st = ktGetStock(p.id);
        if (st && st.available < min) lowCount++;
    });

    var h = '';
    h += ktStatCard('orange', 'bi-grid-fill',   s.total_products || 0,              'Ù…Ø­ØµÙˆÙ„Ø§Øª');
    h += ktStatCard('teal',   'bi-box-seam',    ktFmt(totalStock),                    'Ú©Ù„ Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ');
    h += ktStatCard('amber',  'bi-cash-stack',  ktFmt(s.inventory_value || 0) + ' Øª', 'Ø§Ø±Ø²Ø´ Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ');
    h += ktStatCard('red',    'bi-trash3-fill', s.waste_today_qty || todayWasteQty,    'Ø¶Ø§ÛŒØ¹Ø§Øª Ø§Ù…Ø±ÙˆØ²');
    if (lowCount > 0) {
        h += ktStatCard('red', 'bi-shield-fill-exclamation', lowCount, 'Ø²ÛŒØ± Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ù‚Ù„ Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ');
    }
    document.getElementById('ktStats').innerHTML = h;
}

function ktDebouncedRenderMenu() {
    if (_ktMenuDebounce) clearTimeout(_ktMenuDebounce);
    _ktMenuDebounce = setTimeout(ktRenderMenuFoods, 200);
}

function ktBuildMenuCatFilters() {
    var wrap = document.getElementById('ktMenuCats');
    if (!wrap) return;
    var cc = {};
    ktMenuFoods.forEach(function (f) { var c = String(f.category_id); cc[c] = (cc[c] || 0) + 1; });
    var b = [];
    b.push('<button class="kt-mf-cat-btn active" data-cat="all" onclick="ktSelectMenuCat(this)">Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ (' + ktMenuFoods.length + ')</button>');
    ktFoodCats.forEach(function (c) {
        var n = cc[String(c.id)] || 0;
        if (n > 0) b.push('<button class="kt-mf-cat-btn" data-cat="' + c.id + '" onclick="ktSelectMenuCat(this)">' + ktEscapeHtml(c.name) + ' (' + n + ')</button>');
    });
    wrap.innerHTML = b.join('');
}

function ktSelectMenuCat(btn) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.kt-mf-cat-btn').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    ktRenderMenuFoods();
}

async function ktShowProductCost(productId) {

    var profit  = price - cost;
    var stock   = ktGetStock(p.id);
    var avail   = stock ? stock.available : 0;
    var min     = ktGetMinStock(p);

    var cBox = document.getElementById("cpTabCost");

    h += ktCsBox(ktFmt(profit) + ' Øª', 'Ø³ÙˆØ¯ ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯', profit >= 0 ? 'var(--kt-success)' : 'var(--kt-danger)');
    h += '</div>';

    h += '<div style="background:' + (profit >= 0 ? "var(--kt-success-bg)" : "var(--kt-danger-bg)") +
         ';border:1px solid ' + (profit >= 0 ? "rgba(22,163,74,.2)" : "rgba(220,38,38,.2)") +
         ';border-radius:10px;padding:14px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:16px">' +
         '<span style="font-size:var(--kt-fs-sm);font-weight:700;color:' +

function cpCalcFromPct() {
    var p = ktFindProduct(cpProductId);
    if (!p) return;
    var c  = Number(p.cost) || 0;
    var pc = parseFloat(document.getElementById("cpProfitPct").value) || 0;
    var np = Math.round(c * (1 + pc / 100));
    document.getElementById("cpNewPrice").value = np;
    cpUpdatePreview(c, np);
}

function cpCalcFromPrice() {
    var p = ktFindProduct(cpProductId);
    if (!p) return;
    var c  = Number(p.cost) || 0;
    var np = parseInt(document.getElementById("cpNewPrice").value) || 0;
    var pc = c > 0 ? Math.round(((np - c) / c) * 100) : 0;
    document.getElementById("cpProfitPct").value = pc;
    cpUpdatePreview(c, np);
}

function cpUpdatePreview(cost, np) {
    var pr = np - cost;
    var m  = cost > 0 ? Math.round(((np - cost) / cost) * 100) : 0;
    var pe = document.getElementById("cpNewProfit");
    if (pe) { pe.textContent = ktFmt(pr) + " ØªÙˆÙ…Ø§Ù†"; pe.style.color = pr >= 0 ? "var(--kt-success)" : "var(--kt-danger)"; }
    var me = document.getElementById("cpNewMargin");
    if (me) { me.textContent = m + "%"; me.style.color = pr >= 0 ? "var(--kt-success)" : "var(--kt-danger)"; }
}

function ktDoSavePrice() {
    var np = parseInt(document.getElementById("cpNewPrice").value);
    if (isNaN(np) || np < 0) { ktToast("Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª Ù†Ø§Ù…Ø¹ØªØ¨Ø±", "e"); return; }
    return ktRunAction(async function () {
        await ktApi("/api/kitchen/products/" + cpProductId + "/", "PATCH", { selling_price: np });
        return "Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª Ø¨Ø±ÙˆØ²Ø±Ø³Ø§Ù†ÛŒ Ø´Ø¯";
    }, { onSuccess: function () { ktShowProductCost(cpProductId); } });
}

function ktSaveMinStock() {
    var val = parseInt(document.getElementById("cpMinStock").value);
    if (isNaN(val) || val < 0) { ktToast("Ù…Ù‚Ø¯Ø§Ø± Ù†Ø§Ù…Ø¹ØªØ¨Ø±", "e"); return; }
    return ktRunAction(async function () {
        await ktApi("/api/kitchen/products/" + cpProductId + "/", "PATCH", { min_stock: val });
        return "Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ù‚Ù„ Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ Ø¨Ø±ÙˆØ²Ø±Ø³Ø§Ù†ÛŒ Ø´Ø¯";
    }, { onSuccess: function () { ktShowProductCost(cpProductId); } });

function renderMaterialBlock(title, icon, color, items) {
    var h = '<div style="margin-bottom:16px"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:var(--kt-fs-base);margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--kt-text)"><i class="bi ' + icon + '" style="color:' + color + ';margin-left:4px"></i> ' + title + '</div>';
    items.forEach(function (m) {
        var ok  = m.available >= m.required;
        var pct = m.required > 0 ? Math.round((m.available / m.required) * 100) : 100;
        var bc  = ok ? "var(--kt-success)" : (pct >= 50 ? "var(--kt-warning)" : "var(--kt-danger)");
        h += '<div style="background:var(--kt-surface);border:1.5px solid ' + (ok ? "var(--kt-border)" : "var(--kt-danger-border)") + ';border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:8px">';
        h += '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px"><span style="font-weight:700;font-size:var(--kt-fs-sm)">' + ktEscapeHtml(m.name || 'â€”') + '</span><span class="kt-badge ' + (ok ? "kt-badge-ok" : "kt-badge-out") + '">' + (ok ? "Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯" : "Ú©Ù…Ø¨ÙˆØ¯") + '</span></div>';
        h += '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:var(--kt-fs-sm);color:var(--kt-text-sec);margin-bottom:6px"><span>Ù†ÛŒØ§Ø²: ' + ktFmt(m.required) + ' ' + (m.unit || '') + '</span><span>Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯: ' + ktFmt(m.available) + ' ' + (m.unit || '') + '</span></div>';
        h += '<div style="background:#e7e5e4;border-radius:4px;height:6px;overflow:hidden"><div style="width:' + Math.min(100, pct) + '%;background:' + bc + ';height:100%;border-radius:4px"></div></div>';
        if (!ok) h += '<div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:var(--kt-fs-sm);color:var(--kt-danger);font-weight:600">Ú©Ù…Ø¨ÙˆØ¯: ' + ktFmt(m.required - m.available) + ' ' + (m.unit || '') + '</div>';
        h += '</div>';
    });
    h += '</div>';
    return h;
}

function ktBuildWasteReasonFilters() {
    var wrap = document.getElementById('ktWasteReasonFilters');
    if (!wrap) return;
    var waste = ktD.waste || [];
    var rc = {};
    waste.forEach(function (w) { rc[w.reason] = (rc[w.reason] || 0) + 1; });
    var b = ['<button class="kt-mf-cat-btn' + (_ktWasteFilterReason === 'all' ? ' active' : '') + '" data-wreason="all" onclick="ktSelectWasteReason(this)">Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ (' + waste.length + ')</button>'];
    for (var key in _ktWasteReasons) {
        if (!_ktWasteReasons.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;
        var n = rc[key] || 0;
        if (n > 0) b.push('<button class="kt-mf-cat-btn' + (_ktWasteFilterReason === key ? ' active' : '') + '" data-wreason="' + key + '" onclick="ktSelectWasteReason(this)">' + _ktWasteReasons[key].label + ' (' + n + ')</button>');
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = b.join('');
}

function ktSelectWasteReason(btn) {

    _ktWasteFilterReason = btn.dataset.wreason;
    ktRenderWaste();
}

function ktRenderWasteStats() {

    if (!sb) return;
    var waste = ktD.waste || [];

    var todayWaste = waste.filter(function (w) { return (w.created_at || '').slice(0, 10) === today; });
    var todayQty   = todayWaste.reduce(function (s, w) { return s + (w.quantity || 0); }, 0);
    var todayCost  = todayWaste.reduce(function (s, w) { return s + ktWasteCost(w); }, 0);
    var totalQty   = waste.reduce(function (s, w) { return s + (w.quantity || 0); }, 0);
    var totalCost  = waste.reduce(function (s, w) { return s + ktWasteCost(w); }, 0);

    sb.innerHTML =
        '<div class="kt-mf-stat"><span class="kt-mf-sv" style="color:var(--kt-danger)">' + todayQty + '</span><div class="kt-mf-sl">Ø¶Ø§ÛŒØ¹Ø§Øª Ø§Ù…Ø±ÙˆØ²</div></div>' +

    function getTimeAgo(dateStr) {
        const date = (dateStr instanceof Date) ? dateStr : new Date(dateStr);
        const sec  = Math.floor((Date.now() - date.getTime()) / 1000);
        if (sec < 0)    return 'Ù‡Ù…ÛŒÙ† Ø§Ù„Ø§Ù†';
        if (sec < 60)   return 'Ù„Ø­Ø¸Ø§ØªÛŒ Ù¾ÛŒØ´';

    /* CSRF Token */
    function getCookie(name) {
        let v = null;
        document.cookie.split(';').forEach(c => {
            c = c.trim();
            if (c.startsWith(name + '=')) v = decodeURIComponent(c.substring(name.length + 1));
        });

    async function apiChangeStatus(orderId, newStatus) {
        const url = API.changeStatus + orderId + '/status/';

        const res = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type':     'application/json',
                'X-CSRFToken':      csrftoken,
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ status: newStatus }),

            throw new Error(err.detail || err.error || err.message || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§ÛŒ Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ± (' + res.status + ')');

    function loadDemoOrders() {

    function createDemoOrder(status) {
        const used = new Set();
        const items = [];
        for (let i = 0, n = randInt(2, 5); i < n; i++) {
            let idx;
            do { idx = randInt(0, DEMO_FOODS.length - 1); } while (used.has(idx));
            used.add(idx);
            items.push({ name: DEMO_FOODS[idx].name, price: DEMO_FOODS[idx].price, qty: randInt(1, 3) });
        }
        orderIdCounter++;
        return {
            id:        orderIdCounter,
            status:    status,
            table:     randItem(DEMO_TABLES),
            customer:  randItem(DEMO_CUSTOMERS),
            items:     items,
            total:     items.reduce((s, it) => s + it.price * it.qty, 0),
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            isNew:     true,
        };
    }

    function renderOrders() {

        const q = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();

        let filtered = orders.filter(o => {
            if (currentFilter === 'active') return ['pending','confirmed','preparing','ready'].includes(o.status);
            return o.status === currentFilter;

                String(o.id).includes(q) ||
                (o.customer || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                String(o.table).includes(q) ||

    function updateStats() {
        const c = {
            total:     orders.filter(o => ['pending','confirmed','preparing','ready'].includes(o.status)).length,
            pending:   orders.filter(o => o.status === 'pending').length,
            confirmed: orders.filter(o => o.status === 'confirmed').length,

        document.getElementById('statReady').textContent      = toPersianNum(c.ready);
        document.getElementById('countActive').textContent    = toPersianNum(c.total);
        document.getElementById('countPending').textContent   = toPersianNum(c.pending);
        document.getElementById('countConfirmed').textContent = toPersianNum(c.confirmed);
        document.getElementById('countPreparing').textContent = toPersianNum(c.preparing);
        document.getElementById('countReady').textContent     = toPersianNum(c.ready);

        const badge = document.getElementById('headerBadge');
        if (c.total > 0) {
            badge.textContent = toPersianNum(c.total) + ' Ø³ÙØ§Ø±Ø´ ÙØ¹Ø§Ù„';
            badge.classList.add('show');

    function showModal(title, desc, type, buttons) {

    function showToast(msg, type) {
        type = type || 'success';
        const box   = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
        const icons = {
            success: 'bi-check-circle-fill',
            info:    'bi-info-circle-fill',
            error:   'bi-x-circle-fill',
            warning: 'bi-exclamation-circle-fill',
        };
        const t = document.createElement('div');
        t.className = 'toast ' + type;
        t.innerHTML = '<i class="bi ' + (icons[type] || icons.success) + '"></i> ' + msg;
        box.appendChild(t);
        setTimeout(() => {
            t.classList.add('out');
            setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 350);
        }, 2800);
    }

function onSubscriberSelect() {
    const sel = $('posSubscriberSelect'); const infoBox = $('subscriberCreditInfo');
    if (!sel.value) { infoBox.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    const sub = getSubscriberById(parseInt(sel.value)); if (!sub) { infoBox.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    if ($('posCustName')) $('posCustName').value = sub.name;
    if ($('posCustPhone')) $('posCustPhone').value = sub.phone;
    const avail = Math.max(0, sub.creditLimit - sub.debt);
    $('sciLimit').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(sub.creditLimit);
    $('sciDebt').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(sub.debt);
    const availEl = $('sciAvailable'); availEl.textContent = Utils.formatPrice(avail);
    availEl.parentElement.className = 'sci-row ' + (avail > sub.creditLimit * 0.3 ? 'sci-available' : 'sci-danger');
    infoBox.style.display = 'block';
}

function openSubscriberModal() { $('subscriberModal').classList.add('show'); renderSubscriberList(); }
function closeSubscriberModal() { $('subscriberModal').classList.remove('show'); }

function submitNewSubscriber() {
    const name = $('subName').value, phone = $('subPhone').value, limit = $('subCreditLimit').value, debt = $('subInitDebt').value;
    if (addSubscriber(name, phone, limit, debt)) { $('subName').value = ''; $('subPhone').value = ''; $('subCreditLimit').value = ''; $('subInitDebt').value = '0'; }
}

function setOrderType(type) {
    State.currentOrderType = type;
    document.querySelectorAll('.order-type-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.type === type));
    const tf = $('tableNumberField'), df = $('deliveryAddressField');
    if (tf) tf.style.display = type === 'hall' ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (df) df.style.display = type === 'delivery' ? 'block' : 'none';
}

//  SERVER & TOAST
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

async function savePriceToServer(foodId, price, finalPrice) {
    try { const res = await fetch('/api/pos/update-food-price/', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': Utils.getCSRFToken() }, body: JSON.stringify({ food_id: foodId, price, final_price: finalPrice }) }); const data = await res.json(); if (data.success) return true; showToast(data.error || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§ÛŒ Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ±', 'error'); return false; } catch { showToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø§Ø±ØªØ¨Ø§Ø· Ø¨Ø§ Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ±', 'error'); return false; }
}

let toastTimer = null;
function showToast(msg, type = 'success') {
    let t = document.querySelector('.pos-toast');
    if (!t) { t = document.createElement('div'); t.className = 'pos-toast'; document.body.appendChild(t); }
    const ic = { success:'bi-check-circle', error:'bi-x-circle', warning:'bi-exclamation-triangle' };
    t.className = `pos-toast ${type}`; t.innerHTML = `<i class="bi ${ic[type]||ic.success}"></i> ${msg}`;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => t.classList.add('show'));
    clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 3000);
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  SYNC FOOD UPDATE
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

async function syncFoodUpdate(foodId, newPrice, successMsg) {
    const food = Utils.getFoodById(foodId); if (!food) return false;
    const ok = await savePriceToServer(foodId, newPrice, Utils.getDiscountedPrice({price: newPrice, id: foodId}));
    if (!ok) return false;
    const orig = food.originalPrice || food.price;
    if (newPrice !== orig) { if (!food.originalPrice) food.originalPrice = food.price; food.price = newPrice; food.priceEdited = true; }
    else { if (food.originalPrice) { food.price = food.originalPrice; delete food.originalPrice; food.priceEdited = false; } }
    const sp = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pos_custom_prices')||'{}');
    if (food.priceEdited) sp[foodId] = newPrice; else delete sp[foodId];
    localStorage.setItem('pos_custom_prices', JSON.stringify(sp));
    const ci = State.cart.find(c => c.id === foodId);
    if (ci) { ci.price = Utils.getDiscountedPrice(food); ci.originalPrice = food.price; }
    renderMenu(); renderCart(); renderDiscounts();
    if (successMsg) showToast(successMsg, 'success'); return true;
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  MENU, CATEGORIES, FILTERING
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

async function loadFoods() {
    try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/menu/'); const data = await res.json();
        const raw = data.results || data.foods || data;
        if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
            State.foods = raw.map(f => ({ id: f.id, name: f.name, category: f.category_name||f.category||'Ø¨Ø¯ÙˆÙ† Ø¯Ø³ØªÙ‡', price: f.final_price||f.price||0, image: f.image||'', stock: f.is_available !== undefined ? (f.is_available?999:0) : (f.stock||999), maxPerOrder: f.maxPerOrder||10 }));
            const sp = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pos_custom_prices')||'{}');
            State.foods.forEach(f => { if (sp[f.id] !== undefined) { f.originalPrice = f.price; f.price = sp[f.id]; f.priceEdited = true; } });
            Object.assign(State.discounts, JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pos_discounts')||'{}'));
            const sc = localStorage.getItem('pos_order_counter'); if (sc) State.orderCounter = parseInt(sc);
            const pins = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pos_pinned')||'[]'); State.pinnedFoods = new Set(pins);
        }
    } catch (e) { console.error('Ø®Ø·Ø§:', e); State.foods = []; }
    loadSubscribers(); renderMenu(); renderDiscounts(); populateWasteSelects(); refreshSubscriberUI();
}

function renderCategories() {
    const cats = ['all', ...new Set(State.foods.map(f => f.category))];
    [['posCats', State.activeCat, 'posFilterCat', 'pos-cat-btn'], ['discCats', State.activeDiscCat, 'discFilterCat', 'disc-cat-btn']].forEach(([id, active, fn, cls]) => {
        const c = $(id); if (!c) return;
        c.innerHTML = cats.map(cat => `<button class="${cls} ${cat===active?'active':''}" onclick="${fn}('${cat}')">${cat==='all'?'Ù‡Ù…Ù‡':cat}</button>`).join('');
    });
}

function renderMenu() { renderCategories(); posFilter(); }
function posFilterCat(cat) { State.activeCat = cat; renderCategories(); posFilter(); }
function discFilterCat(cat) { State.activeDiscCat = cat; renderCategories(); discFilter(); }

function getFilteredFoods(searchId, activeCat) {
    const q = ($(searchId)?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    return State.foods.filter(f => (activeCat==='all'||f.category===activeCat) && (!q||f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
}

function posFilter() {
    const grid = $('posGrid'); let filtered = getFilteredFoods('posSearch', State.activeCat);
    // Pin: Ù…Ø±ØªØ¨â€ŒØ³Ø§Ø²ÛŒ â€” Ù¾ÛŒÙ†â€ŒØ´Ø¯Ù‡â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ Ø§ÙˆÙ„
    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const ap = State.pinnedFoods.has(a.id) ? 0 : 1;
        const bp = State.pinnedFoods.has(b.id) ? 0 : 1;
        return ap - bp;
    });

    if (!filtered.length) { grid.innerHTML = '<div style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--pos-text-sec)"><i class="bi bi-search" style="font-size:32px;display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--pos-border)"></i><p>ØºØ°Ø§ÛŒÛŒ Ù¾ÛŒØ¯Ø§ Ù†Ø´Ø¯</p></div>'; return; }
    grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(food => {
        const inCart = State.cart.find(c => c.id === food.id); const qty = inCart?inCart.qty:0;
        const disc = State.discounts[food.id]; const oos = food.stock<=0; const max = food.maxPerOrder && qty>=food.maxPerOrder;
        const isPinned = State.pinnedFoods.has(food.id);
        let cls = 'pos-food-card'; if (oos) cls += ' out-of-stock'; else if (max) cls += ' max-reached'; else if (qty>0) cls += ' in-cart';
        if (isPinned) cls += ' pinned';
        return `<div class="${cls}" onclick="addToCart(${food.id})" data-food-id="${food.id}" draggable="true">
            ${disc?`<div class="pos-discount-badge">${disc.type==='percent'?disc.value+'%':Utils.formatPriceShort(disc.value)}</div>`:''}
            ${qty>0?`<div class="pos-qty-badge">${Utils.toPersianNum(qty)}</div>`:''}
            <div class="pin-badge" onclick="event.stopPropagation();togglePin(${food.id})" title="${isPinned?'Ø¨Ø±Ø¯Ø§Ø´ØªÙ† Ù¾ÛŒÙ†':'Ù¾ÛŒÙ† Ú©Ø±Ø¯Ù†'}">
                <i class="bi bi-pin-angle${isPinned?'-fill':''}"></i>
            </div>
            <div class="pos-food-img">${food.image?`<img src="${food.image}" alt="${food.name}">`:Utils.getCategoryEmoji(food.category)}</div>
            <div class="pos-food-body">
                <div class="pos-food-name">${food.name}</div>
                <span class="pos-food-cat">${food.category}</span>
                <div class="pos-food-price">${Utils.formatPrice(Utils.getDiscountedPrice(food))}</div>
                ${food.priceEdited?`<span class="pos-food-price-old">${Utils.formatPrice(food.originalPrice)}</span>`:''}
            </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');

    initFoodCardDragDrop();
}

function togglePin(foodId) {
    if (State.pinnedFoods.has(foodId)) State.pinnedFoods.delete(foodId);
    else State.pinnedFoods.add(foodId);
    localStorage.setItem('pos_pinned', JSON.stringify([...State.pinnedFoods]));
    posFilter();
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  DRAG & DROP â€” Food Cards
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

function initFoodCardDragDrop() {
    const grid = $('posGrid'); if (!grid) return;
    let draggedEl = null;
    grid.querySelectorAll('.pos-food-card[draggable]').forEach(el => {
        el.addEventListener('dragstart', function(e) {
            draggedEl = this; this.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
            e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', this.dataset.foodId);
        });
        el.addEventListener('dragend', function() {
            this.classList.remove('dragging');
            grid.querySelectorAll('.drag-over').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('drag-over'));
            draggedEl = null;
        });
        el.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move'; });
        el.addEventListener('dragenter', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); if (this !== draggedEl) this.classList.add('drag-over'); });
        el.addEventListener('dragleave', function() { this.classList.remove('drag-over'); });
        el.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault(); this.classList.remove('drag-over');
            if (!draggedEl || this === draggedEl) return;
            const fromId = parseInt(draggedEl.dataset.foodId);
            const toId = parseInt(this.dataset.foodId);
            const fromIdx = State.foods.findIndex(f => f.id === fromId);
            const toIdx = State.foods.findIndex(f => f.id === toId);
            if (fromIdx === -1 || toIdx === -1) return;
            const [moved] = State.foods.splice(fromIdx, 1);
            State.foods.splice(toIdx, 0, moved);
            posFilter();
        });
    });
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  CART SYSTEM (Ø¨Ø§ Drag & Drop)
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

function addToCart(foodId) {
    const food = Utils.getFoodById(foodId); if (!food||food.stock<=0) return;
    const ex = State.cart.find(c => c.id === foodId);
    if (ex) { if (food.maxPerOrder && ex.qty >= food.maxPerOrder) { showToast(`Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ú©Ø«Ø± ${Utils.toPersianNum(food.maxPerOrder)} Ø¹Ø¯Ø¯`, 'warning'); return; } ex.qty++; }
    else State.cart.push({ id:food.id, name:food.name, price:Utils.getDiscountedPrice(food), originalPrice:food.price, qty:1, category:food.category });
    renderCart(); posFilter();
    if (window.innerWidth<=768) document.querySelector('.pos-cart')?.classList.add('open');
}

function removeFromCart(foodId) {
    const i = State.cart.findIndex(c => c.id === foodId); if (i===-1) return;
    if (State.cart[i].qty>1) State.cart[i].qty--; else State.cart.splice(i,1);
    renderCart(); posFilter();
}

function renderCart() {
    const c = $('posCartItems'); const tq = State.cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.qty,0);
    const total = State.cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.price*i.qty,0);
    const orig = State.cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.originalPrice*i.qty,0);
    const sav = orig - total;
    $('posCartCount').textContent = Utils.toPersianNum(tq);
    const fb = $('mobileFabBadge'); if (fb) fb.classList.toggle('hide', tq===0);
    if ($('fabCartPrice')) $('fabCartPrice').textContent = Utils.formatPriceShort(total)+' Øª';

    if (!State.cart.length) {
        c.innerHTML = '<div class="pos-cart-empty"><i class="bi bi-cart-x"></i><p>ØºØ°Ø§ÛŒÛŒ Ø§Ù†ØªØ®Ø§Ø¨ Ù†Ø´Ø¯Ù‡</p></div>';
        $('posTotal').textContent = 'Û° ØªÙˆÙ…Ø§Ù†'; $('posCheckout').disabled = true;
        $('originalTotalRow')?.classList.remove('show'); $('savingsRow')?.classList.remove('show');
        return;
    }

    c.innerHTML = State.cart.map(item => `
        <div class="pos-cart-item" draggable="true" data-food-id="${item.id}">
            <div class="pos-cart-item-info">
                <div class="pos-cart-item-name">${item.name}</div>
                <div class="pos-cart-item-price">${Utils.formatPrice(item.price*item.qty)}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="pos-cart-item-controls">
                <button class="pos-cart-btn pos-cart-btn-minus" onclick="event.stopPropagation();removeFromCart(${item.id})">${item.qty===1?'<i class="bi bi-trash"></i>':'âˆ’'}</button>
                <span class="pos-cart-qty">${Utils.toPersianNum(item.qty)}</span>
                <button class="pos-cart-btn pos-cart-btn-plus" onclick="event.stopPropagation();addToCart(${item.id})">+</button>
            </div>
        </div>`).join('');

    $('posTotal').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(total);
    $('posCheckout').disabled = false;

    if (sav > 0) { $('originalTotal').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(orig); $('savingsTotal').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(sav); $('originalTotalRow')?.classList.add('show'); $('savingsRow')?.classList.add('show'); }
    else { $('originalTotalRow')?.classList.remove('show'); $('savingsRow')?.classList.remove('show'); }

    initCartDragDrop();
}

function initCartDragDrop() {
    const container = $('posCartItems'); if (!container) return;
    let draggedEl = null;
    container.querySelectorAll('.pos-cart-item[draggable]').forEach(el => {
        el.addEventListener('dragstart', function(e) { draggedEl = this; this.classList.add('dragging'); e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move'; e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', this.dataset.foodId); });
        el.addEventListener('dragend', function() { this.classList.remove('dragging'); container.querySelectorAll('.drag-over').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('drag-over')); draggedEl = null; });
        el.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move'; });
        el.addEventListener('dragenter', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); if (this!==draggedEl) this.classList.add('drag-over'); });
        el.addEventListener('dragleave', function() { this.classList.remove('drag-over'); });
        el.addEventListener('drop', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); this.classList.remove('drag-over'); if (!draggedEl||this===draggedEl) return; const fi=State.cart.findIndex(c=>c.id===parseInt(draggedEl.dataset.foodId)); const ti=State.cart.findIndex(c=>c.id===parseInt(this.dataset.foodId)); if (fi===-1||ti===-1) return; const [m]=State.cart.splice(fi,1); State.cart.splice(ti,0,m); renderCart(); });
    });
}

async function applyDiscount(foodId) {
    const card=$(`discCard-${foodId}`); const tb=card.querySelector('.disc-type-btn.active'); const inp=$(`discVal-${foodId}`);
    const type=tb?.textContent?.includes('Ø¯Ø±ØµØ¯')?'percent':'amount'; const val=parseInt(inp?.value);
    if(isNaN(val)||val<=0)return showToast('Ù…Ù‚Ø¯Ø§Ø± ØªØ®ÙÛŒÙ Ø±Ø§ ÙˆØ§Ø±Ø¯ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯','error');
    const food=Utils.getFoodById(foodId);
    if(type==='percent'&&val>100)return showToast('Ø¯Ø±ØµØ¯ Ù†Ø§Ù…Ø¹ØªØ¨Ø±','error');
    if(type==='amount'&&val>=food.price)return showToast('Ù…Ø¨Ù„Øº Ù†Ø§Ù…Ø¹ØªØ¨Ø±','error');
    State.discounts[foodId]={type,value:val}; localStorage.setItem('pos_discounts',JSON.stringify(State.discounts));
    const ok=await syncFoodUpdate(foodId,food.price,`ØªØ®ÙÛŒÙ "${food.name}" Ø§Ø¹Ù…Ø§Ù„ Ø´Ø¯`);
    if(ok){card.classList.add('just-applied');setTimeout(()=>card.classList.remove('just-applied'),700);}
}

async function removeDiscount(foodId) {
    const food=Utils.getFoodById(foodId); if(!food)return;
    delete State.discounts[foodId]; localStorage.setItem('pos_discounts',JSON.stringify(State.discounts));
    const ok=await syncFoodUpdate(foodId,food.price,`ØªØ®ÙÛŒÙ "${food.name}" Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´Ø¯`);
    const card=$(`discCard-${foodId}`); if(ok&&card){card.classList.add('just-removed');setTimeout(()=>card.classList.remove('just-removed'),700);}
}

function updateDiscStats() {

    const pd=Object.values(State.discounts).filter(d=>d.type==='percent');
    if(pd.length&&$('discAvgPercent'))$('discAvgPercent').textContent=Utils.toPersianNum(Math.round(pd.reduce((s,d)=>s+d.value,0)/pd.length))+'%';

function updateCreditInfo() {
    const sel = $('creditSubscriber'); if (!sel||!sel.value) { $('creditInfoBox').style.display='none'; return; }
    const sub = getSubscriberById(parseInt(sel.value)); if (!sub) return;
    const avail = Math.max(0, sub.creditLimit - sub.debt);
    const amount = parseInt($('payModal').dataset.amount);
    $('creditInfoBox').style.display = 'block';
    $('cLimit').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(sub.creditLimit);
    $('cDebt').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(sub.debt);
    $('cAvail').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(avail);
    if (amount > avail) { $('creditWarn').style.display='flex'; $('creditConfirmBtn').disabled=true; $('creditConfirmBtn').style.opacity='.5'; }
    else { $('creditWarn').style.display='none'; $('creditConfirmBtn').disabled=false; $('creditConfirmBtn').style.opacity='1'; }
}

function processPayment(method) {
    const modal = $('payModal');
    const amount = parseInt(modal.dataset.amount);
    const custName = modal.dataset.custName;
    const custPhone = modal.dataset.custPhone;

    let subscriberId = null, subscriberName = '';
    if (method === 'credit') {
        const sel = $('creditSubscriber');
        if (!sel||!sel.value) { showToast('Ù…Ø´ØªØ±Ú© Ø±Ø§ Ø§Ù†ØªØ®Ø§Ø¨ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯','error'); return; }

            <div class="pay-header-icon"><i class="bi ${Utils.paymentMethodIcon(method)}"></i></div>
            <div class="pay-header-title">${Utils.paymentMethodLabel(method)}</div>
            <div class="pay-header-sub">Ø¯Ø± Ø­Ø§Ù„ Ù¾Ø±Ø¯Ø§Ø²Ø´...</div>

            <div class="pay-status waiting"><span class="pay-spinner"></span><span>Ø¯Ø± Ø­Ø§Ù„ Ø«Ø¨Øª Ø³ÙØ§Ø±Ø´...</span></div>
        </div>`;

            discount: State.cart.reduce((s,c) => s + (c.originalPrice - c.price) * c.qty, 0),
            customerName: subscriberName || custName || 'Ù…Ø´ØªØ±ÛŒ', customerPhone: custPhone,
            time: Utils.nowTimeStr(), date: Utils.todayDateStr(), dateISO: Utils.todayISO(),

function showReceipt(order) {

    $('receiptCust').textContent = order.customerName || 'Ù…Ø´ØªØ±ÛŒ';
    $('receiptTotal').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(order.total);
    $('receiptItems').innerHTML = order.items.map(item =>
        `<div class="pos-receipt-item"><span class="pos-receipt-item-name">${item.name} Ã— ${Utils.toPersianNum(item.qty)}</span><span class="pos-receipt-item-detail">${Utils.formatPrice(item.price*item.qty)}</span></div>`
    ).join('') + `
        <div style="padding:8px 0;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center">
            <span class="receipt-order-type"><i class="bi ${Utils.orderTypeIcon(order.orderType)}"></i> ${Utils.orderTypeLabel(order.orderType)}${order.tableNumber?' â€” Ù…ÛŒØ² '+order.tableNumber:''}</span>
            <span class="receipt-payment-method"><i class="bi ${Utils.paymentMethodIcon(order.paymentMethod)}"></i> ${Utils.paymentMethodLabel(order.paymentMethod)}</span>
            ${order.isCredit?'<span class="badge-credit"><i class="bi bi-person-badge"></i> Ù†Ø³ÛŒÙ‡</span>':''}
        </div>`;
    $('posReceiptModal').classList.add('show');
}

function loadCloseSummary() {
    const today = State.todayOrders;
    const total = today.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.total,0);
    const delivered = today.filter(o=>o.status==='delivered').length;
    const pending = today.filter(o=>o.status!=='delivered'&&o.status!=='cancelled').length;
    if ($('closeTotalSales')) $('closeTotalSales').textContent = Utils.formatPrice(total);
    if ($('closeOrderCount')) $('closeOrderCount').textContent = Utils.toPersianNum(today.length);
    if ($('closeDelivered')) $('closeDelivered').textContent = Utils.toPersianNum(delivered);
    if ($('closePending')) $('closePending').textContent = Utils.toPersianNum(pending);

    const openCard = $('closeOpenOrdersCard'), openList = $('closeOpenOrders');
    const openOrders = today.filter(o=>o.status!=='delivered'&&o.status!=='cancelled');
    if (openCard && openList) {
        if (openOrders.length) { openCard.style.display = 'block'; openList.innerHTML = openOrders.map(o=>`<div class="close-row"><span class="close-row-label">#${o.id} â€” ${o.customerName||'â€”'}</span><span class="close-row-val yellow">${Utils.formatPrice(o.total)}</span></div>`).join(''); }
        else openCard.style.display = 'none';
    }
    populateWasteSelects();
}

function switchTab(tabId) {
    closeFabMenu();
    document.querySelector('.pos-cart')?.classList.remove('open');
    document.querySelectorAll('.pos-tab,.pos-panel').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelector(`.pos-tab[data-tab="${tabId}"]`)?.classList.add('active');
    $(`panel-${tabId}`)?.classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.fab-menu-item').forEach(f=>f.classList.toggle('active',f.dataset.tab===tabId));
    const loaders = {report:loadReport,close:loadCloseSummary,history:loadHistory,discount:renderDiscounts,online:renderOnlineOrders};
    if (loaders[tabId]) loaders[tabId]();
}

function toggleFabMenu() { const m=$('mobileFabMenu'); if(m.classList.contains('show'))closeFabMenu(); else{$('mobileFabBtn').classList.add('open');m.classList.add('show');$('fabOverlay').classList.add('show');} }
function closeFabMenu() { $('mobileFabBtn')?.classList.remove('open');$('mobileFabMenu')?.classList.remove('show');$('fabOverlay')?.classList.remove('show'); }
function fabOpenCart() { closeFabMenu(); if(window.innerWidth<=768)document.querySelector('.pos-cart')?.classList.add('open'); }

}

<script>
var rmTbody = document.getElementById('rm-tbody');
var rmOverlay = document.getElementById('rm-modal-overlay');
var rmModalTitle = document.getElementById('rm-modal-title');
var rmMId = document.getElementById('rm-m-id');
var rmMName = document.getElementById('rm-m-name');
var rmMLabel = document.getElementById('rm-m-label');
var rmMPrice = document.getElementById('rm-m-price');
var rmMQty = document.getElementById('rm-m-qty');
var rmMUnit = document.getElementById('rm-m-unit');
var rmSearch = document.getElementById('rm-search-input');

function rmGetCookie(name) {
    var v = null;
    document.cookie.split(';').forEach(function(c) {
        c = c.trim();
        if (c.startsWith(name + '=')) v = decodeURIComponent(c.slice(name.length + 1));
    });
    return v;
}

function rmToast(msg, type) {
    type = type || 'success';
    var box = document.getElementById('rm-toast-box');
    var t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'rm-toast rm-toast-' + type;
    t.textContent = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){ t.classList.add('show'); });
    setTimeout(function(){ t.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(function(){ t.remove(); }, 350); }, 3500);
}

function rmToPersian(n) {
    var d = 'Û°Û±Û²Û³Û´ÛµÛ¶Û·Û¸Û¹';
    return String(n).replace(/\d/g, function(c){ return d[c]; });
}

function rmFormatPrice(n) {
    return rmToPersian(Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en'));
}

function rmAddCommas(raw) {
    if (!raw && raw !== '0') return '';
    var s = String(raw).replace(/,/g, '');
    return s.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
}

function rmStripCommas(s) {
    return parseInt(String(s).replace(/,/g, ''), 10) || 0;
}

rmMPrice.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
    var input = e.target, cursorPos = input.selectionStart, oldVal = input.value;
    var raw = oldVal.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
    if (!raw) { input.value = ''; input.dataset.rawValue = '0'; return; }
    var formatted = rmAddCommas(raw);
    input.value = formatted;
    input.dataset.rawValue = raw;
    var diff = formatted.length - oldVal.length;
    input.setSelectionRange(cursorPos + diff, cursorPos + diff);
});

// â”€â”€ Stats â”€â”€
function rmUpdateStats() {
    var rows = rmTbody.querySelectorAll('tr[data-id]');
    var totalVal = 0, ok = 0, low = 0, out = 0;
    rows.forEach(function(r) {
        if (r.style.display === 'none') return;
        var qty = parseInt(r.dataset.qty) || 0;
        var price = parseInt(r.dataset.price) || 0;
        totalVal += qty * price;
        if (qty <= 0) out++;
        else if (qty < 5) low++;
        else ok++;
    });
    document.getElementById('rm-stat-total').textContent = rmToPersian(rows.length);
    document.getElementById('rm-stat-sum').textContent = rmFormatPrice(totalVal);
    document.getElementById('rm-stat-ok').textContent = rmToPersian(ok);
    document.getElementById('rm-stat-low').textContent = rmToPersian(low);
    document.getElementById('rm-stat-out').textContent = rmToPersian(out);
}

// â”€â”€ Modal â”€â”€
function rmOpenModal(title, data) {
    rmModalTitle.textContent = title;
    rmMId.value = data ? data.id : '';
    rmMName.value = data ? data.name : '';
    rmMLabel.value = data ? data.label : '';
    rmMPrice.value = data ? rmAddCommas(data.price) : '';
    if (data) rmMPrice.dataset.rawValue = data.price;
    rmMQty.value = data ? data.qty : '';
    rmMUnit.value = data ? data.unit : 'unit';
    document.getElementById('rm-m-type').value = data ? (data.material_type || 'raw') : 'raw';
    rmOverlay.classList.add('active');
    rmMName.focus();
}

function rmCloseModal() {
    rmOverlay.classList.remove('active');
}

document.getElementById('rm-modal-cancel').addEventListener('click', rmCloseModal);
rmOverlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === rmOverlay) rmCloseModal();
});

// â”€â”€ Add â”€â”€
document.getElementById('rm-add-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    rmOpenModal('Ø§ÙØ²ÙˆØ¯Ù† Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø§ÙˆÙ„ÛŒÙ‡', null);
});

// â”€â”€ Edit / Delete â”€â”€
rmTbody.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var editBtn = e.target.closest('.rm-edit-btn');
    var delBtn = e.target.closest('.rm-del');

    if (editBtn) {
        var tr = editBtn.closest('tr');
        rmOpenModal('ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´ Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø§ÙˆÙ„ÛŒÙ‡', {
            id: tr.dataset.id, name: tr.dataset.name, label: tr.dataset.label,
            price: tr.dataset.price, qty: tr.dataset.qty, unit: tr.dataset.unit
        });
    }

    if (delBtn) {
        var tr = delBtn.closest('tr');
        if (!confirm('Ø¢ÛŒØ§ Â«' + tr.dataset.name + 'Â» Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´ÙˆØ¯ØŸ')) return;
        var fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('id', tr.dataset.id);
        fetch('/api/raw-materials/delete/', {
            method: 'POST', body: fd,
            headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': rmGetCookie('csrftoken') }
        })
        .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
        .then(function(d) {
            if (d.success) {
                tr.style.transition = 'opacity .3s';
                tr.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(function(){ tr.remove(); rmRenumber(); rmUpdateStats(); }, 300);
                rmToast(d.msg);
            } else {
                rmToast(d.error, 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(function(){ rmToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø§Ø±ØªØ¨Ø§Ø·', 'error'); });
    }
});

// â”€â”€ Save â”€â”€
document.getElementById('rm-modal-save').addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (!rmMName.value.trim()) { rmToast('Ù†Ø§Ù… Ú©Ø§Ù„Ø§ Ø§Ù„Ø²Ø§Ù…ÛŒ Ø§Ø³Øª.', 'error'); return; }
    var fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('id', rmMId.value);
    fd.append('name', rmMName.value.trim());
    fd.append('label', rmMLabel.value.trim());
    fd.append('price', rmMPrice.dataset.rawValue || rmStripCommas(rmMPrice.value) || 0);
    fd.append('quantity', rmMQty.value || 0);
    fd.append('unit', rmMUnit.value);
    fd.append('material_type', document.getElementById('rm-m-type').value);
    fetch('/api/raw-materials/save/', {
        method: 'POST', body: fd,
        headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': rmGetCookie('csrftoken') }
    })
    .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d) {
        if (d.success) {
            rmCloseModal();
            if (rmMId.value) {
                var tr = rmTbody.querySelector('tr[data-id="' + rmMId.value + '"]');
                rmUpdateRow(tr, d.item);
                rmToast('ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´ Ø´Ø¯.');
            } else {
                var emptyRow = rmTbody.querySelector('.rm-empty-row');
                if (emptyRow) emptyRow.remove();
                var tr = rmCreateRow(d.item);
                rmTbody.appendChild(tr);
                rmToast('Ø§Ø¶Ø§ÙÙ‡ Ø´Ø¯.');
            }
            rmRenumber();
            rmUpdateStats();
        } else {
            rmToast(d.error, 'error');
        }
    })
    .catch(function(){ rmToast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø§Ø±ØªØ¨Ø§Ø·', 'error'); });
});

function rmCreateRow(item) {
    var tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.dataset.id = item.id;
    tr.dataset.name = item.name;
    tr.dataset.label = item.label;
    tr.dataset.price = item.price;
    tr.dataset.qty = item.quantity;
    tr.dataset.unit = item.unit;
    rmBuildCells(tr, item);
    return tr;
}

function rmUpdateRow(tr, item) {
    tr.dataset.name = item.name;
    tr.dataset.label = item.label;
    tr.dataset.price = item.price;
    tr.dataset.qty = item.quantity;
    tr.dataset.unit = item.unit;
    rmBuildCells(tr, item);
}

function rmBuildCells(tr, item) {
    var statusHtml = '';
    if (item.quantity <= 0) statusHtml = '<span class="rm-status rm-status-out">Ù†Ø§Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯</span>';
    else if (item.quantity < 5) statusHtml = '<span class="rm-status rm-status-low">Ú©Ù…</span>';
    else statusHtml = '<span class="rm-status rm-status-ok">Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯</span>';

    tr.innerHTML =
        '<td style="font-weight:600;color:var(--rm-text-sec)"></td>' +
        '<td style="font-weight:600">' + item.name + '</td>' +
        '<td style="color:var(--rm-text-sec)">' + (item.label || 'â€”') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + rmFormatPrice(item.price) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-weight:600">' + rmFormatPrice(item.quantity) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + item.unit_display + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-weight:700;color:var(--rm-accent)">' + rmFormatPrice(item.total) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + statusHtml + '</td>' +
        '<td><div class="rm-actions">' +
            '<button class="rm-btn-icon rm-edit-btn" title="ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7"/><path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z"/></svg></button>' +
            '<button class="rm-btn-icon rm-del" title="Ø­Ø°Ù"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/></svg></button>' +
        '</div></td>';
}

// â”€â”€ Format initial table â”€â”€
function rmFormatTable() {
    rmTbody.querySelectorAll('tr[data-id]').forEach(function(tr) {
        var cells = tr.querySelectorAll('td');
        var p = parseInt(tr.dataset.price) || 0;
        var q = parseInt(tr.dataset.qty) || 0;
        if (p >= 1000) cells[3].textContent = rmFormatPrice(p);
        if (q >= 1000) cells[4].textContent = rmFormatPrice(q);
        var t = q * p;
        if (t >= 1000) cells[6].textContent = rmFormatPrice(t);
    });
}

function rmRenumber() {
    rmTbody.querySelectorAll('tr[data-id]').forEach(function(tr, i) {
        tr.querySelector('td').textContent = rmToPersian(i + 1);
    });
}

// â”€â”€ Search â”€â”€
rmSearch.addEventListener('input', function() {
    var q = rmSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    rmTbody.querySelectorAll('tr[data-id]').forEach(function(tr) {
        var nm = (tr.dataset.name || '').toLowerCase();
        var lb = (tr.dataset.label || '').toLowerCase();
        tr.style.display = (!q || nm.indexOf(q) !== -1 || lb.indexOf(q) !== -1) ? '' : 'none';
    });
    rmUpdateStats();
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') rmCloseModal();
});

// â”€â”€ Init â”€â”€
rmRenumber();
rmUpdateStats();
rmFormatTable();
</script>

<script>
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  Ú©Ù…Ú©ÛŒ
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
function rmToPersian(n) {
    var d = '\u06F0\u06F1\u06F2\u06F3\u06F4\u06F5\u06F6\u06F7\u06F8\u06F9';
    return String(n).replace(/\d/g, function(c){ return d[c]; });
}

function rmToast(msg, type) {
    type = type || 'success';
    var box = document.getElementById('rm-toast-box');
    var t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'rm-toast rm-toast-' + type;
    t.textContent = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){ t.classList.add('show'); });
    setTimeout(function(){ t.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(function(){ t.remove(); }, 350); }, 3500);
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  Ø¢Ù…Ø§Ø±
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
function rmUpdateStats() {
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#rm-tbody tr[data-id]');
    var inStock = 0, outStock = 0;
    rows.forEach(function(r) {
        if (r.style.display === 'none') return;
        var inStockVal = r.dataset.inStock;
        if (inStockVal === 'true') inStock++;
        else outStock++;
    });
    document.getElementById('rm-stat-total').textContent = rmToPersian(inStock + outStock);
    document.getElementById('rm-stat-instock').textContent = rmToPersian(inStock);
    document.getElementById('rm-stat-outstock').textContent = rmToPersian(outStock);
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  Ø¬Ø³ØªØ¬Ùˆ
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
var rmSearch = document.getElementById('rm-search-input');
rmSearch.addEventListener('input', function() {
    var q = rmSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    document.querySelectorAll('#rm-tbody tr[data-id]').forEach(function(tr) {
        var nm = (tr.dataset.name || '').toLowerCase();
        tr.style.display = (!q || nm.indexOf(q) !== -1) ? '' : 'none';
    });
    rmUpdateStats();
});

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  Ú©Ø§ÙˆØ± Ù†Ø§Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
function rmAddCovers() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#rm-tbody tr.rm-row-unavailable').forEach(function(tr) {
        var statusCell = tr.querySelector('td:last-child');
        if (statusCell && !statusCell.querySelector('.rm-unavail-cover')) {
            var cover = document.createElement('div');
            cover.className = 'rm-unavail-cover';
            cover.innerHTML = '<span class="rm-unavail-tag">Ù†Ø§Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ Ø¯Ø± Ø§Ù†Ø¨Ø§Ø±</span>';
            statusCell.style.position = 'relative';
            statusCell.appendChild(cover);
        }
    });
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
//  Ù…Ø­Ø§Ø³Ø¨Ù‡ Ø§Ø±Ø²Ø´ Ú©Ù„
// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
function rmCalcValues() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#rm-tbody tr[data-id]').forEach(function(tr) {
        var qty = parseFloat(tr.dataset.qty);
        var price = parseInt(tr.dataset.price);
        var cells = tr.querySelectorAll('td');
        // Ø³ØªÙˆÙ† Û¶ = Ø§Ø±Ø²Ø´ Ú©Ù„ (index 5)
        if (cells[5] && qty >= 0 && price > 0) {
            cells[5].textContent = (qty * price).toLocaleString('en');
            cells[5].style.fontWeight = '700';
            cells[5].style.color = 'var(--rm-accent)';
        }
    });
}

// â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

rmCalcValues();
rmAddCovers();
rmUpdateStats();

var PERSIAN_DIGITS = ['Û°','Û±','Û²','Û³','Û´','Ûµ','Û¶','Û·','Û¸','Û¹'];

function toPersianNum(n) {
  return String(n).replace(/\d/g, function(d){ return PERSIAN_DIGITS[+d]; });
}

function formatPrice(amount) {
  var parts = Number(amount).toLocaleString('en-US').split(',');
  return toPersianNum(parts.join(','));
}

function formatTime(d) {
  var h = d.getHours(), m = d.getMinutes();
  return toPersianNum(h < 10 ? '0'+h : h) + ':' + toPersianNum(m < 10 ? '0'+m : m);
}

function receiptNum(id) {
  return toPersianNum(id || Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000));
}

function esc(s) {
  var d = document.createElement('div');
  d.textContent = s || '';
  return d.innerHTML;
}

   Customer Receipt

function getCSRF() {
    var cookies = document.cookie.split(';');

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• CACHE â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
var cacheDet = {};
var CACHE_MAX = 50;
var CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000;

function cacheSet(id, data) {
    var keys = Object.keys(cacheDet);
    if (keys.length >= CACHE_MAX) delete cacheDet[keys[0]];
    cacheDet[id] = { data: data, ts: Date.now() };
}
function cacheGet(id) {
    var e = cacheDet[id];
    if (!e) return null;
    if (Date.now() - e.ts > CACHE_TTL) { delete cacheDet[id]; return null; }
    return e.data;
}

function normalizeUnit(u) {

function safeFetchJson(r) {
    return r.text().then(function (t) {
        if (!r.ok) {
            var e = {};
            try { e = JSON.parse(t); } catch (x) { e = { detail: t || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§' }; }
            throw e;
        }
        if (!t || !t.trim()) return {};
        try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch (x) { return {}; }
    });
}

function debounce(fn, ms) {
    var t;
    return function () {
        var ctx = this, args = arguments;
        clearTimeout(t);
        t = setTimeout(function () { fn.apply(ctx, args); }, ms);
    };
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• TOAST â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
function toast(msg, type) {
    var ex = document.querySelector('.rp-toast');
    if (ex) ex.remove();
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'rp-toast ' + (type || 'success');
    el.textContent = msg;
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(function () { if (el.parentNode) el.remove(); }, 3500);
}

function findRawById(rawId) {
    if (!rawId) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < allRawMaterials.length; i++) {
        if (allRawMaterials[i].id === rawId) return allRawMaterials[i];
    }
    return null;
}

function findSemiById(semiId) {
    if (!semiId) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < allSemiForPick.length; i++) {
        if (allSemiForPick[i].id === semiId) return allSemiForPick[i];
    }
    return null;
}

function findPackagingById(pkId) {
    if (!pkId) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < allPackagingMaterials.length; i++) {
        if (allPackagingMaterials[i].id === pkId) return allPackagingMaterials[i];
    }
    return null;
}

function getRawUnit(rawId) { var r = findRawById(rawId); return r ? (r.unit_display || r.unit || '') : ''; }

function getRawPrice(rawId) { if (!rawId) return 0; var r = findRawById(rawId); return r ? (parseFloat(r.price) || 0) : 0; }
function getSemiStock(semiId) { if (!semiId) return 0; var s = findSemiById(semiId); return s ? (parseFloat(s.quantity_produced) || 0) : 0; }
