function findRawPrice(name) {
    name = (name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!name) return 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < allRawMaterials.length; i++) {
        if ((allRawMaterials[i].name || '').trim().toLowerCase() === name)
            return parseFloat(allRawMaterials[i].price) || 0;
    }
    for (var j = 0; j < allRawMaterials.length; j++) {
        var rn = (allRawMaterials[j].name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (rn.indexOf(name) !== -1 || name.indexOf(rn) !== -1)
            return parseFloat(allRawMaterials[j].price) || 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

function findPackagingPrice(name) {
    name = (name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!name) return 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < allPackagingMaterials.length; i++) {
        if ((allPackagingMaterials[i].name || '').trim().toLowerCase() === name)
            return parseFloat(allPackagingMaterials[i].price) || 0;
    }
    for (var j = 0; j < allPackagingMaterials.length; j++) {
        var pn = (allPackagingMaterials[j].name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (pn.indexOf(name) !== -1 || name.indexOf(pn) !== -1)
            return parseFloat(allPackagingMaterials[j].price) || 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• SEMI COST & INGREDIENTS â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
function getSemiCost(semiId) {
    var s = findSemiById(semiId);
    if (!s) return 0;
    var cpu = parseFloat(s.cost_per_unit) || 0;
    if (cpu) return cpu;
    if (s.ingredients && s.ingredients.length) {
        var total = 0;
        s.ingredients.forEach(function (ig) {
            var rid = ig.raw_material_id || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' ? ig.raw_material.id : ig.raw_material);
            var pr = parseFloat(ig.price || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' && ig.raw_material ? ig.raw_material.price : 0)) || 0;
            if (!pr && rid) pr = getRawPrice(rid);
            total += (parseFloat(ig.quantity) || 0) * pr;
        });
        return total;
    }
    return calcSemiCostFromDesc(s);
}

function getSemiIngredients(s) {
    if (!s) return [];
    if (s.ingredients && s.ingredients.length) {
        return s.ingredients.map(function (ig) {
            var rid = ig.raw_material_id || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' ? ig.raw_material.id : ig.raw_material);
            var rn = ig.raw_material_name || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' && ig.raw_material ? ig.raw_material.name : '') || '';
            var qty = parseFloat(ig.quantity) || 0;
            var unit = ig.unit || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' && ig.raw_material ? ig.raw_material.unit : '');
            var pr = parseFloat(ig.price || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' && ig.raw_material ? ig.raw_material.price : 0)) || 0;
            if (!pr && rid) pr = getRawPrice(rid);
            if (!pr && rn) pr = findRawPrice(rn);
            return { name: rn, unit: unit, qty: qty, price: pr };
        });
    }
    var parsed = parseDescIngredients(s.description || '');
    return parsed.map(function (ig) { return { name: ig.name, unit: ig.unit, qty: ig.qty, price: findRawPrice(ig.name) }; });
}

function parseDescIngredients(desc) {
    if (!desc) return [];
    var body = desc;
    var prefixes = ['Ù…ÙˆØ§Ø¯ Ù…ØµØ±ÙÛŒ:', 'Ù…ÙˆØ§Ø¯:'];
    for (var p = 0; p < prefixes.length; p++) { var idx = desc.indexOf(prefixes[p]); if (idx !== -1) { body = desc.substring(idx + prefixes[p].length); break; } }
    var parts = body.split('|'), result = [];
    for (var j = 0; j < parts.length; j++) {
        var part = parts[j].trim(); if (!part) continue;
        var op = part.indexOf('('), cp = part.indexOf(')');
        if (op > 0 && cp > op) {
            var name = part.substring(0, op).trim(), unit = part.substring(op + 1, cp).trim();
            var colon = part.indexOf(':', cp), qty = 0;
            if (colon > cp) { var ac = part.substring(colon + 1).trim(), ns = ''; for (var k = 0; k < ac.length; k++) { var ch = ac[k]; if ((ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') || ch === '.') ns += ch; else if (ns) break; } qty = parseFloat(ns) || 0; }
            if (name && qty > 0) result.push({ name: name, unit: unit, qty: qty });
        }
    }
    return result;
}

function calcSemiCostFromDesc(semiObj) {
    var ings = parseDescIngredients(semiObj.description || '');
    if (!ings.length) return 0;
    var total = 0;
    for (var m = 0; m < ings.length; m++) total += ings[m].qty * findRawPrice(ings[m].name);
    return total;
}

function parseRecipeInstructions(instructions) {
    if (!instructions) return { raws: [], semis: [], packs: [] };
    var lines = instructions.split('\n'), raws = [], semis = [], packs = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        var line = lines[i].trim(); if (!line) continue;
        var isSemi = false, isPack = false;
        if (line.indexOf('[Ù†ÛŒÙ…Ù‡]') === 0) { isSemi = true; line = line.substring(6).trim(); }
        else if (line.indexOf('[Ø¨Ø³ØªÙ‡]') === 0) { isPack = true; line = line.substring(6).trim(); }
        var colon = line.indexOf(':'); if (colon === -1) continue;
        var name = line.substring(0, colon).trim(), after = line.substring(colon + 1).trim();
        var si = after.indexOf(' '), qty = parseFloat(si > -1 ? after.substring(0, si) : after) || 0;
        var unit = normalizeUnit(si > -1 ? after.substring(si + 1).trim() : '');
        if (!name || qty <= 0) continue;
        if (isSemi) {
            var semiId = null;
            for (var sj = 0; sj < allSemiForPick.length; sj++) { if (allSemiForPick[sj].name === name) { semiId = allSemiForPick[sj].id; break; } }
            if (!semiId) for (var sj2 = 0; sj2 < allSemiForPick.length; sj2++) { var sn = allSemiForPick[sj2].name || ''; if (sn.indexOf(name) !== -1 || name.indexOf(sn) !== -1) { semiId = allSemiForPick[sj2].id; break; } }
            semis.push({ semi_finished_id: semiId, semi_finished_name: name, quantity: qty, unit: unit });
        } else if (isPack) {
            var pkId = null;
            for (var pk = 0; pk < allPackagingMaterials.length; pk++) { if (allPackagingMaterials[pk].name === name) { pkId = allPackagingMaterials[pk].id; break; } }
            if (!pkId) for (var pk2 = 0; pk2 < allPackagingMaterials.length; pk2++) { var pn = allPackagingMaterials[pk2].name || ''; if (pn.indexOf(name) !== -1 || name.indexOf(pn) !== -1) { pkId = allPackagingMaterials[pk2].id; break; } }
            packs.push({ packaging_material_id: pkId, packaging_material_name: name, quantity: qty, unit: unit });
        } else {
            var rawId = null;
            for (var rk = 0; rk < allRawMaterials.length; rk++) { if (allRawMaterials[rk].name === name) { rawId = allRawMaterials[rk].id; break; } }
            if (!rawId) for (var rk2 = 0; rk2 < allRawMaterials.length; rk2++) { var rn = allRawMaterials[rk2].name || ''; if (rn.indexOf(name) !== -1 || name.indexOf(rn) !== -1) { rawId = allRawMaterials[rk2].id; break; } }
            raws.push({ raw_material_id: rawId, raw_material_name: name, quantity: qty, unit: unit });
        }
    }
    return { raws: raws, semis: semis, packs: packs };
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• OVER-STOCK & COST HELPERS â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
function isOverStock(el, stock, qty) {
    if (!el) return false;
    if (stock > 0 && qty > stock) { el.style.borderColor = 'var(--rp-danger)'; el.style.background = 'var(--rp-danger-bg)'; el.title = 'Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ: ' + toP(stock); return true; }
    el.style.borderColor = ''; el.style.background = ''; el.title = ''; return false;
}

/* â˜…â˜…â˜… setAllCosts â€” Ù…Ù‚Ø§ÙˆÙ… Ø¯Ø± Ø¨Ø±Ø§Ø¨Ø± Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø§Ù†â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ÛŒ ØºØ§ÛŒØ¨ â˜…â˜…â˜… */
function setAllCosts(rawCost, semiCost, packagingCost, totalCost, perUnit) {
    var pairs = [
        ['costRaw', rawCost],
        ['costSemi', semiCost],
        ['costPackaging', packagingCost],
        ['costTotal', totalCost],
        ['costPerServing', perUnit]
    ];
    for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
        var el = document.getElementById(pairs[i][0]);
        if (!el) continue;
        var v = fmtPrice(Math.round(pairs[i][1] || 0));
        if (el.tagName === 'INPUT' || el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') el.value = v; else el.textContent = v;
    }
}

function loadRecipeGroups() {
    return fetch(API.groups, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRF() } })
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(res) {
        recipeGroups = (res.groups || res || []).filter(function(g) { return g.usage_recipes; });
        updateActiveSections();
        return recipeGroups;
    }).catch(function() { recipeGroups = []; return []; });
}

function updateActiveSections() {
    /* Ù¾ÛŒØ´â€ŒÙØ±Ø¶: Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ ÙØ¹Ø§Ù„ (Ø§Ú¯Ø± API Ø¬ÙˆØ§Ø¨ Ù†Ø¯Ø§Ø¯) */
    activeSections = { raw: true, semi: true, packaging: true };
    if (!recipeGroups.length) return;

    /* Ø§ÙˆÙ„ Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ false Ú©Ù† */
    activeSections = { raw: false, semi: false, packaging: false };

    for (var i = 0; i < recipeGroups.length; i++) {
        var g = recipeGroups[i];
        var t = (g.type || g.item_type || g.slug || '').toLowerCase();
        var n = (g.name || '').toLowerCase();

        if (t === 'raw' || t === 'raw_material' || t === 'raw_materials' || n.indexOf('Ø§ÙˆÙ„ÛŒÙ‡') !== -1)
            activeSections.raw = true;
        else if (t === 'semi' || t === 'semi_finished' || t === 'semifinished' || n.indexOf('Ù†ÛŒÙ…Ù‡') !== -1)
            activeSections.semi = true;
        else if (t === 'packaging' || t === 'pack' || n.indexOf('Ø¨Ø³ØªÙ‡') !== -1 || n.indexOf('Ø¬Ø¹Ø¨Ù‡') !== -1)
            activeSections.packaging = true;
    }
}

function applyGroupVisibility() {
    var els = document.querySelectorAll('[data-group-type]');
    for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
        var type = els[i].getAttribute('data-group-type');
        if (activeSections.hasOwnProperty(type)) {
            els[i].style.display = activeSections[type] ? '' : 'none';
        }
    }
}

        ci += '<div class="rp-cost-item"><div class="rp-cost-blabel">Ø¨Ø³ØªÙ‡â€ŒØ¨Ù†Ø¯ÛŒ</div><div class="rp-cost-bval" style="color:#0d9488">' + fmtPrice(Math.round(totalPack)) + '</div></div>';

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
   RECIPE DESC & COST PREVIEW
   â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
function buildCard(row, type, index) {
    var prefix;
    if (type === 'raw') prefix = 'rm-';
    else if (type === 'semi') prefix = 'sf-';
    else prefix = 'pk-';

    var cssClass = 'rp-instr-item';
    if (type === 'semi') cssClass += ' rp-instr-semi';
    else if (type === 'pack') cssClass += ' rp-instr-pack';

    var labelPrefix = '';
    if (type === 'semi') labelPrefix = '[Ù†ÛŒÙ…Ù‡] ';
    else if (type === 'pack') labelPrefix = '[Ø¨Ø³ØªÙ‡] ';

    var deleteFunction;
    if (type === 'raw') deleteFunction = removeRawRow;
    else if (type === 'semi') deleteFunction = removeSfRow;
    else deleteFunction = removePackRow;

    var n = row.querySelector('input[id^="' + prefix + 'name-"]');
    var q = row.querySelector('input[id^="' + prefix + 'qty-"]');
    var u = row.querySelector('input[id^="' + prefix + 'unit-"]');
    var nm = n ? n.value.trim() : '';
    if (!nm) return null;
    var rowNum = row.id ? parseInt(row.id.replace(prefix + 'row-', '')) : 0;

    var item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = cssClass;
    item.innerHTML =
        '<span class="rp-instr-name">' + labelPrefix + escHtml(nm) + '</span>' +
        '<input class="rp-instr-qty" type="number" min="0" step="0.001" value="' + (q && q.value ? q.value : '') + '" data-type="' + type + '" data-idx="' + index + '">' +
        '<span class="rp-instr-unit">' + uLabel(u ? u.value : 'kg') + '</span>' +
        '<button class="rp-instr-del" title="Ø­Ø°Ù"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button>';

    var qtyInput = item.querySelector('.rp-instr-qty');
    qtyInput.addEventListener('change', function () {
        if (q) q.value = this.value;
        recalcCostPreview();
    });
    qtyInput.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    item.querySelector('.rp-instr-del').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (!isNaN(rowNum) && rowNum > 0) deleteFunction(rowNum);
    });
    return item;
}

function updateRecipeDesc() {
    var el = document.getElementById('instrList');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerHTML = '';
    var count = 0;
    if (activeSections.raw) {
        var rows1 = queryRows('rawMaterialList');
        for (var i = 0; i < rows1.length; i++) { var card = buildCard(rows1[i], 'raw', i); if (card) { count++; el.appendChild(card); } }
    }
    if (activeSections.semi) {
        var rows2 = queryRows('semiFinishedList');
        for (var j = 0; j < rows2.length; j++) { var card2 = buildCard(rows2[j], 'semi', j); if (card2) { count++; el.appendChild(card2); } }
    }
    if (activeSections.packaging) {
        var rows3 = queryRows('packagingList');
        for (var k = 0; k < rows3.length; k++) { var card3 = buildCard(rows3[k], 'pack', k); if (card3) { count++; el.appendChild(card3); } }
    }
    if (count === 0) el.innerHTML = '<div class="rp-instr-empty">Ù‡Ù†ÙˆØ² Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ Ø§Ù†ØªØ®Ø§Ø¨ Ù†Ø´Ø¯Ù‡</div>';
    syncInstructionsText();
}

function syncInstructionsText() {
    var ta = document.getElementById('instructions');
    if (!ta || ta.dataset.manual === 'true') return;
    var parts = [];
    if (activeSections.raw) {
        var rows1 = queryRows('rawMaterialList');
        for (var i = 0; i < rows1.length; i++) {
            var nm = getRowValue(rows1[i], 'rm-', 'name'), qty = getRowValue(rows1[i], 'rm-', 'qty'), unit = getRowValue(rows1[i], 'rm-', 'unit');
            if (nm && qty) parts.push(nm + ': ' + qty + ' ' + uLabel(unit));
        }
    }
    if (activeSections.semi) {
        var rows2 = queryRows('semiFinishedList');
        for (var j = 0; j < rows2.length; j++) {
            var nm2 = getRowValue(rows2[j], 'sf-', 'name'), qty2 = getRowValue(rows2[j], 'sf-', 'qty'), unit2 = getRowValue(rows2[j], 'sf-', 'unit');
            if (nm2 && qty2) parts.push('[Ù†ÛŒÙ…Ù‡] ' + nm2 + ': ' + qty2 + ' ' + uLabel(unit2));
        }
    }
    if (activeSections.packaging) {
        var rows3 = queryRows('packagingList');
        for (var k = 0; k < rows3.length; k++) {
            var nm3 = getRowValue(rows3[k], 'pk-', 'name'), qty3 = getRowValue(rows3[k], 'pk-', 'qty'), unit3 = getRowValue(rows3[k], 'pk-', 'unit');
            if (nm3 && qty3) parts.push('[Ø¨Ø³ØªÙ‡] ' + nm3 + ': ' + qty3 + ' ' + uLabel(unit3));
        }
    }
    ta.value = parts.join('\n');
}

/* â˜…â˜…â˜… recalcCostPreview â€” Ø¯Ø§ÛŒÙ†Ø§Ù…ÛŒÚ© â˜…â˜…â˜… */
function recalcCostPreview() {
    var tr = 0, ts = 0, tp = 0;
    if (activeSections.raw) {
        var rows1 = queryRows('rawMaterialList');
        for (var i = 0; i < rows1.length; i++) {
            var rid = getRowInt(rows1[i], 'rm-', 'id'), qty = getRowFloat(rows1[i], 'rm-', 'qty');
            if (rid && qty > 0) tr += qty * getRawPrice(rid);
        }
    }
    if (activeSections.semi) {
        var rows2 = queryRows('semiFinishedList');
        for (var k = 0; k < rows2.length; k++) {
            var sid = getRowInt(rows2[k], 'sf-', 'id'), qty2 = getRowFloat(rows2[k], 'sf-', 'qty');
            if (sid && qty2 > 0) ts += qty2 * getSemiCost(sid);
        }
    }
    if (activeSections.packaging) {
        var rows3 = queryRows('packagingList');
        for (var m = 0; m < rows3.length; m++) {
            var pid = getRowInt(rows3[m], 'pk-', 'id'), pqty = getRowFloat(rows3[m], 'pk-', 'qty');
            if (pid && pqty > 0) tp += pqty * getPackagingPrice(pid);
        }
    }
    var t = tr + ts + tp;
    setAllCosts(tr, ts, tp, t, t);
}

function recalcSemiCost() {
    var t = 0;
    var rows = queryRows('semiIngList');
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        var q = getRowFloat(rows[i], 'si-', 'qty');
        var priceEl = rows[i].querySelector('input[id^="si-price-"]');
        var rawVal = priceEl ? priceEl.value : '0';
        var p = parseFloat(rawVal) || 0;
        t += q * p;
    }
    var totalEl = document.getElementById('semiCostTotal');
    if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = fmtPrice(Math.round(t));
    var unitEl = document.getElementById('semiCostUnit');
    if (unitEl) unitEl.textContent = fmtPrice(Math.round(t));
    updateSemiDesc();
}

function updateSemiDesc() {
    var el = document.getElementById('semiDesc');
    if (!el) return;
    if (el.dataset.auto === 'false' && el.value.trim() !== '') return;
    var parts = [];
    var rows = queryRows('semiIngList');
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        var nm = getRowValue(rows[i], 'si-', 'name'), rid = getRowInt(rows[i], 'si-', 'id'), qt = getRowValue(rows[i], 'si-', 'qty'), ul = getRawUnit(rid);
        if (nm) parts.push(nm + (qt ? ': ' + qt : '') + (ul ? ' ' + ul : ''));
    }
    if (parts.length) { el.value = 'Ù…ÙˆØ§Ø¯ Ù…ØµØ±ÙÛŒ: ' + parts.join(' | '); el.dataset.auto = 'true'; }
    else if (el.dataset.auto === 'true') { el.value = ''; }
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
   PICK GRIDS
   â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
function renderRawPickGrid(materials) {
    var g = document.getElementById('rawPickGrid');
    if (!g) return;
    g.innerHTML = '';
    if (!materials || !materials.length) { g.innerHTML = '<div class="rp-pick-empty">Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ ÛŒØ§ÙØª Ù†Ø´Ø¯</div>'; updateRawPickCount(); return; }
    var pids = getRawPickedIds();
    materials.forEach(function (m) {
        var p = pids.indexOf(m.id) !== -1;
        var b = document.createElement('div');
        b.className = 'rp-pick-item' + (p ? ' picked' : '');
        var stock = parseFloat(m.quantity) || 0;
        var price = parseFloat(m.price) || 0;
        var unit = m.unit_display || m.unit || '';
        var stockColor = stock <= 0 ? 'var(--rp-danger)' : (stock < 5 ? 'var(--rp-warning)' : 'var(--rp-success)');
        b.innerHTML =
            '<div style="min-width:0;flex:1"><div class="rp-pick-name">' + escHtml(m.name) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="rp-pick-meta">' + uLabel(unit) + ' | Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ: <span style="color:' + stockColor + ';font-weight:700">' + toP(stock) + '</span> | ' + fmtPrice(price) + '</div></div>' +
            (p ? '<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" style="color:var(--rp-success)"></i>' : '<i class="bi bi-plus-circle" style="color:var(--rp-accent)"></i>');
        if (!p) {
            b.onclick = (function (mat) {
                return function () {
                    addRawMaterialRow({
                        raw_material_id: mat.id, raw_material_name: mat.name,
                        quantity: '', unit: mat.unit_display || mat.unit || 'kg',
                        stock: parseFloat(mat.quantity) || 0
                    });
                    renderRawPickGrid(getFilteredRawList());
                    var el = document.getElementById('rm-qty-' + rawMaterialRowCounter);
                    if (el) el.focus();
                };
            })(m);
        }
        g.appendChild(b);
    });
    updateRawPickCount();
}

function getRawPickedIds() { var ids = []; var rows = queryRows('rawMaterialList'); for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) { var v = getRowInt(rows[i], 'rm-', 'id'); if (v) ids.push(v); } return ids; }
function getFilteredRawList() { var el = document.getElementById('rawPickSearch'); var q = el ? el.value.trim().toLowerCase() : ''; if (!q) return allRawMaterials; return allRawMaterials.filter(function (m) { return (m.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; }); }
function filterRawPickList() { renderRawPickGrid(getFilteredRawList()); }
function updateRawPickCount() { var el = document.getElementById('rawPickCount'); if (el) el.textContent = toP(getRawPickedIds().length) + ' Ø§Ù†ØªØ®Ø§Ø¨'; }

function renderPackagingPickGrid(materials) {
    var g = document.getElementById('packagingPickGrid');
    if (!g) return;
    g.innerHTML = '';
    if (!materials || !materials.length) {
        g.innerHTML = '<div class="rp-pick-empty">Ø¨Ø³ØªÙ‡â€ŒØ¨Ù†Ø¯ÛŒâ€ŒØ§ÛŒ ÛŒØ§ÙØª Ù†Ø´Ø¯</div>';
        updatePackagingPickCount();
        return;
    }

    var pids = getPackagingPickedIds();

    var sorted = materials.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
        var sa = parseFloat(a.quantity) || 0;
        var sb = parseFloat(b.quantity) || 0;
        if (sa > 0 && sb <= 0) return -1;
        if (sa <= 0 && sb > 0) return 1;
        return (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '');
    });

    sorted.forEach(function (m) {
        var p = pids.indexOf(m.id) !== -1;
        var stock = parseFloat(m.quantity) || 0;
        var price = parseFloat(m.price) || 0;
        var unit = m.unit_display || m.unit || '';
        var inStock = stock > 0;

        var b = document.createElement('div');
        b.className = 'rp-pick-item' + (p ? ' picked' : '') + (!inStock && !p ? ' pk-unavailable' : '');

        var stockHtml;
        if (inStock) {
            var sc = stock < 5 ? 'var(--rp-warning)' : 'var(--rp-success)';
            stockHtml = '<span style="color:' + sc + ';font-weight:700">' + toP(stock) + '</span>';
        } else {
            stockHtml = '<span class="pk-badge-unavailable">Ù†Ø§Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯</span>';
        }

        b.innerHTML =
            '<div style="min-width:0;flex:1;opacity:' + (inStock || p ? '1' : '0.5') + '">' +
                '<div class="rp-pick-name">' +
                    '<i class="bi bi-box-seam" style="margin-left:4px;color:' + (inStock ? '#0d9488' : '#999') + '"></i>' +
                    escHtml(m.name) +
                    (!inStock && !p ? ' <span style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--rp-danger);font-weight:600">(Ù†Ø§Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯)</span>' : '') +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="rp-pick-meta">' +
                    uLabel(unit) + ' | Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ: ' + stockHtml + ' | ' + fmtPrice(price) +
                '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            (p
                ? '<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" style="color:#0d9488"></i>'
                : (inStock
                    ? '<i class="bi bi-plus-circle" style="color:#0d9488;cursor:pointer"></i>'
                    : '<i class="bi bi-lock-fill" style="color:#aaa;cursor:not-allowed"></i>'
                )
            );

        if (!p && inStock) {
            b.onclick = (function (mat) {
                return function () {
                    addPackagingRow({
                        packaging_material_id: mat.id,
                        packaging_material_name: mat.name,
                        quantity: '',
                        unit: mat.unit_display || mat.unit || 'unit',
                        stock: parseFloat(mat.quantity) || 0
                    });
                    renderPackagingPickGrid(getFilteredPackagingList());
                    var el = document.getElementById('pk-qty-' + packagingRowCounter);
                    if (el) el.focus();
                };
            })(m);
        } else if (!p && !inStock) {
            b.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';
            b.onclick = function () {
                toast(m.name + ' Ø¯Ø± Ø§Ù†Ø¨Ø§Ø± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ Ù†ÛŒØ³Øª', 'error');
            };
        }

        g.appendChild(b);
    });

    updatePackagingPickCount();
}

function openNewRecipe() {
    document.getElementById('editRecipeId').value = '';
    document.getElementById('editorTitle').textContent = 'Ø±Ø³Ù¾ÛŒ Ø¬Ø¯ÛŒØ¯';
    document.getElementById('deleteBtn').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('foodInput').value = '';
    document.getElementById('foodId').value = '';
    var yieldEl = document.getElementById('yieldQty');
    yieldEl.value = '1'; yieldEl.disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('prepTime').value = '0';
    document.getElementById('instructions').value = '';
    document.getElementById('instructions').dataset.manual = 'false';
    document.getElementById('rawMaterialList').innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('semiFinishedList').innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('packagingList').innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('rawPickSearch').value = '';
    document.getElementById('semiPickSearch').value = '';
    document.getElementById('packagingPickSearch').value = '';
    rawMaterialRowCounter = 0; semiFinishedRowCounter = 0; packagingRowCounter = 0;
    document.getElementById('recipeEditor').style.display = '';

    /* â˜… Ú¯Ø±ÙˆÙ‡â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ + visibility */
    applyGroupVisibility();
    renderCostPreviewRows();

    loadAllRawMaterials().then(function () { return loadAllSemiForPick(); }).then(function () { return loadAllPackagingMaterials(); }).then(function () {
        if (activeSections.raw) renderRawPickGrid(allRawMaterials);
        if (activeSections.semi) renderSemiPickGrid(allSemiForPick);
        if (activeSections.packaging) renderPackagingPickGrid(allPackagingMaterials);
    });
    updateRecipeDesc(); recalcCostPreview();
    document.getElementById('recipeEditor').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
}

function editRecipe(id) {
    document.getElementById('recipeEditor').style.display = '';

    /* â˜… Ú¯Ø±ÙˆÙ‡â€ŒÙ‡Ø§ + visibility */
    applyGroupVisibility();
    renderCostPreviewRows();

    Promise.all([loadAllRawMaterials(), loadAllSemiForPick(), loadAllPackagingMaterials()])
    .then(function () {
        return fetch(API.recipes + id + '/', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } });
    })
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (r) {
        document.getElementById('editRecipeId').value = r.id;
        document.getElementById('editorTitle').textContent = 'ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´: ' + (r.food_name || (typeof r.food === 'object' && r.food ? r.food.name : '') || '-');
        document.getElementById('deleteBtn').style.display = '';
        document.getElementById('foodInput').value = r.food_name || (typeof r.food === 'object' && r.food ? r.food.name : '') || '';
        document.getElementById('foodId').value = r.food_id || (typeof r.food === 'object' ? r.food.id : r.food) || '';
        var yieldEl = document.getElementById('yieldQty');
        yieldEl.value = '1'; yieldEl.disabled = true;
        document.getElementById('prepTime').value = r.estimated_preparation_time || 0;
        document.getElementById('instructions').value = r.instructions || '';
        document.getElementById('instructions').dataset.manual = r.instructions ? 'true' : 'false';
        document.getElementById('rawMaterialList').innerHTML = '';
        document.getElementById('semiFinishedList').innerHTML = '';
        document.getElementById('packagingList').innerHTML = '';
        rawMaterialRowCounter = 0; semiFinishedRowCounter = 0; packagingRowCounter = 0;

        var ingredients = r.ingredients || [];
        var semiItems = r.semi_finished_items || [];
        var packagingItems = r.packaging_items || [];
        if (!ingredients.length && !semiItems.length && !packagingItems.length && r.instructions) {
            var parsed = parseRecipeInstructions(r.instructions);
            ingredients = parsed.raws; semiItems = parsed.semis; packagingItems = parsed.packs;
        }

        if (activeSections.raw) {
            ingredients.forEach(function (ig) {
                var rid = ig.raw_material_id || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' ? (ig.raw_material && ig.raw_material.id) : ig.raw_material);
                if (!rid) {
                    var name = ig.raw_material_name || (ig.raw_material && ig.raw_material.name) || ig.name || '';
                    for (var ri = 0; ri < allRawMaterials.length; ri++) { if (allRawMaterials[ri].name === name) { rid = allRawMaterials[ri].id; break; } }
                }
                addRawMaterialRow({
                    raw_material_id: rid,
                    raw_material_name: ig.raw_material_name || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' && ig.raw_material ? ig.raw_material.name : '') || ig.name || '',
                    quantity: safeVal(ig.quantity || ig.qty, 0), unit: ig.unit, stock: getRawStock(rid)
                });
            });
        }

        if (activeSections.semi) {
            semiItems.forEach(function (sf) {
                var sfId = sf.semi_finished_id || (typeof sf.semi_finished === 'object' ? sf.semi_finished.id : sf.semi_finished);
                if (!sfId) {
                    var name = sf.semi_finished_name || (typeof sf.semi_finished === 'object' && sf.semi_finished ? sf.semi_finished.name : '') || sf.name || '';
                    for (var si = 0; si < allSemiForPick.length; si++) { if (allSemiForPick[si].name === name) { sfId = allSemiForPick[si].id; break; } }
                }
                addSemiFinishedRow({
                    semi_finished_id: sfId,
                    semi_finished_name: sf.semi_finished_name || (typeof sf.semi_finished === 'object' && sf.semi_finished ? sf.semi_finished.name : '') || sf.name || '',
                    quantity: safeVal(sf.quantity || sf.qty, 0), unit: sf.unit
                });
            });
        }

        if (activeSections.packaging) {
            packagingItems.forEach(function (pk) {
                var pkId = pk.packaging_material_id || pk.raw_material_id ||
                           (typeof pk.packaging_material === 'object' ? pk.packaging_material.id : pk.packaging_material) ||
                           (typeof pk.raw_material === 'object' ? (pk.raw_material && pk.raw_material.id) : pk.raw_material);
                if (!pkId) {
                    var name = pk.packaging_material_name || pk.raw_material_name ||
                               (typeof pk.packaging_material === 'object' && pk.packaging_material ? pk.packaging_material.name : '') ||
                               (typeof pk.raw_material === 'object' && pk.raw_material ? pk.raw_material.name : '') || pk.name || '';
                    for (var pi = 0; pi < allPackagingMaterials.length; pi++) { if (allPackagingMaterials[pi].name === name) { pkId = allPackagingMaterials[pi].id; break; } }
                }
                addPackagingRow({
                    packaging_material_id: pkId,
                    packaging_material_name: pk.packaging_material_name || pk.raw_material_name ||
                        (typeof pk.packaging_material === 'object' && pk.packaging_material ? pk.packaging_material.name : '') ||
                        (typeof pk.raw_material === 'object' && pk.raw_material ? pk.raw_material.name : '') || pk.name || '',
                    quantity: safeVal(pk.quantity || pk.qty, 0),
                    unit: pk.unit || 'unit',
                    stock: getPackagingStock(pkId)
                });
            });
        }

        if (activeSections.raw) renderRawPickGrid(getFilteredRawList());
        if (activeSections.semi) renderSemiPickGrid(getFilteredSemiPickList());
        if (activeSections.packaging) renderPackagingPickGrid(getFilteredPackagingList());
        updateRecipeDesc();

        var savedRaw = parseFloat(r.total_raw_material_cost) || 0;
        var savedSemi = parseFloat(r.total_semi_finished_cost) || 0;
        var savedPack = parseFloat(r.total_packaging_cost) || 0;
        var savedTotal = parseFloat(r.total_cost) || (savedRaw + savedSemi + savedPack);
        setAllCosts(savedRaw, savedSemi, savedPack, savedTotal, savedTotal);
        setTimeout(function () { recalcCostPreview(); }, 150);
        document.getElementById('recipeEditor').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    })
    .catch(function (err) { console.error('[editRecipe]', err); toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø¨Ø§Ø±Ú¯Ø°Ø§Ø±ÛŒ', 'error'); });

function closeEditor() { document.getElementById('recipeEditor').style.display = 'none'; }

function saveRecipe() {
    var foodId = document.getElementById('foodId').value;
    if (!foodId || isNaN(parseInt(foodId))) { toast('ØºØ°Ø§ Ø§Ù†ØªØ®Ø§Ø¨ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯', 'error'); return; }

    var hasErr = false, ings = [];
    if (activeSections.raw) {
        var rows1 = queryRows('rawMaterialList');
        for (var i = 0; i < rows1.length; i++) {
            var rid = getRowInt(rows1[i], 'rm-', 'id'), qty = getRowFloat(rows1[i], 'rm-', 'qty'), unit = getRowValue(rows1[i], 'rm-', 'unit') || 'kg';
            var qtyEl = rows1[i].querySelector('input[id^="rm-qty-"]');
            if (rid && qty > 0) {
                var st = getRawStock(rid);
                if (st > 0 && qty > st) { hasErr = true; isOverStock(qtyEl, st, qty); toast('Ø¨ÛŒØ´ØªØ± Ø§Ø² Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ', 'error'); }
                else { isOverStock(qtyEl, st, qty); ings.push({ raw_material: rid, quantity: qty, unit: unit }); }
            }
        }
    }

    var semis = [];
    if (activeSections.semi) {
        var rows2 = queryRows('semiFinishedList');
        for (var j = 0; j < rows2.length; j++) {
            var sid = getRowInt(rows2[j], 'sf-', 'id'), qty2 = getRowFloat(rows2[j], 'sf-', 'qty'), unit2 = getRowValue(rows2[j], 'sf-', 'unit') || 'kg';
            var qtyEl2 = rows2[j].querySelector('input[id^="sf-qty-"]');
            if (sid && qty2 > 0) {
                var st2 = getSemiStock(sid);
                if (st2 > 0 && qty2 > st2) { hasErr = true; isOverStock(qtyEl2, st2, qty2); toast('Ø¨ÛŒØ´ØªØ± Ø§Ø² Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ', 'error'); }
                else { isOverStock(qtyEl2, st2, qty2); semis.push({ semi_finished: sid, quantity: qty2, unit: unit2 }); }
            }
        }
    }

    var packs = [];
    if (activeSections.packaging) {
        var rows3 = queryRows('packagingList');
        for (var k = 0; k < rows3.length; k++) {
            var pid = getRowInt(rows3[k], 'pk-', 'id'), pqty = getRowFloat(rows3[k], 'pk-', 'qty'), punit = getRowValue(rows3[k], 'pk-', 'unit') || 'unit';
            var pkqtyEl = rows3[k].querySelector('input[id^="pk-qty-"]');
            if (pid && pqty > 0) {
                var pst = getPackagingStock(pid);
                if (pst > 0 && pqty > pst) { hasErr = true; isOverStock(pkqtyEl, pst, pqty); toast('Ø¨Ø³ØªÙ‡â€ŒØ¨Ù†Ø¯ÛŒ: Ø¨ÛŒØ´ØªØ± Ø§Ø² Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ', 'error'); }
                else { isOverStock(pkqtyEl, pst, pqty); packs.push({ packaging_material: pid, quantity: pqty, unit: punit }); }
            }
        }
    }

    if (hasErr) return;
    if (!ings.length && !semis.length && !packs.length) { toast('Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ù‚Ù„ ÛŒÚ© Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø§Ø¶Ø§ÙÙ‡ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯', 'error'); return; }

    var payload = {
        food: parseInt(foodId),
        yield_quantity: 1,
        estimated_preparation_time: parseInt(document.getElementById('prepTime').value) || 0,
        instructions: document.getElementById('instructions').value,
        notes: '',
        ingredients: ings,
        semi_finished_items: semis,
        packaging_items: packs,
        restaurant: RESTAURANT_ID
    };
    var eid = document.getElementById('editRecipeId').value;
    fetch(eid ? API.recipes + eid + '/' : API.recipes, {
        method: eid ? 'PUT' : 'POST',
        headers: apiHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
    .then(safeFetchJson)
    .then(function () { toast('Ø°Ø®ÛŒØ±Ù‡ Ø´Ø¯', 'success'); closeEditor(); loadRecipes(); loadFoods(); })
    .catch(function (err) {
        var msg = 'Ø®Ø·Ø§';
        if (err && typeof err === 'object') {
            var p = [];
            for (var kk in err) {
                if (!err.hasOwnProperty(kk)) continue;
                if (Array.isArray(err[kk])) p.push(kk + ': ' + err[kk].join(', '));
                else if (typeof err[kk] === 'string') p.push(kk + ': ' + err[kk]);
            }
            if (p.length) msg = p.join(' | ');
        }
        toast(msg, 'error');
    });
}

function deleteRecipe() {
    var id = document.getElementById('editRecipeId').value;
    if (!id || !confirm('Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´ÙˆØ¯ØŸ')) return;
    fetch(API.recipes + id + '/', { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRF() } })
    .then(function (r) {
        if (r.ok || r.status === 204) { toast('Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´Ø¯', 'success'); closeEditor(); loadRecipes(); loadFoods(); }
        else toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'error');
    })
    .catch(function () { toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'error'); });
}

function calcCost(id) {
    fetch(API.recipes + id + '/calculate-cost/', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRF() } })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) { toast('Ù‡Ø²ÛŒÙ†Ù‡ Ù‡Ø± ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯: ' + fmtPrice(d.total_cost || d.cost_per_serving || 0), 'success'); loadRecipes(); })
    .catch(function () { toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'error'); });
}

function recalculateAll() {
    if (!confirm('Ù…Ø­Ø§Ø³Ø¨Ù‡ Ù…Ø¬Ø¯Ø¯ Ù‡Ù…Ù‡ØŸ')) return;
    fetch(API.recalcAll, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRF() } })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) { toast((d.count || 0) + ' Ø±Ø³Ù¾ÛŒ Ù…Ø­Ø§Ø³Ø¨Ù‡ Ø´Ø¯', 'success'); loadRecipes(); })
    .catch(function () { toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'error'); });

function createMissingRecipes() {
    if (!confirm('Ø¨Ø±Ø§ÛŒ ØªÙ…Ø§Ù… ØºØ°Ø§Ù‡Ø§ÛŒÛŒ Ú©Ù‡ Ø±Ø³Ù¾ÛŒ Ù†Ø¯Ø§Ø±Ù†ØŒ Ø±Ø³Ù¾ÛŒ Ø®Ø§Ù„ÛŒ Ø³Ø§Ø®ØªÙ‡ Ø¨Ø´Ù‡ØŸ')) return;
    fetch(API.recipes + 'create-missing/', { method: 'POST', headers: apiHeaders() })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) {
        if (d.success) { toast(d.message, 'success'); loadRecipes(); loadFoods(); }
        else toast(d.error || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'error');
    })
    .catch(function (e) { toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§: ' + (e.message || 'Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ±'), 'error'); });
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
   RECIPE GRID
   â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
function renderRecipeGrid(recipes) {
    var g = document.getElementById('recipeGrid');
    if (!g) return;
    g.innerHTML = '';
    if (!recipes.length) { g.innerHTML = '<div class="rp-empty"><i class="bi bi-journal-plus"></i><p>Ù‡Ù†ÙˆØ² Ø±Ø³Ù¾ÛŒâ€ŒØ§ÛŒ Ø«Ø¨Øª Ù†Ø´Ø¯Ù‡</p></div>'; return; }
    recipes.forEach(function (r, i) {
        var cost = r.cost_per_serving || 0;
        var foodName = r.food_name || (typeof r.food === 'object' && r.food ? r.food.name : '') || '-';
        var card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'rp-card';
        card.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.04) + 's';

        var chips = '';
        if (activeSections.raw) {
            (r.ingredients || []).forEach(function (ig) {
                var n = ig.raw_material_name || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' && ig.raw_material ? ig.raw_material.name : '') || '';
                var q = ig.quantity || 0;
                var u = ig.unit || (typeof ig.raw_material === 'object' && ig.raw_material ? ig.raw_material.unit : '') || '';
                if (n) chips += '<span class="rp-card-ing-chip rp-chip-raw">' + escHtml(n) + ': ' + toP(q) + (u ? ' ' + escHtml(u) : '') + '</span>';
            });
        }
        if (activeSections.semi) {
            (r.semi_finished_items || []).forEach(function (sf) {
                var n = sf.semi_finished_name || (typeof sf.semi_finished === 'object' && sf.semi_finished ? sf.semi_finished.name : '') || '';
                var q = sf.quantity || 0;
                var u = sf.unit || (typeof sf.semi_finished === 'object' && sf.semi_finished ? sf.semi_finished.unit : '') || '';
                if (n) chips += '<span class="rp-card-ing-chip rp-chip-semi"><i class="bi bi-layers"></i> ' + escHtml(n) + ': ' + toP(q) + (u ? ' ' + escHtml(u) : '') + '</span>';
            });
        }
        if (activeSections.packaging) {
            (r.packaging_items || []).forEach(function (pk) {
                var n = pk.packaging_material_name || pk.raw_material_name ||
                        (typeof pk.packaging_material === 'object' && pk.packaging_material ? pk.packaging_material.name : '') ||
                        (typeof pk.raw_material === 'object' && pk.raw_material ? pk.raw_material.name : '') || '';
                var q = pk.quantity || 0;
                var u = pk.unit || (typeof pk.packaging_material === 'object' && pk.packaging_material ? pk.packaging_material.unit : '') || '';
                if (n) chips += '<span class="rp-card-ing-chip rp-chip-pack"><i class="bi bi-box-seam"></i> ' + escHtml(n) + ': ' + toP(q) + (u ? ' ' + escHtml(u) : '') + '</span>';
            });
        }

        card.innerHTML =
            '<div class="rp-card-top">' +
                '<h3 class="rp-card-title"><i class="bi bi-egg-fried"></i> ' + escHtml(foodName) + '</h3>' +
                '<div class="rp-card-tags">' +
                    (cost > 0 ? '<span class="rp-card-tag rp-tag-price"><i class="bi bi-cash-coin"></i> ' + fmtPrice(Math.round(cost)) + '/ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯</span>' : '<span class="rp-card-tag" style="background:#f5f5f5;color:var(--rp-text-sec)"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-circle"></i> Ø¨Ø¯ÙˆÙ† Ù‡Ø²ÛŒÙ†Ù‡</span>') +
                '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            (chips
                ? '<div class="rp-card-ingredients"><div class="rp-card-ing-title"><i class="bi bi-list-check"></i> Ù…ÙˆØ§Ø¯ Ù…ØµØ±ÙÛŒ (Ø¨Ù‡ Ø§Ø²Ø§ÛŒ Û± ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯):</div><div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px">' + chips + '</div></div>'
                : '<div class="rp-card-ingredients"><span style="font-size:.78rem;color:var(--rp-text-sec);font-style:italic">Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ ØªØ¹Ø±ÛŒÙ Ù†Ø´Ø¯Ù‡ â€” <a href="#" onclick="editRecipe(' + r.id + ');return false" style="color:var(--rp-accent)">ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´</a></span></div>'
            ) +
            '<div class="rp-card-actions">' +
                '<button class="rp-btn rp-btn-outline rp-btn-sm" onclick="editRecipe(' + r.id + ')"><i class="bi bi-pencil"></i> ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´</button>' +
                '<button class="rp-btn rp-btn-accent rp-btn-sm" onclick="calcCost(' + r.id + ')"><i class="bi bi-calculator"></i> Ù…Ø­Ø§Ø³Ø¨Ù‡</button>' +
            '</div>';
        g.appendChild(card);
    });
}

function filterRecipes() {
    var q = document.getElementById('recipeSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    renderRecipeGrid(!q ? allRecipes : allRecipes.filter(function (r) {
        return (r.food_name || (typeof r.food === 'object' && r.food ? r.food.name : '') || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
    }));
}

function renderRecipeDetail(food, recipe) {
    var box = document.getElementById('rcpBox');

        return;
    }

            var rawLookup = rid ? findRawById(rid) : null;
            var name = ing.raw_material_name || (typeof ing.raw_material === 'object' && ing.raw_material ? ing.raw_material.name : '') || ing.name || (rawLookup ? rawLookup.name : '') || '-';
            var qty = parseFloat(ing.quantity || ing.qty) || 0;
            var unit = ing.unit || (typeof ing.raw_material === 'object' && ing.raw_material ? ing.raw_material.unit : '') || (rawLookup ? (rawLookup.unit_display || rawLookup.unit) : '');
            var price = parseFloat(ing.price || (typeof ing.raw_material === 'object' && ing.raw_material ? ing.raw_material.price : 0)) || 0;
            if (!price && rid) price = getRawPrice(rid);
            if (!price && name) price = findRawPrice(name);

            var sfId = sf.semi_finished_id || (typeof sf.semi_finished === 'object' ? sf.semi_finished.id : sf.semi_finished);

function loadSemiSubIngredients(sfId) {
    if (!sfId) return;
    var container = document.getElementById('semi-sub-' + sfId);
    if (!container) return;
    var semiObj = findSemiById(sfId);
    if (semiObj) { var ings = getSemiIngredients(semiObj); if (ings.length) { renderSemiSub(sfId, ings); return; } }
    var cached = cacheGet(sfId);
    if (cached) { var cachedIngs = getSemiIngredients(cached); if (cachedIngs.length) { renderSemiSub(sfId, cachedIngs); return; } }
    fetch(API.semiFinished + sfId + '/', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (det) { cacheSet(sfId, det); renderSemiSub(sfId, getSemiIngredients(det)); })
    .catch(function () {});
}

function renderSemiSub(sfId, subIngs) {
    var container = document.getElementById('semi-sub-' + sfId);
    if (!container) return;
    if (!subIngs || !subIngs.length) { container.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    var html = '<div style="font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--rp-text-sec);margin-bottom:6px"><i class="bi bi-list-ul"></i> Ù…ÙˆØ§Ø¯ Ø§ÙˆÙ„ÛŒÙ‡:</div>';
    subIngs.forEach(function (ig) {
        var igName = ig.name || ig.raw_material_name || '-', igQty = parseFloat(ig.qty || ig.quantity) || 0, igUnit = ig.unit || '';
        var igPrice = parseFloat(ig.price) || 0; if (!igPrice && igName) igPrice = findRawPrice(igName);
        var igCost = igQty * igPrice;
        html += '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 8px;margin-bottom:3px;background:rgba(124,58,237,.04);border-radius:6px;font-size:.76rem"><div><span style="font-weight:600">' + escHtml(igName) + '</span> <span style="color:var(--rp-text-sec)">: ' + toP(igQty) + ' ' + uLabel(igUnit) + '</span></div>' + (igCost > 0 ? '<span style="font-weight:700;color:var(--rp-purple)">' + fmtPrice(Math.round(igCost)) + '</span>' : '') + '</div>';
    });
    container.innerHTML = html;
    container.style.display = '';
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
   FOOD VIEW
   â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
function renderFoodBtns(list) {
    var g = document.getElementById('foodGrid'); if (!g) return; g.innerHTML = '';
    if (!list.length) { g.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--rp-text-sec);font-size:.88rem;padding:8px">ØºØ°Ø§ÛŒÛŒ Ù†ÛŒØ³Øª</div>'; return; }
    list.forEach(function (f) {
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.className = 'rp-food-btn' + (selFood && selFood.id === f.id ? ' active' : '');
        b.textContent = f.name;
        b.onclick = function () { selectFood(f); };
        g.appendChild(b);
    });
}

function filtFoods() {
    var q = document.getElementById('foodSrch').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    renderFoodBtns(!q ? allFoods : allFoods.filter(function (f) { return (f.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; }));
}

function selectFood(food) {
    selFood = food;
    document.getElementById('foodCloseBtn').style.display = '';
    var q = document.getElementById('foodSrch').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    renderFoodBtns(!q ? allFoods : allFoods.filter(function (f) { return (f.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; }));
    var recipeListItem = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < allRecipes.length; i++) {
        var r = allRecipes[i], fid = r.food_id || (r.food && (typeof r.food === 'object' ? r.food.id : r.food));
        if (String(fid) === String(food.id)) { recipeListItem = r; break; }
    }
    var detail = document.getElementById('rcpDetail'), empty = document.getElementById('rcpEmpty');
    if (recipeListItem) {
        fetch(API.recipes + recipeListItem.id + '/', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (fullRecipe) {
            empty.style.display = 'none'; detail.style.display = '';
            renderRecipeDetail(food, fullRecipe);
            detail.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
            for (var jdx = 0; jdx < allRecipes.length; jdx++) { if (allRecipes[jdx].id === fullRecipe.id) { allRecipes[jdx] = fullRecipe; break; } }
        })
        .catch(function () {
            empty.style.display = 'none'; detail.style.display = '';
            renderRecipeDetail(food, recipeListItem);
            detail.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
        });
    } else {
        detail.style.display = 'none'; empty.style.display = '';
        openNewRecipe();
        document.getElementById('foodInput').value = food.name;
        document.getElementById('foodId').value = food.id;
    }
}

function switchTab(btn, tabId) {
    var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.rp-tab');
    for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) tabs[i].classList.remove('active');
    var panels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');
    for (var j = 0; j < panels.length; j++) panels[j].classList.remove('active');
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('panel-' + tabId).classList.add('active');
    if (tabId === 'semi') loadSemiFinished();
}

function loadSemiFinished() {
    fetch(API.semiFinished, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })

}

function filterSemi() {
    var q = document.getElementById('semiSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    renderSemiGrid(!q ? allSemi : allSemi.filter(function (s) { return (s.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; }));
}

function closeSemiEditor() { document.getElementById('semiEditor').style.display = 'none'; }

function editSemi(id) {
    var s = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < allSemi.length; i++) { if (allSemi[i].id === id) { s = allSemi[i]; break; } }
    if (!s) return;
    document.getElementById('semiEditId').value = s.id;
    document.getElementById('semiEditorTitle').textContent = 'ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´: ' + s.name;
    document.getElementById('semiDeleteBtn').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('semiName').value = s.name;
    document.getElementById('semiCategory').value = s.category || 'other';
    document.getElementById('semiUnit').value = s.unit || 'kg';
    var semiYieldEl = document.getElementById('semiYield');
    semiYieldEl.value = '1'; semiYieldEl.disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('semiDesc').value = s.description || '';
    document.getElementById('semiDesc').dataset.auto = 'false';
    document.getElementById('semiIngList').innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('semiIngPickSearch').value = '';
    semiIngCounter = 0;
    document.getElementById('semiEditor').style.display = '';
    loadAllRawMaterials().then(function () {
        var src = s;
        for (var sp = 0; sp < allSemiForPick.length; sp++) { if (allSemiForPick[sp].id === s.id) { src = allSemiForPick[sp]; break; } }
        var ings = getSemiIngredients(src);
        ings.forEach(function (ig) {
            var rid = 0;
            for (var ri = 0; ri < allRawMaterials.length; ri++) {
                if (allRawMaterials[ri].name === ig.name) { rid = allRawMaterials[ri].id; break; }
            }
            if (!rid && ig.name) {
                for (var ri2 = 0; ri2 < allRawMaterials.length; ri2++) {
                    var rn = (allRawMaterials[ri2].name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                    var igName = (ig.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                    if (rn === igName || rn.indexOf(igName) !== -1 || igName.indexOf(rn) !== -1) { rid = allRawMaterials[ri2].id; break; }
                }
            }
            var dn = ig.name + (ig.unit ? ' (' + ig.unit + ')' : '');
            var rowId = addSemiIngRow({ id: rid, name: dn, quantity: ig.qty });
            if (rid) {
                var raw = findRawById(rid);
                var pi = document.getElementById('si-price-' + rowId);
                if (pi && raw) pi.value = raw.price || 0;
            }
        });
        recalcSemiCost(); renderSemiIngPickGrid();
    });
    document.getElementById('semiEditor').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
}

function saveSemi() {
    var name = document.getElementById('semiName').value.trim();
    if (!name) { toast('Ù†Ø§Ù… Ø§Ù„Ø²Ø§Ù…ÛŒ', 'error'); return; }
    var hasErr = false, ings = [], dp = [];
    var rows = queryRows('semiIngList');
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        var rid = getRowInt(rows[i], 'si-', 'id'), qty = getRowFloat(rows[i], 'si-', 'qty'), nm = getRowValue(rows[i], 'si-', 'name');
        var qtyEl = rows[i].querySelector('input[id^="si-qty-"]');
        if (rid && qty > 0) {
            var st = getRawStock(rid);
            if (st > 0 && qty > st) { hasErr = true; isOverStock(qtyEl, st, qty); toast(nm + ': Ø¨ÛŒØ´ØªØ± Ø§Ø² Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ', 'error'); }
            else {
                isOverStock(qtyEl, st, qty);
                ings.push({ raw_material_id: rid, quantity: qty });
                var ul = getRawUnit(rid);
                if (nm) dp.push(nm + ': ' + toP(qty) + (ul ? ' ' + ul : ''));
            }
        }
    }
    if (hasErr) return;
    if (!ings.length) { toast('Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡ Ø§ÙˆÙ„ÛŒÙ‡ Ø§Ø¶Ø§ÙÙ‡ Ú©Ù†ÛŒØ¯', 'error'); return; }
    var descEl = document.getElementById('semiDesc'), fd = descEl.value.trim();
    if (!fd && dp.length) fd = 'Ù…ÙˆØ§Ø¯ Ù…ØµØ±ÙÛŒ: ' + dp.join(' | ');
    var payload = {
        name: name, category: document.getElementById('semiCategory').value,
        unit: document.getElementById('semiUnit').value, quantity_produced: 1,
        description: fd, ingredients: ings, restaurant: RESTAURANT_ID
    };
    var eid = document.getElementById('semiEditId').value;
    fetch(eid ? API.semiFinished + eid + '/' : API.semiFinished, {
        method: eid ? 'PUT' : 'POST', headers: apiHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
    .then(safeFetchJson)
    .then(function () { toast('Ø°Ø®ÛŒØ±Ù‡ Ø´Ø¯', 'success'); closeSemiEditor(); loadSemiFinished(); loadAllSemiForPick(); loadAllRawMaterials(); })
    .catch(function (err) {
        var msg = 'Ø®Ø·Ø§';
        if (err && typeof err === 'object') {
            var p = [];
            for (var k in err) {
                if (!err.hasOwnProperty(k)) continue;
                if (k === 'detail') p.push(err[k]);
                else if (Array.isArray(err[k])) p.push(k + ': ' + err[k].join(', '));
                else if (typeof err[k] === 'string') p.push(k + ': ' + err[k]);
            }
            if (p.length) msg = p.join(' | ');
        }
        toast(msg, 'error');
    });
}

function deleteSemiConfirm(id) {
    if (!confirm('Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´ÙˆØ¯ØŸ')) return;
    fetch(API.semiFinished + id + '/', { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRF() } })
    .then(function (r) {
        if (r.ok || r.status === 204) { toast('Ø­Ø°Ù Ø´Ø¯', 'success'); loadSemiFinished(); loadAllSemiForPick(); }
        else toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'error');
    })
    .catch(function () { toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'error'); });
}

function deleteSemi() { var id = document.getElementById('semiEditId').value; if (id) deleteSemiConfirm(parseInt(id)); }

function mOpen(id) {
    var r = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < allSemi.length; i++) { if (allSemi[i].id === id) { r = allSemi[i]; break; } }
    if (!r) return;
    selR = r;
    document.getElementById('mNm').textContent = r.name;
    document.getElementById('mQt').value = 1;
    document.getElementById('mEr').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('mSum').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('mLst').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:20px"><span class="rp-spinner"></span></div>';
    document.getElementById('mOv').classList.add('show');
    fetchDetail(id).then(function (det) {
        if (!selR || selR.id !== id) return;
        selR.ingredients = det.ingredients || [];
        mChg();
    });
}

function mCls() { document.getElementById('mOv').classList.remove('show'); selR = null; }

function fetchDetail(id) {
    var cached = cacheGet(id);
    if (cached) return Promise.resolve(cached);
    return fetch(API.semiFinished + id + '/', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) { cacheSet(id, d); return d; });
}

function mChg() {
    if (!selR) return;
    var b = parseInt(document.getElementById('mQt').value) || 1;
    var lst = document.getElementById('mLst'), err = document.getElementById('mEr'), btn = document.getElementById('mBtn'), sum = document.getElementById('mSum');
    lst.innerHTML = '';
    var ings = selR.ingredients || [];
    if (!ings.length) {
        lst.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:var(--rp-text-sec)">Ù…Ø§Ø¯Ù‡â€ŒØ§ÛŒ ØªØ¹Ø±ÛŒÙ Ù†Ø´Ø¯Ù‡</div>';
        btn.disabled = true; sum.style.display = 'none'; return;
    }
    var hasErr = false, totalCost = 0;
    ings.forEach(function (ing) {
        var rid = ing.raw_material_id || (typeof ing.raw_material === 'object' ? (ing.raw_material && ing.raw_material.id) : ing.raw_material);
        var rn = ing.raw_material_name || (typeof ing.raw_material === 'object' && ing.raw_material ? ing.raw_material.name : '') || '-';
        var nq = (parseFloat(ing.quantity) || 0) * b;
        var ru = ing.unit || (typeof ing.raw_material === 'object' && ing.raw_material ? ing.raw_material.unit : '') || 'kg';
        var pr = parseFloat(ing.price || (typeof ing.raw_material === 'object' && ing.raw_material ? ing.raw_material.price : 0)) || 0;
        if (!pr && rid) pr = getRawPrice(rid);
        var rowCost = nq * pr; totalCost += rowCost;
        var sv = getRawStock(rid), ok = sv >= nq;
        if (!ok) hasErr = true;
        var item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'rp-si ' + (ok ? 'ok' : 'fail');
        item.innerHTML =
            '<div class="rp-si-left"><div class="rp-si-name">' + escHtml(rn) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="rp-si-detail"><span>Ù†ÛŒØ§Ø²: <strong>' + toP(nq) + '</strong> ' + uLabel(ru) + '</span>' +
            '<span>| Ù‚ÛŒÙ…Øª: ' + fmtPrice(pr) + '</span>' +
            '<span style="color:' + (ok ? 'var(--rp-success)' : 'var(--rp-danger)') + '">| Ø¬Ù…Ø¹: <strong>' + fmtPrice(Math.round(rowCost)) + '</strong></span></div></div>' +
            '<div class="rp-si-right"><div class="rp-si-stock" style="color:' + (ok ? 'var(--rp-success)' : 'var(--rp-danger)') + '">' +
            (ok ? 'âœ“ ' : 'âœ— ') + toP(sv) + ' ' + uLabel(ru) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="rp-si-stock-label">Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ Ø§Ù†Ø¨Ø§Ø±</div></div>';
        lst.appendChild(item);
    });
    sum.style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('mCostVal').textContent = fmtPrice(totalCost);
    document.getElementById('mUnitCost').textContent = b > 0 ? fmtPrice(Math.round(totalCost / b)) : '-';
    document.getElementById('mOutVal').textContent = toP(b) + ' ' + uLabel(selR.unit);
    if (hasErr) { err.style.display = ''; document.getElementById('mErMsg').textContent = 'Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ÛŒ Ø¨Ø¹Ø¶ÛŒ Ù…ÙˆØ§Ø¯ Ú©Ø§ÙÛŒ Ù†ÛŒØ³Øª!'; btn.disabled = true; }
    else { err.style.display = 'none'; btn.disabled = false; }
}

        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRF() },

    })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) {
        mCls();
        if (d.success || d.data) toast(semiName + ' ØªÙˆÙ„ÛŒØ¯ Ø´Ø¯', 'success');
        else toast(d.error || d.message || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'error');
        cacheDet = {};
        return Promise.all([loadSemiFinished(), loadAllRawMaterials()]);
    })
    .then(function () { loadAllSemiForPick(); })
    .catch(function () { toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ÛŒ Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ±', 'error'); mCls(); })
    .then(function () { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-lightning-charge-fill"></i> ØªÙˆÙ„ÛŒØ¯'; },
          function () { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-lightning-charge-fill"></i> ØªÙˆÙ„ÛŒØ¯'; });
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
   STATS
   â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
function updateStats() {
    var st = document.getElementById('statTotal'), sf = document.getElementById('statFoods'), sr = document.getElementById('statRaw'), sa = document.getElementById('statAvgCost');
    if (st) st.textContent = toP(allRecipes.length);
    if (sf) sf.textContent = toP(allFoods.length);
    if (sr) sr.textContent = toP(allRawMaterials.length);
    if (sa) {
        if (allRecipes.length) {
            var tc = 0;
            allRecipes.forEach(function (r) { tc += parseFloat(r.cost_per_serving) || 0; });
            sa.textContent = fmtPrice(Math.round(tc / allRecipes.length));
        } else { sa.textContent = 'â€”'; }
    }
}

/* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
   DATA LOADING
   â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
function loadRecipes() {
    fetch(API.recipes, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRF() } })
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) { allRecipes = Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d.results || []); renderRecipeGrid(allRecipes); updateStats(); })
    .catch(function (err) { console.error('[loadRecipes]', err); allRecipes = []; renderRecipeGrid([]); updateStats(); });
}

function loadFoods() {
    fetch(API.foods, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) {
        allFoods = Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d.results || []);
        renderFoodBtns(allFoods);
        var fc = document.getElementById('foodCount');
        if (fc) fc.textContent = toP(allFoods.length) + ' ØºØ°Ø§';
        updateStats();
    })
    .catch(function () { allFoods = []; });
}

function loadAllRawMaterials() {
    return fetch(API.rawSuggest + '?type=raw&q=', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) {
        allRawMaterials = Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d.results || []);
        renderRawPickGrid(allRawMaterials);
        renderSemiIngPickGrid();
        updateStats();
        return allRawMaterials;
    })
    .catch(function () { allRawMaterials = []; return []; });
}

function loadAllPackagingMaterials() {
    return fetch(API.packagingSuggest + '?type=packaging&q=', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) {
        allPackagingMaterials = Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d.results || []);
        renderPackagingPickGrid(allPackagingMaterials);
        return allPackagingMaterials;
    })
    .catch(function () { allPackagingMaterials = []; return []; });
}

function loadAllSemiForPick() {
    return fetch(API.semiFinished, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) {
        allSemiForPick = Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d.results || []);
        var promises = allSemiForPick.map(function (s) {
            if (s.ingredients && s.ingredients.length > 0) return Promise.resolve();
            var cached = cacheGet(s.id);
            if (cached && cached.ingredients && cached.ingredients.length > 0) {
                s.ingredients = cached.ingredients;
                s.cost_per_unit = cached.cost_per_unit || s.cost_per_unit || 0;
                if (!s.quantity_produced && cached.quantity_produced) s.quantity_produced = cached.quantity_produced;
                return Promise.resolve();
            }
            return fetch(API.semiFinished + s.id + '/', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
            .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function (det) {
                cacheSet(s.id, det);
                s.ingredients = det.ingredients || [];
                s.cost_per_unit = det.cost_per_unit || s.cost_per_unit || 0;
                s.quantity_produced = det.quantity_produced || s.quantity_produced || 1;
                s.unit = det.unit || s.unit || '';
            })
            .catch(function () {});
        });
        return Promise.all(promises);
    })
    .then(function () {
        renderSemiPickGrid(allSemiForPick);
        if (allSemi.length) renderSemiGrid(allSemi);
        return allSemiForPick;
    })
    .catch(function () { allSemiForPick = []; return []; });
}

   â˜…â˜…â˜… INIT â€” Ø¨Ø§ loadRecipeGroups â˜…â˜…â˜…
   â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
var _debouncedUpdateDesc = debounce(updateRecipeDesc, 120);
var _debouncedRecalcCost = debounce(recalcCostPreview, 120);

document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    var id = e.target.id;
    if (!id) return;

    if (id.indexOf('rm-qty-') === 0) {
        var row = e.target.closest('.rp-ing-row');
        var rid = row ? getRowInt(row, 'rm-', 'id') : 0;
        isOverStock(e.target, getRawStock(rid), parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0);
        _debouncedUpdateDesc(); _debouncedRecalcCost(); return;
    }
    if (id.indexOf('sf-qty-') === 0) {
        var row2 = e.target.closest('.rp-ing-row');
        var sid = row2 ? getRowInt(row2, 'sf-', 'id') : 0;
        isOverStock(e.target, getSemiStock(sid), parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0);
        _debouncedUpdateDesc(); _debouncedRecalcCost(); return;
    }
    if (id.indexOf('si-qty-') === 0) {
        var row3 = e.target.closest('.rp-ing-row');
        var siRid = row3 ? getRowInt(row3, 'si-', 'id') : 0;
        isOverStock(e.target, getRawStock(siRid), parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0);

    if (id === 'yieldQty') { _debouncedRecalcCost(); return; }
    if (id === 'semiYield') { _debouncedRecalcSemi(); return; }
});

  function getToken() {
    return localStorage.getItem('super_admin_token') || '';

  function apiHeaders() {
    return {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-CSRFToken': getCookie('csrftoken') || '',
      'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + getToken()
    };

  function getCookie(name) {
    var val = null;
    document.cookie.split(';').forEach(function(c) {
      c = c.trim();
      if (c.startsWith(name + '=')) {
        val = decodeURIComponent(c.slice(name.length + 1));
      }
    });
    return val;
  }

    t.textContent = msg;
    c.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(function() { t.remove(); }, 3000);
  }

  function renderServices(services) {

    var html = '';
    services.forEach(function(s) {
      var enabledClass = s.is_enabled ? ' enabled' : '';
      var today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
      var isExpired = s.end_date && s.end_date < today;
      if (isExpired && s.is_enabled) enabledClass += ' expired-svc';

      var dateStatusHTML = '';
      if (s.is_enabled) {
        if (!s.end_date) {
          dateStatusHTML = '<span class="date-status no-date">Ø¨Ø¯ÙˆÙ† Ø§Ù†Ù‚Ø¶Ø§</span>';
        } else if (isExpired) {
          dateStatusHTML = '<span class="date-status expired">Ù…Ù†Ù‚Ø¶ÛŒ</span>';
        } else {
          dateStatusHTML = '<span class="date-status valid">ÙØ¹Ø§Ù„</span>';
        }
      }

      html += '<div class="service-item' + enabledClass + '" data-sid="' + s.service_id + '">' +
        '<div class="service-top">' +
        '<span class="service-icon">' + s.icon + '</span>' +
        '<div class="service-info"><div class="service-name">' + s.label + '</div>' +
        '<div class="service-desc">' + (s.description || s.code) + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class="service-price"><input type="number" value="' + s.price + '" data-price="' + s.service_id + '"><span>ØªÙˆÙ…Ø§Ù†/Ù…Ø§Ù‡</span></div>' +
        '<label class="toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-toggle="' + s.service_id + '"' + (s.is_enabled ? ' checked' : '') + ' onchange="onToggleService(this)"><span class="toggle-slider"></span></label>' +
        '</div>' +

        dateStatusHTML +

    });
    list.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function onToggleService(el) {
    var item = el.closest('.service-item');
    if (el.checked) {

    } else {

    }
  }

  async function saveTenantServices() {
    if (!selectedTenantId) return;
    var items = document.querySelectorAll('.service-item');
    var services = [];
    items.forEach(function(item) {
      var sid = parseInt(item.dataset.sid);
      var toggle = item.querySelector('[data-toggle="' + sid + '"]');
      var price = item.querySelector('[data-price="' + sid + '"]');
      var startInput = item.querySelector('[data-start="' + sid + '"]');
      var endInput = item.querySelector('[data-end="' + sid + '"]');
      services.push({
        service_id: sid,
        is_enabled: toggle.checked,
        price: parseInt(price.value) || 0,
        start_date: startInput.value || null,
        end_date: endInput.value || null
      });
    });
    try {
      var res = await fetch('/api/super/tenants/' + selectedTenantId + '/services/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: apiHeaders(),
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        body: JSON.stringify({ services: services })
      });
      var d = await res.json();
      if (d.ok) {
        toast(d.msg || 'Ø°Ø®ÛŒØ±Ù‡ Ø´Ø¯', 'success');
        loadTenants();
      } else {
        toast(d.error || 'Ø®Ø·Ø§', 'error');
      }
    } catch(e) {
      toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ Ø¯Ø± Ø°Ø®ÛŒØ±Ù‡', 'error');
    }
  }

  async function loadUsers(page) {
    usersPage = page || 1;
    var search = document.getElementById('user-search-input').value.trim();
    var restId = document.getElementById('user-filter-restaurant').value;
    var params = '?page=' + usersPage;
    if (search) params += '&search=' + encodeURIComponent(search);
    if (restId) params += '&restaurant_id=' + restId;

    try {
      var res = await fetch('/api/super/users/' + params, {
        headers: apiHeaders(),
        credentials: 'same-origin'
      });
      if (res.status === 403 || res.status === 401) {
        localStorage.clear();
        window.location.href = '/dashboard/super/auth/?next=/dashboard/super/';
        return;
      }
      var d = await res.json();
      renderUsers(d.users || [], d.page || 1, d.pages || 1, d.total || 0);
    } catch(e) {
      console.error('Users error:', e);
    }
  }

  function renderUsers(users, page, pages, total) {
    var tbody = document.getElementById('users-body');
    var empty = document.getElementById('users-empty');
    if (!users.length) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      empty.style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('users-pagination').innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    empty.style.display = 'none';
    var html = '';
    users.forEach(function(u, i) {
      var roleBadge = u.is_superuser
        ? '<span class="badge admin">Ù…Ø¯ÛŒØ± Ú©Ù„</span>'
        : '<span class="badge role">' + u.role_display + '</span>';

        ? '<span class="badge active">ÙØ¹Ø§Ù„</span>'
        : '<span class="badge inactive">ØºÛŒØ±ÙØ¹Ø§Ù„</span>';
      html += '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + ((page - 1) * 20 + i + 1) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="font-weight:700;">' + u.username + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (u.first_name || '-') + ' ' + (u.last_name || '') + '</td>' +
        '<td style="direction:ltr;text-align:right;">' + (u.phone_number || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + roleBadge + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (u.restaurant_name || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + statusBadge + '</td>' +
        '<td><button class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onclick="openPermsModal(' + u.id + ')">ðŸ”‘ Ø¯Ø³ØªØ±Ø³ÛŒâ€ŒÙ‡Ø§</button></td>' +
        '<td><div class="actions">' +

        (!u.is_superuser ? '<button class="btn-icon" onclick="openDeleteUser(' + u.id + ')" title="Ø­Ø°Ù">ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>' : '') +
        '</div></td></tr>';

    if (pages > 1) {
      pHtml += '<button ' + (page <= 1 ? 'disabled' : '') + ' onclick="loadUsers(' + (page - 1) + ')">â€¹</button>';
      for (var p = 1; p <= pages; p++) {
        if (p === page) {
          pHtml += '<button class="active">' + p + '</button>';
        } else if (Math.abs(p - page) <= 2 || p === 1 || p === pages) {
          pHtml += '<button onclick="loadUsers(' + p + ')">' + p + '</button>';
        } else if (Math.abs(p - page) === 3) {
          pHtml += '<span class="pagination-info">...</span>';
        }
      }
      pHtml += '<button ' + (page >= pages ? 'disabled' : '') + ' onclick="loadUsers(' + (page + 1) + ')">â€º</button>';
    }
    document.getElementById('users-pagination').innerHTML = pHtml;
  }

    function checkStrengthPass(pass) {

    }
    function checkStrength(pass) {
        doStrengthCheck(pass, document.getElementById('addStrengthFill'), document.getElementById('addStrengthText'));
    }

    function doStrengthCheck(pass, fill, text) {
        if (!pass) { fill.className = 'strength-fill'; text.textContent = ''; return; }
        var score = 0;
        if (pass.length >= 6) score++;
        if (pass.length >= 10) score++;
        if (/[A-Z]/.test(pass)) score++;
        if (/[0-9]/.test(pass)) score++;
        if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(pass)) score++;
        if (score <= 2) {
            fill.className = 'strength-fill strength-weak';
            text.textContent = 'Ø¶Ø¹ÛŒÙ'; text.style.color = 'var(--danger)';
        } else if (score <= 3) {
            fill.className = 'strength-fill strength-medium';
            text.textContent = 'Ù…ØªÙˆØ³Ø·'; text.style.color = 'var(--accent)';
        } else {
            fill.className = 'strength-fill strength-strong';
            text.textContent = 'Ù‚ÙˆÛŒ'; text.style.color = 'var(--success)';
        }
    }

        } catch (err) { toast('Ø®Ø·Ø§ÛŒ Ø§Ø±ØªØ¨Ø§Ø·', true); }
    }

function doStrengthCheck(pass,fill,text){
    if(!pass){fill.className='strength-fill';text.textContent='';return;}
    var s=0;if(pass.length>=4)s++;if(pass.length>=10)s++;if(/[A-Z]/.test(pass))s++;if(/[0-9]/.test(pass))s++;if(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(pass))s++;
    if(s<=2){fill.className='strength-fill strength-weak';text.textContent='Ø¶Ø¹ÛŒÙ';text.style.color='var(--danger)';}
    else if(s<=3){fill.className='strength-fill strength-medium';text.textContent='Ù…ØªÙˆØ³Ø·';text.style.color='var(--accent)';}
    else{fill.className='strength-fill strength-strong';text.textContent='Ù‚ÙˆÛŒ';text.style.color='var(--success)';}
}
